notes: Text commands converted: text/line/cont -> newline joins, para -> blank line, done/prompt end a block.

The source charmap token '#' is pokecrystal's abbreviation glyph for 'POKe' (e.g. '#MON' = 'POKeMON') and is kept raw, as are <PLAYER>/<RIVAL> placeholder tokens, matching the Kanto pack's treatment of <PLAYER>.

Only text blocks physically inside each map's own .asm file are staged. Shared/common text (data/text/, engine text, phone/radio scripts) is not per-map and is not staged - dialogue coverage is therefore honestly partial for system text.

entries.BugsyText_INeverLose:
I'm BUGSY!
I never lose when

it comes to bug
#MON.

My research is
going to make me

the authority on
bug #MON!

Let me demonstrate
what I've learned
from my studies.
entries.BugsyText_ResearchIncomplete:
Whoa, amazing!
You're an expert
on #MON!

My research isn't
complete yet.

OK, you win. Take
this BADGE.
entries.BugsyText_HiveBadgeSpeech:
Do you know the
benefits of HIVE-
BADGE?

If you have it,
#MON up to L30

will obey you,
even traded ones.

#MON that know
CUT will be able

to use it outside
of battle too.

Here, I also want
you to have this.
entries.BugsyText_FuryCutterSpeech:
TM49 contains
FURY CUTTER.

If you don't miss,
it gets stronger
every turn.

The longer your
battle goes, the
better it gets.

Isn't that great?
I discovered it!
entries.BugsyText_BugMonsAreDeep:
Bug #MON are
deep. There are

many mysteries to
be explored.

Study your favor-
ites thoroughly.
entries.BugCatcherBennySeenText:
Bug #MON evolve
young. So they get

stronger that much
faster.
entries.BugCatcherBennyAfterBattleText:
#MON become
stronger if they
evolve. Really!
entries.BugCatcherAlSeenText:
Bug #MON are
cool and tough!

I'll prove it to
you!
entries.BugCatcherAlBeatenText:
You proved how
tough you are…
entries.BugCatcherAlAfterBattleText:
They're so cool,
but most girls

don't like bug
#MON.

I don't know why…
entries.BugCatcherJoshSeenText:
You saved all the
SLOWPOKE? Whew,
you're mighty!

But my grown-up
#MON are pretty
tough too!
entries.BugCatcherJoshAfterBattleText:
I guess I should
teach them better
moves…
entries.TwinsAmyandmay1SeenText:

challenging the
LEADER? No way!
entries.TwinsAmyandmay2SeenText:
MAY: You want to
see the LEADER?
We come first!
entries.TwinsAmyandmay2AfterBattleText:
MAY: Our bug #-
MON lost! Oh, what
a shame.
entries.AzaleaGymGuideText:
Yo, challenger!

BUGSY's young, but
his knowledge of

bug #MON is for
real.

It's going to be
tough without my
advice.

Let's see… Bug
#MON don't like
fire.

Flying-type moves
are super-effec-
tive too.
entries.AzaleaGymGuideWinText:
Well done! That
was a great clash

of talented young
trainers.

With people like
you, the future of
#MON is bright!

entries.AzaleaMartCooltrainerMText:
There's no GREAT
BALL here. #

BALLS will have
to do.

I wish KURT would
make me some of
his custom BALLS.
entries.AzaleaMartBugCatcherText:
A GREAT BALL is
better for catch-
ing #MON than a
# BALL.

But KURT's might
be better some-
times.

entries.AzaleaPokecenter1FGentlemanText:
Do your #MON
know HM moves?

Those moves can
be used even if

your #MON has
fainted.
entries.AzaleaPokecenter1FUnusedText:

created the system

for storing
#MON in a PC.

BILL's PC can
store up to 20
#MON per BOX.
entries.AzaleaPokecenter1FFishingGuruText:
BILL's PC can
store up to 20
#MON per BOX.
entries.AzaleaPokecenter1FPokefanFText:
Do you know about
APRICORNS?

Crack one open,
hollow it out and

fit it with a
special device.

Then you can catch
#MON with it.

Before # BALLS
were invented,

everyone used
APRICORNS.

entries.AzaleaTownRivalBeforeText:
…Tell me some-
thing.

Is it true that
TEAM ROCKET has
returned?

What? You beat
them? Hah! Quit
lying.

You're not joking?
Then let's see how
good you are.
entries.AzaleaTownRivalWinText:
… Humph! Useless
#MON!

Listen, you. You
only won because

my #MON were
weak.
entries.AzaleaTownRivalAfterText:
I hate the weak.

#MON, trainers.
It doesn't matter
who or what.

I'm going to be
strong and wipe
out the weak.

That goes for TEAM
ROCKET too.

They act big and
tough in a group.

But get them
alone, and they're
weak.

I hate them all.

You stay out of my
way. A weakling

like you is only a
distraction.
entries.AzaleaTownRocket1Text:
It's unsafe to go
in there, so I'm
standing guard.

Aren't I a good
Samaritan?
entries.AzaleaTownRocket2Text:
Do you know about
SLOWPOKETAIL? I
heard it's tasty!

Aren't you glad I
told you that?
entries.AzaleaTownGrampsTextBefore:
The SLOWPOKE have
disappeared from
town…

I heard their
TAILS are being
sold somewhere.
entries.AzaleaTownGrampsTextAfter:
The SLOWPOKE have
returned.

Knowing them, they
could've just been

goofing off some-
where.
entries.AzaleaTownTeacherText:
Did you come to
get KURT to make
some BALLS?

A lot of people do
just that.
entries.AzaleaTownYoungsterText:
Cut through AZALEA
and you'll be in
ILEX FOREST.

But these skinny
trees make it

impossible to get
through.

The CHARCOAL MAN's
#MON can CUT
down trees.
entries.AzaleaTownKurtText1:
ILEX FOREST is
restless!

What is going on?
entries.AzaleaTownKurtText3:
Could you go see
why ILEX FOREST is
so restless?
entries.AzaleaTownSignText:
AZALEA TOWN
Where People and

#MON Live in
Happy Harmony

AZALEA TOWN

SLOWPOKE WELL

Also known as the
RAINMAKER WELL.

Locals believe
that a SLOWPOKE's
yawn summons rain.

Records show that
a SLOWPOKE's yawn

ended a drought
400 years ago.
entries.AzaleaTownIlexForestSignText:
ILEX FOREST

Enter through the
gate.

entries.Text_BattleTowerWelcomesYou:
BATTLE TOWER
welcomes you!

I could show you
to a BATTLE ROOM.
entries.Text_WantToGoIntoABattleRoom:
Want to go into a
BATTLE ROOM?
entries.Text_RightThisWayToYourBattleRoom:
Right this way to
your BATTLE ROOM.
entries.Text_BattleTowerIntroduction_1:
BATTLE TOWER is a
facility made for
#MON battles.

Countless #MON
trainers gather

from all over to
hold battles in

specially designed
BATTLE ROOMS.

There are many
BATTLE ROOMS in
the BATTLE TOWER.

Each ROOM holds
seven trainers.

If you defeat the
seven in a ROOM,

and you have a
good record, you

could become the
ROOM's LEADER.

All LEADERS will
be recorded in the

HONOR ROLL for
posterity.

You may challenge
in up to five

BATTLE ROOMS each
day.

However, you may
battle only once a

day in any given
ROOM.

To interrupt a
session, you must

SAVE. If not, you
won't be able to

resume your ROOM
challenge.
entries.Text_BattleTowerIntroduction_2:
BATTLE TOWER is a
facility made for
#MON battles.

Countless #MON
trainers gather

from all over to
hold battles in

specially designed
BATTLE ROOMS.

There are many

You've beaten all
the trainers!

Your feat may be
worth registering,

be chosen as a

entries.Text_CongratulationsYouveBeatenAllTheTra:
Congratulations!

You've beaten all
the trainers!

For that, you get
this great prize!

Would you like to
register your

record with the

Please make room

entries.Text_YourRegistrationIsComplete:
Your registration
is complete.

entries.Text_WeHopeToServeYouAgain:
We hope to serve
you again.
entries.Text_WouldYouLikeToHearAboutTheBattleTow:

are written here.

Three #MON may

different.

The items they
hold must also be
different.

Certain #MON
may also have

level restrictions
placed on them.
entries.Text_BattleTower_LeftWithoutSaving:
Excuse me!
You didn't SAVE

before exiting
the BATTLE ROOM.

I'm awfully sorry,
but your challenge

will be declared
invalid.
entries.Text_YourMonWillBeHealedToFullHealth:
Your #MON will
be healed to full
health.
entries.Text_SaveBeforeConnecting_Mobile:
Your session will
be SAVED before

connecting with
the CENTER.
entries.Text_SaveBeforeEnteringBattleRoom:
Before entering
the BATTLE ROOM,

your progress will
be saved.
entries.Text_SaveBeforeReentry:
Your record will
be SAVED before

you go back into

entries.Text_RegisterRecordOnFile_Mobile:
We have your

file. Would you
like to register

entries.Text_WeveBeenWaitingForYou:
We've been waiting
for you. This way

to a BATTLE ROOM,
please.
entries.Text_FiveDayBattleLimit_Mobile:

five BATTLE ROOMS

Please come back
tomorrow.

Sorry, but it's

current record at

entries.Text_RegisterRecordTimedOut_Mobile:
Sorry, but it's
not possible to

entries.Text_BattleTowerYoungster:

entries.Text_BattleTowerCooltrainerF:
There are lots of
BATTLE ROOMS, but

entries.Text_BattleTowerGranny:

in battle.

Making your
#MON hold items

is the key to
winning battles.
entries.Text_BattleTowerBugCatcher:

how far I can go

using just bug

entries.BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText_NotYetOp:
Wow, the BATTLE
TOWER is huge! My

TOWER is huge!

whole bunch of

trainers inside,

a wide variety of

entries.BattleTowerOutsideYoungsterText:
Wow, the BATTLE
TOWER is huge!

There must be many
kinds of #MON

entries.BattleTowerOutsideBeautyText_NotYetOpen:

it must be for

entries.BattleTowerOutsideSailorText_Mobile:

a LEADER!
entries.BattleTowerOutsideSailorText:
Hehehe, I snuck

I have to win it

entries.BattleTowerOutsideSignText:
BATTLE TOWER

Take the Ultimate

entries.BattleTowerOutsideText_DoorsClosed:
The BATTLE TOWER's
doors are closed…

entries.BillTakeThisEeveeText:
BILL: Hi, <PLAYER>!
Do us a favor and
take this EEVEE.

It came over when
I was adjusting
the TIME CAPSULE.

Someone has to
take care of it,

but I don't like
being outside.

Can I count on you
to play with it,
<PLAYER>?
entries.BillImCountingOnYouText:
BILL: I knew you'd
come through!

Way to go! You're
the real deal!

OK, I'm counting
on you.

Take good care of
it!
entries.BillEeveeMayEvolveText:
BILL: PROF.ELM
claims EEVEE may

evolve in new and
unknown ways.
entries.BillPartyFullText:
Whoa, wait. You
can't carry any
more #MON.
entries.BillPopWontWorkText:
BILL: My pop, he
won't work. All he

does is goof off
all day long.

He's getting to be
a real headache…
entries.BillsMomText_BeforeEcruteak:
Oh, you collect
#MON? My son
BILL is an expert.

He just got called
to the #MON

CENTER in ECRUTEAK
CITY.

My husband went
off to the GAME

CORNER without
being called…
entries.BillsMomText_AfterEcruteak:
My husband was
once known as a

#MANIAC.
BILL must have

taken after his
father.
entries.BillsYoungerSisterUsefulNumberText:
Are you a trainer?

I've got a useful
phone number for
you.
entries.BillsYoungerSisterRefusedNumberText:
My brother made
the PC #MON
storage system.

I was going to
give you BILL's
number…
entries.BillsYoungerSisterPhoneFullText:
You can't record
any more numbers.
entries.BillsYoungerSisterStorageSystemText:
My big brother
BILL made the PC

#MON storage
system.

entries.BillsGrandpaIntroText:
Hm? You know BILL?
He's my grandson.

He's in JOHTO. He
does something

with PCs, so I'm
house-sitting.
entries.BillsGrandpaAskToSeeMonText:
If you have that
#MON, may I see
it, please?
entries.BillsGrandpaExcitedToSeeText:
You will show me?
How good of you!
entries.BillsGrandpaYouDontHaveItTextText:
You don't have it?
That's too bad…
entries.BillsGrandpaTokenOfAppreciationText:
Thanks!

This is a token of
my appreciation.
entries.BillsGrandpaShownAllThePokemonText:
Thanks for showing
me so many cute
#MON.

I really enjoyed
myself. I'm glad

I've lived such a
long life.
entries.BillsGrandpaWrongPokemonText:
Hm?

That's not the
#MON that I was
told about.
entries.BillsGrandpaLickitungText:
My grandson BILL
told me about a

#MON that has a
long tongue.
entries.BillsGrandpaOddishText:
Ah, my grandson
mentioned a round,

green #MON that
has leaves growing
on its head.
entries.BillsGrandpaStaryuText:
Do you know of a
sea #MON that

has a red sphere
in its body?

You know, the one
that's shaped like
a star?

I heard that it
appears at night.

I would surely
like to see it.
entries.BillsGrandpaGrowlitheText:
BILL told me about
a #MON that is

very loyal to its
trainer.

It's supposed to
ROAR well.
entries.BillsGrandpaVulpixText:
I heard about a
cute #MON that
has six tails.

I would love to
hug a cute #MON
like that.
entries.BillsGrandpaPichuText:
Do you know that
hugely popular
#MON?

The #MON that
has a yellow body
and red cheeks.

I would love to
see what it looks

like before it
evolves.

entries.BillsOlderSisterText:
My grandpa is at 
my brother BILL's
on CERULEAN CAPE.
entries.BillsOlderSistersHouseYoungsterText:
I saw these weird,
slow #MON on
CYCLING ROAD.

entries.Text_ClairIsOut:
I am sorry.

CLAIR, our GYM
LEADER, entered

the DRAGON'S DEN
behind the GYM.

I have no idea
when our LEADER
will return.
entries.Text_ClairIsIn:
CLAIR, our GYM
LEADER, is waiting
for you.

However, it would
be impossible for

a run-of-the-mill
trainer to win.
entries.Text_ClairIsBeaten:
You defeated
CLAIR?

That's amazing!

I've never heard
of her losing to

anyone other than
LANCE.
entries.BlackthornGrampsRefusesEntryText:
No. Only chosen
trainers may train

here.
Please leave.
entries.BlackthornGrampsGrantsEntryText:
If CLAIR allows
it, her grand-
father--our MASTER
--will also.

You may enter.
entries.BlackBeltText_WeirdRadio:
My radio's busted?
Lately, I only get
this weird signal.
entries.BlackBeltText_VoicesInMyHead:
Arooo! Voices in
my head!

Huh? I'm listening
to my radio!
entries.BlackthornCooltrainerF1Text:
Are you going to
make your #MON
forget some moves?
entries.BlackthornYoungsterText:
Dragon masters all
come from the city
of BLACKTHORN.
entries.MeetSantosText:
SANTOS: …

It's Saturday…

I'm SANTOS of
Saturday…
entries.SantosGaveGiftText:
SANTOS: …

SPELL TAG…

Ghost-type moves
get stronger…

It will frighten
you…
entries.SantosSaturdayText:
SANTOS: …

See you again on
another Saturday…

I won't have any
more gifts…
entries.BlackthornCooltrainerF2Text:
Wow, you came
through the ICE
PATH?

You must be a real
hotshot trainer!
entries.BlackthornCitySignText:
BLACKTHORN CITY

A Quiet Mountain
Retreat
entries.BlackthornGymSignText:
BLACKTHORN CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: CLAIR

The Blessed User
of Dragon #MON
entries.BlackthornCityTrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

A #MON holding
a MIRACLEBERRY

will cure itself
of any status
problem.

entries.BlackthornDragonSpeechHouseGrannyText:
A clan of trainers
who can freely

command dragons
live right here in
BLACKTHORN.

As a result, there
are many legends

about dragons in
this town.

entries.ClairIntroText:
I am CLAIR.

The world's best
dragon master.

I can hold my own
against even the

#MON LEAGUE's
ELITE FOUR.

Do you still want
to take me on?

…Fine.
Let's do it!

As a GYM LEADER,
I will use my full

power against any
opponent!
entries.ClairWinText:
I lost?

I don't believe
it. There must be
some mistake…
entries.ClairText_GoToDragonsDen:
I won't admit
this.

I may have lost,
but you're still

not ready for the
#MON LEAGUE.

I know. You should
take the dragon
user challenge.

Behind this GYM is
a place called
DRAGON'S DEN.

There is a small
shrine at its

center.
Go there.

If you can prove
that you've lost

your lazy ideals,
I will recognize

you as a trainer
worthy of a GYM
BADGE!
entries.ClairText_TooMuchToExpect:
What's the matter?

Is it too much to
expect of you?
entries.BlackthornGymClairText_YouKeptMeWaiting:
You've kept me
waiting!

Here! Take this!
entries.BlackthornGymClairText_DescribeTM24:
That contains
DRAGONBREATH.

No, it doesn't
have anything to
do with my breath.

If you don't want
it, you don't have
to take it.
entries.BlackthornGymClairText_BagFull:
What is this? You
don't have room?
entries.BlackthornGymClairText_League:
What's the matter?

Aren't you headed
to the #MON
LEAGUE?

Don't you know
where it is?

From here, go to
NEW BARK TOWN.

Then SURF east.
The route there is
very tough.

Don't you dare
lose at the #-
MON LEAGUE!

If you do, I'll
feel even worse

about having lost
to you!

Give it every-
thing you've got.
entries.CooltrainermPaulSeenText:
Your first battle
against dragons?

I'll show you how
tough they are!
entries.CooltrainermPaulAfterBattleText:
LANCE told you
that he'd like to

see you again?
Not a chance!
entries.CooltrainermMikeSeenText:
My chance of
losing? Not even
one percent!
entries.CooltrainermMikeAfterBattleText:
I know my short-
comings now.

Thanks for showing
me!
entries.CooltrainerfLolaSeenText:
Dragons are sacred
#MON.

They are full of
life energy.

If you're not
serious, you won't

be able to beat
them.
entries.CooltrainerfLolaAfterBattleText:
Dragons are weak
against dragon-
type moves.
entries.BlackthornGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

It's been a long
journey, but we

are almost done!
Count on me!

CLAIR uses the
mythical and sac-
red dragon-type
#MON.

You can't damage
them very easily.

But you know,
they're supposed

to be weak against
ice-type moves.
entries.BlackthornGymGuideWinText:
You were great to
beat CLAIR!

All that's left is
the #MON LEAGUE
challenge.

You're on the way
to becoming the
#MON CHAMPION!

entries.CooltrainermCodySeenText:
It's not as if we
all use dragon-
type #MON.
entries.CooltrainermCodyBeatenText:
Rats! If only I
had a dragon!
entries.CooltrainermCodyAfterBattleText:
Members of our
dragon-user clan

can use dragon
#MON only after

our MASTER allows
it.
entries.CooltrainerfFranSeenText:
I can't allow a
nameless trainer
past me!

CLAIR would be
livid if I did!
entries.CooltrainerfFranAfterBattleText:
Uh-oh… CLAIR is
going to be mad…

entries.BlackthornMartCooltrainerMText:
You can't buy MAX
REVIVE, but it

fully restores a
fainted #MON.

Beware--it won't
restore PP, the

POWER POINTS
needed for moves.
entries.BlackthornMartBlackBeltText:
MAX REPEL keeps
weak #MON away
from you.

It's the longest
lasting of the
REPEL sprays.

entries.BlackthornPokecenter1FGentlemanText:
Deep inside far-
off INDIGO PLATEAU

is the #MON
LEAGUE.

I hear the best
trainers gather

there from around
the country.
entries.BlackthornPokecenter1FTwinText:
There was this
move I just had

to teach my #-
MON.

So I got the MOVE
DELETER to make it
forget an HM move.

DAISY: Hi! My kid
brother is the GYM

LEADER in VIRIDIAN
CITY.

But he goes out
of town so often,

it causes problems
for the trainers.

entries.DaisyCantGroomEggText:
DAISY: Oh, sorry.
I honestly can't
groom an EGG.

entries.BrunoScript_BrunoBeforeText:
I am BRUNO of the
ELITE FOUR.

I always train to
the extreme be-
cause I believe in
our potential.

That is how we
became strong.

Can you withstand
our power?

Hm? I see no fear
in you. You look

determined. Per-
fect for battle!

Ready, <PLAYER>?
You will bow down

to our overwhelm-
ing power!

Hoo hah!
entries.BrunoScript_BrunoDefeatText:
Having lost, I
have no right to
say anything…

Go face your next
challenge!

entries.BurnedTowerRival_BeforeText:
<……> <……> <……>

…Oh, it's you.

I came looking for
some legendary

#MON that they
say roosts here.

But there's
nothing here!

Nothing after all
the trouble of

coming to this
dump? No way!

It's all your
fault!
entries.BurnedTowerRival_WinText:
…Humph!

This is why I hate
battling wimps.

There's no
challenge in it.
entries.BurnedTowerRival_AfterText1:
…Aw, whatever.

You would never be
able to catch a

legendary #MON
anyway.
entries.BurnedTowerRival_LossText:
…Humph!

This is why I hate
battling wimps.

It's just a waste
of my time.
entries.BurnedTowerRival_AfterText2:
Humph!

What are you doing
falling into a

hole? Some genius
you are!

Serves you right!
entries.BurnedTower1FEusineIntroText:
EUSINE: My name's
EUSINE.

I'm on the trail
of a #MON named
SUICUNE.

And you are…?

<PLAYER>? Glad to
meet you!

I heard rumors
that SUICUNE is in

this BURNED TOWER,
so I came to look.

But where exactly
could it be?
entries.BurnedTower1FEusineText:
EUSINE: I heard
that SUICUNE is in

this BURNED TOWER,
so I came to look.

But where exactly
could it be?
entries.BurnedTower1FMortyText:
MORTY: ECRUTEAK's
GYM LEADER has to

study what are
said to be the

legendary #MON
--SUICUNE, ENTEI
and RAIKOU.

EUSINE is here, so
I've decided to

investigate the
TOWER with him.

entries.BurnedTowerB1FEusineText:
EUSINE: I dug a
hole here, too…

I was shocked!

SUICUNE raced by
like a blur, right

in front of my
eyes!

For ten years I
chased SUICUNE,

and I finally got
to see it.

I'm all choked up!

<PLAYER>, I owe
this all to you!

Thank you!

I heard that the
legendary #MON

of ECRUTEAK test
chosen humans by

allowing them to
get close.

I'm going to track
SUICUNE.

<PLAYER>, let's
meet again!

Farewell!

entries.ChefText_Eatathon:
Hi!

We're holding an
eatathon contest.

We can't serve you
right now. Sorry.
entries.Fisher1Text_Concentration:
Don't talk to me!

You'll break my
concentration!
entries.Fisher2Text_Quantity:
I take quantity
over quality!

I'm happy when I'm
full!
entries.Fisher3Text_GoldenrodIsBest:
The food is good
here, but GOLDEN-
ROD has the best
food anywhere.
entries.TeacherText_NoCoinCase:
Nobody here will
give you a COIN

CASE. You should
look in JOHTO.
entries.TeacherText_KeepEating:
Crunch… Crunch…

I can keep eating!
entries.EatathonContestPosterText:
Eatathon Contest!
No time limit!

A battle without
end! The biggest

muncher gets it
all for free!

entries.CeladonCityFisherText:
This POLIWRATH is
my partner.

I wonder if it'll
ever evolve into a
frog #MON.
entries.CeladonCityGramps1Text:
GRIMER have been
appearing lately.

See that pond out
in front of the

house? GRIMER live
there now.

Where did they
come from? This is
a serious problem…
entries.CeladonCityGramps2Text:
Nihihi! This GYM
is great! Only

girls are allowed
here!
entries.CeladonCityYoungster1Text:
Want to know a
secret?

CELADON MANSION
has a hidden back
door.
entries.CeladonCityYoungster2Text:
They're holding an
eating contest at
the restaurant.

Just watching them
go at it makes me
feel bloated…
entries.CeladonCityTeacher2Text:
CELADON DEPT.STORE
has the biggest

and best selection
of merchandise.

If you can't get
it there, you

can't get it any-
where.

Gee… I sound like
a sales clerk.
entries.CeladonCityLassText_Mobile:
I love being
surrounded by tall
buildings!

Isn't it true that
GOLDENROD #MON

CENTER was made
much, much bigger?

That is so neat!
I wish we had a

place like that in
KANTO…
entries.CeladonCityLassText:
Looking at the
ground while I was

walking made me
dizzy.
entries.CeladonCitySignText:
CELADON CITY

The City of
Rainbow Dreams
entries.CeladonGymSignText:
CELADON CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: ERIKA

The Nature-Loving
Princess
entries.CeladonCityDeptStoreSignText:
Find What You
Need at CELADON
DEPT.STORE!
entries.CeladonCityTrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

GUARD SPEC.
protects #MON

against SPECIAL
attacks such as
fire and water.

Get your items at
CELADON DEPT.
STORE!

entries.CeladonDeptStore1FReceptionistText:
Hello! Welcome to
CELADON DEPT.
STORE!

The directory is
on the wall.
entries.CeladonDeptStore1FGentlemanText:
This DEPT.STORE is
part of the same

chain as the one
in GOLDENROD CITY.

They were both
renovated at the
same time.
entries.CeladonDeptStore1FTeacherText:
This is my first
time here.

It's so big…

I'm afraid I'll
get lost.
entries.CeladonDeptStore1FDirectoryText:
1F: SERVICE
    COUNTER

2F: TRAINER'S
    MARKET

3F: TM SHOP

4F: WISEMAN GIFTS

5F: DRUG STORE

6F: ROOFTOP
    SQUARE

entries.CeladonDeptStore2FPokefanMText:
I just recently
became a trainer.

My son encouraged
me to do it.

I'm impressed by
the selection of
convenient items.
entries.CeladonDeptStore2FYoungsterText:
My dad's having a
hard time learning

the names of items
and how they are

supposed to be
used…
entries.CeladonDeptStore2FDirectoryText:
Top Grade Items
for Trainers!

2F: TRAINER'S
    MARKET

entries.CeladonDeptStore3FYoungsterText:
I can't decide
which #MON I

should use this TM
on…
entries.CeladonDeptStore3FGameboyKid1Text:
Uh-oh! I traded my
#MON without

removing the UP-
GRADE from it.
entries.CeladonDeptStore3FGameboyKid2Text:
Yeah! I'm finally
getting a PORYGON!

I'm no good at the
slots, so I could

never get enough
coins…

…Huh?

The traded PORYGON
turned into a dif-
ferent #MON!
entries.CeladonDeptStore3FSuperNerdText:
The TM SHOP sells
some rare moves.

entries.CeladonDeptStore4FSuperNerdText:
I'm here to buy
SURF MAIL to send
to my girlfriend.
entries.CeladonDeptStore4FYoungsterText:
This is the only
place where you

can buy LOVELY
MAIL.
entries.CeladonDeptStore4FDirectoryText:
Express Yourself
With Gifts!

4F: WISEMAN GIFTS

entries.CeladonDeptStore5FGentlemanText:
I want to buy some
items that raise

#MON stats, but
I don't have
enough money…
entries.CeladonDeptStore5FSailorText:
I want PP UP, so I
can raise the PP

of moves. But you
can't buy it…
entries.CeladonDeptStore5FTeacherText:
Using items on
them makes #-
MON happy.

They hate certain
items, though…

entries.CeladonVendingText:
A vending machine!
Here's the menu.
entries.CeladonVendingNoSpaceText:
There's no more
room for stuff…
entries.CeladonDeptStore6FSuperNerdText:
A vending machine
with a prize rou-
lette…

You never see
those anymore.
entries.CeladonDeptStore6FYoungsterText:
Aww! There's no
games here!

I wanted to play…

entries.CeladonGameCornerReceptionistText:
Welcome!

You may exchange
your coins for

fabulous prizes
next door.
entries.CeladonGameCornerPokefanMText:
The slot machines
are all state of
the art.
entries.CeladonGameCornerFisherText2:
Gahahaha!

It makes me feel
good to do nice

things for other
people!
entries.CeladonGameCornerFisherNoCoinCaseText:
Hey, you don't
have a COIN CASE.

How am I supposed
to give you any
coins, kid?
entries.CeladonGymGuideText:
Hey! CHAMP in
making!

Are you playing
entries.CeladonGameCornerPoster1Text:
Hey!

Underneath this
poster…

There's nothing!
entries.CeladonGameCornerPoster2Text:
Hey!

Underneath this
poster…

There's nothing!
entries.CeladonGameCornerSodaCanText:
A can of soda…

Someone must be
coming back…

Huh? It's empty!

entries.CeladonGameCornerPrizeRoomGentlemanText:
I wanted PORYGON,
but I was short by
100 coins…
entries.CeladonPrizeRoom_PrizeVendorIntroText:
Welcome!

We exchange your
coins for fabulous
prizes!
entries.CeladonPrizeRoom_NotEnoughRoomText:
You have no room
for it.
entries.CeladonPrizeRoom_ComeAgainText:
Oh. Please come
back with coins!
entries.CeladonPrizeRoom_NoCoinCaseText:
Oh? You don't have
a COIN CASE.

entries.ErikaBeforeBattleText:
ERIKA: Hello…
Lovely weather,

isn't it?
It's so pleasant…

…I'm afraid I may
doze off…

My name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of
CELADON GYM.

…Oh? All the way
from JOHTO, you
say? How nice…

Oh. I'm sorry, I
didn't realize

that you wished to
challenge me.

Very well, but I
shall not lose.
entries.ErikaBeatenText:
ERIKA: Oh!
I concede defeat…

You are remarkably
strong…

I shall give you
RAINBOWBADGE…
entries.ErikaExplainTMText:
ERIKA: That was a
delightful match.

I felt inspired.
Please, I wish you
to have this TM.

It is GIGA DRAIN.

It is a wonderful
move that drains

half the damage it
inflicts to heal
your #MON.

Please use it if
it pleases you…
entries.ErikaAfterBattleText:
ERIKA: Losing
leaves a bitter
aftertaste…

But knowing that
there are strong

trainers spurs me
to do better…
entries.LassMichelleSeenText:
Do you think a
girls-only GYM
is rare?
entries.LassMichelleAfterBattleText:
I just got care-
less, that's all!
entries.PicnickerTanyaSeenText:
Oh, a battle?
That's kind of
scary, but OK!
entries.PicnickerTanyaAfterBattleText:
Oh, look at all
your BADGES. No

wonder I couldn't
win!
entries.BeautyJuliaSeenText:
Were you looking
at these flowers
or at me?
entries.BeautyJuliaAfterBattleText:
How do I go about
becoming ladylike
like ERIKA?
entries.TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenText:
We'll show you
#MON moves that
ERIKA taught us!
entries.TwinsJoAndZoe1AfterBattleText:
ERIKA will get you
back for us!

entries.CeladonMansionManagerText:
My dear #MON
keep me company,

so I don't ever
feel lonely.

MEOWTH even brings
money home.

entries.CeladonMansion2FComputerText:
<PLAYER> turned on
the PC.

…

Someone was in the
middle of compos-
ing an e-mail.

…I hope you'll
come visit KANTO.

I think you'll be
surprised at how

much things have
changed here.

You'll also see
many #MON that

aren't native to
JOHTO.

To the PRODUCER

…

entries.GameFreakGameDesignerText:
Is that right?

I'm the GAME
DESIGNER!

Filling up your
#DEX is tough,
but don't give up!
entries.GameFreakGameDesignerCompletedPokedexTex:
Wow! Excellent!
You completed your
#DEX!

Congratulations!
entries.GameFreakGameDesignerAfterDiplomaText:
The GRAPHIC ARTIST
will print out a
DIPLOMA for you.

You should go show
it off.
entries.GameFreakGraphicArtistText:
I'm the GRAPHIC
ARTIST.

I drew you!
entries.GameFreakGraphicArtistPrintDiplomaText:
I'm the GRAPHIC
ARTIST.

Oh, you completed
your #DEX?

Want me to print
out your DIPLOMA?
entries.GameFreakGraphicArtistRefusedText:
Give me a shout if
you want your
DIPLOMA printed.
entries.GameFreakGraphicArtistErrorText:
Something's wrong.
I'll have to can-
cel printing.
entries.GameFreakProgrammerText:
Who, me? I'm the
PROGRAMMER.

Play the slot
machines!
entries.GameFreakCharacterDesignerText:
Aren't the TWINS
adorable?

JASMINE's pretty
too.

Oh, I love them!
entries.CeladonMansion3FDrawingText:
It's a detailed
drawing of a
pretty girl.
entries.CeladonMansion3FGameProgramText:
It's the game
program. Messing

with it could put
a bug in the game!
entries.CeladonMansion3FReferenceMaterialText:
It's crammed with
reference materi-
als. There's even
a # DOLL.

entries.CeladonMansionRoofFisherText:
High places--I do
love them so!

I'd say the only
thing that loves

heights as much as
me is smoke!
entries.CeladonMansionRoofGraffitiText:
There's graffiti
on the wall…

<PLAYER> added a
moustache!

entries.CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistIntroTe:
Let me recount a
terrifying tale…
entries.CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistNotNigh:
Then again, it's
not as scary while

it's still light
outside.

Come back after
sunset, OK?
entries.CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistStoryTe:
Once upon a time,
there was a little

boy who was given
a new BICYCLE…

He wanted to try
it right away…

He was having so
much fun that he

didn't notice the
sun had set…

While riding home
in the pitch-black

night, the bike
suddenly slowed!

The pedals became
heavy!

When he stopped
pedaling, the bike

began slipping
backwards!

It was as if the
bike were cursed

and trying to drag
him into oblivion!

…

…

SHRIEEEEK!

The boy had been
riding uphill on
CYCLING ROAD!

…
Ba-dum ba-dum!

For listening so
patiently, you may
take this--TM03!
entries.CeladonMansionRoofHousePharmacistCurseTe:
TM03 is CURSE.

It's a terrifying
move that slowly

whittles down the
victim's HP.

entries.CeladonPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
ERIKA is a master
of grass #MON.

She'll make you
pay if you don't
watch yourself.
entries.CeladonPokecenter1FPharmacistText:
TEAM ROCKET's
hideout is in the

basement of the
GAME CORNER.

Oh, wait. That was
three years ago.
entries.CeladonEusineText1:
EUSINE: Hi!

I'm back visiting
my hometown.

It's been quite a
while.
entries.EusineLeavesCeladonText:
<PLAYER>, have you
heard?

There have been
fresh rumors of a

rainbow-colored
#MON appearing
at TIN TOWER.

I've just had my
party healed, so

now I'm headed to
ECRUTEAK.

I'll be seeing
you, <PLAYER>!
entries.NoBeastsText:
Oh, by the way,
<PLAYER>.

Have you caught
the legendary

#MON RAIKOU and
ENTEI?

<……><……><……>

Okay…

If you catch even
one, I hope that
you'll inform me.

I'm counting on
you, <PLAYER>!

entries.CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText1:
KANTO's POWER
PLANT?

It's near the end
of ROUTE 9, the

road that heads
east from here.

I think there was
an accident of
some sort there.
entries.CeruleanCityCooltrainerMText2:
You're collecting
every single kind
of #MON?

That must be quite
a challenge, but
it sounds fun too.
entries.CeruleanCitySuperNerdText:
The CAPE in the
north is a good

place for dates.
Girls like it!
entries.CeruleanCityCooltrainerFText1:
My SLOWBRO and I
make an awesome
combination!
entries.CeruleanCityFisherText:
I'm a huge fan of
CERULEAN GYM's
MISTY.
entries.CeruleanCityFisherRocketTipText:
I saw this shady
guy go off toward
CERULEAN's CAPE.
entries.CeruleanCityYoungsterText1:
There used to be a
cave here that had

horribly powerful
#MON in it.
entries.CeruleanCitySignText:
CERULEAN CITY

A Mysterious Blue
Aura Surrounds It
entries.CeruleanGymSignText:
CERULEAN CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: MISTY

The Tomboyish
Mermaid
entries.CeruleanBikeShopSignText:
There's a notice
here…

The BIKE SHOP has
moved to GOLDENROD
CITY in JOHTO…
entries.CeruleanPoliceSignText:
There's a notice
here…

Stamp out thievery
and make the city

a friendlier, more
cheerful place!

CERULEAN POLICE

entries.CeruleanGymGruntIntroText:
Oops! I so sorry!
You not hurt,
okay?

I very busy.
No time for talk-
ing with you. Not
good for me if
seen by somebody.
entries.CeruleanGymGruntBigMistakeText:
Oh no! You seen
me already! I make
big mistake!
entries.CeruleanGymGruntByeText:
Hey, you! Forget
you see me, okay?

You see, hear,
know nothing,

okay?
Bye, kid! Nothing!

Bye-bye a go-go!
entries.CeruleanGymNote1Text:
Sorry, I'll be out
for a while.
MISTY, GYM LEADER
entries.CeruleanGymNote2Text:
Since MISTY's out,
we'll be away too.
GYM TRAINERS
entries.MistyIntroText:
MISTY: I was ex-
pecting you, you
pest!

You may have a
lot of JOHTO GYM

BADGES, but you'd
better not take me
too lightly.

My water-type
#MON are tough!
entries.MistyWinLossText:
MISTY: You really
are good…

I'll admit that
you are skilled…

Here you go. It's
CASCADEBADGE.
entries.MistyFightDoneText:
MISTY: Are there
many strong train-
ers in JOHTO? Like
you, I mean.

I'm going to
travel one day, so

I can battle some
skilled trainers.
entries.SwimmerfDianaSeenText:
Sorry about being
away. Let's get on
with it!
entries.SwimmerfDianaBeatenText:
I give up! You're
the winner!
entries.SwimmerfBrianaSeenText:
Don't let my ele-
gant swimming un-
nerve you.
entries.SwimmerfBrianaBeatenText:
Ooh, you calmly
disposed of me…
entries.SwimmerfBrianaAfterBattleText:
Don't be too smug
about beating me.

MISTY will destroy
you if you get
complacent.
entries.SwimmermParkerSeenText:
Glub…

I'm first! Come
and get me!
entries.SwimmermParkerAfterBattleText:
MISTY has gotten
much better in the
past few years.

Don't let your
guard down, or
you'll be crushed!
entries.CeruleanGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

Since MISTY was
away, I went out

for some fun too.
He-he-he.
entries.CeruleanGymGuideWinText:
Hoo, you showed me
how tough you are.

As always, that
was one heck of a
great battle!

entries.CeruleanGymBadgeSpeechHousePokefanMText:
Are you collecting
KANTO GYM BADGES?

entries.CeruleanMart_CooltrainerMText:
You'll run into
many trainers on

the way to CERU-
LEAN's CAPE.

They want to see
how they stack

up against other
trainers.
entries.CeruleanMart_CooltrainerFText:
MISTY is about the
only person in

town who can beat
the trainers at
CERULEAN's CAPE.

entries.CeruleanPokecenter1FSuperNerdText:
For battles, I'd
much rather use

#MON I've been
raising, even if

they're weaker
than some newly
caught #MON.
entries.CeruleanPokecenter1FSuperNerdText_Mobile:
Do you battle by
mobile phone?

If time runs out
during a battle,

waiting to see who
won is really
nerve wracking.
entries.CeruleanPokecenter1FGymGuideText:
The MAGNET TRAIN
travels at over

340 mph. It goes
between KANTO and

JOHTO in almost no
time at all.

It really makes
JOHTO accessible.

entries.CeruleanPoliceStationFishingGuruText:
I heard that some
shady character is
skulking about.

I won't stand for
it if he turns out
to be a thief.
entries.CeruleanPoliceStationPokefanFText:
We were held up by
robbers before.

entries.CeruleanTradeSpeechHouseGrannyText:
My husband lives
happily with #-
MON he got through
trades.

entries.CharcoalKilnBossText1:
All the SLOWPOKE
have disappeared
from the town.

The forest's pro-
tector may be
angry with us…

It may be a bad
omen. We should
stay in.
entries.CharcoalKilnBossText2:
The SLOWPOKE have
returned…

But my APPRENTICE
hasn't come back
from ILEX FOREST.

Where in the world
is that lazy guy?
entries.CharcoalKilnBossText3:
You chased off
TEAM ROCKET and

went to ILEX
FOREST alone?

That takes guts!
I like that. Come
train with us.
entries.CharcoalKilnApprenticeText1:
Where have all the
SLOWPOKE gone?

Are they out play-
ing somewhere?
entries.CharcoalKilnApprenticeText2:
I'm sorry--I for-
got to thank you.

This is CHARCOAL
that I made.

Fire-type #MON
would be happy to
hold that.
entries.CharcoalKilnApprenticeText3:
The SLOWPOKE came
back, and you even
found FARFETCH'D.

You're the cool-
est, man!

entries.GuideGentIntroText:
You're a rookie
trainer, aren't
you? I can tell!

That's OK! Every-
one is a rookie
at some point!

If you'd like, I
can teach you a
few things.
entries.GuideGentPokecenterText:
This is a #MON
CENTER. They heal

your #MON in no
time at all.

You'll be relying
on them a lot, so

you better learn
about them.
entries.GuideGentMartText:
This is a #MON
MART.

They sell BALLS
for catching wild

#MON and other
useful items.
entries.GuideGentRoute30Text:
ROUTE 30 is out
this way.

Trainers will be
battling their

prized #MON
there.
entries.GuideGentSeaText:
This is the sea,
as you can see.

Some #MON are
found only in
water.
entries.GuideGentGiftText:
Here…

It's my house!
Thanks for your
company.

Let me give you a
small gift.
entries.GuideGentPokegearText:
#GEAR becomes
more useful as you
add CARDS.

I wish you luck on
your journey!
entries.GuideGentNoText:
Oh… It's something
I enjoy doing…

Fine. Come see me
when you like.
entries.CherrygroveRivalText_Seen:
<……> <……> <……>

You got a #MON
at the LAB.

What a waste.
A wimp like you.

<……> <……> <……>

Don't you get what
I'm saying?

Well, I too, have
a good #MON.

I'll show you
what I mean!
entries.RivalCherrygroveWinText:
Humph. Are you
happy you won?
entries.CherrygroveRivalText_YouLost:
<……> <……> <……>

My name's ???.

I'm going to be
the world's great-
est #MON
trainer.
entries.RivalCherrygroveLossText:
Humph. That was a
waste of time.
entries.CherrygroveRivalText_YouWon:
<……> <……> <……>

My name's ???.

I'm going to be
the world's great-
est #MON
trainer.
entries.CherrygroveTeacherText_NoMapCard:
Did you talk to
the old man by the
#MON CENTER?

He'll put a MAP of
JOHTO on your
#GEAR.
entries.CherrygroveTeacherText_HaveMapCard:
When you're with
#MON, going
anywhere is fun.
entries.CherrygroveYoungsterText_NoPokedex:
MR.#MON's house
is still farther
up ahead.
entries.CherrygroveYoungsterText_HavePokedex:
I battled the
trainers on the
road.

My #MON lost.
They're a mess! I

must take them to
a #MON CENTER.
entries.MysticWaterGuyTextBefore:
A #MON I caught
had an item.

I think it's
MYSTIC WATER.

I don't need it,
so do you want it?
entries.MysticWaterGuyTextAfter:
Back to fishing
for me, then.
entries.CherrygroveCitySignText:
CHERRYGROVE CITY

The City of Cute,
Fragrant Flowers

entries.CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouseYoungster:
#MON gain expe-
rience in battle

and change their
form.
entries.CherrygroveEvolutionSpeechHouseLassText:
#MON change?

I would be shocked
if one did that!

entries.CherrygroveGymSpeechHousePokefanMText:
You're trying to
see how good you

are as a #MON
trainer?

You better visit
the #MON GYMS

all over JOHTO and
collect BADGES.
entries.CherrygroveGymSpeechHouseBugCatcherText:
When I get older,
I'm going to be a
GYM LEADER!

I make my #MON
battle with my

friend's to make
them tougher!

entries.CherrygroveMartCooltrainerMText:
They're fresh out
of # BALLS!

When will they get
more of them?
entries.CherrygroveMartCooltrainerMText_PokeBall:
# BALLS are in
stock! Now I can
catch #MON!
entries.CherrygroveMartYoungsterText:
When I was walking
in the grass, a

bug #MON poi-
soned my #MON!

I just kept going,
but then my
#MON fainted.

You should keep an
ANTIDOTE with you.

entries.CherrygrovePokecenter1FFisherText:
It's great. I can
store any number

of #MON, and
it's all free.
entries.CherrygrovePokecenter1FGentlemanText:
That PC is free
for any trainer
to use.
entries.CherrygrovePokecenter1FTeacherText:
The COMMUNICATION
CENTER upstairs
was just built.

But they're still
finishing it up.
entries.CherrygrovePokecenter1FTeacherText_CommC:
The COMMUNICATION
CENTER upstairs
was just built.

I traded #MON
there already!

entries.ChucksWifeEasierToFlyText:
You crossed the
sea to get here?

That must have
been hard.

It would be much
easier if your

#MON knew how
to FLY…
entries.ChucksWifeBeatChuckText:
But you can't use
FLY without this
city's GYM BADGE.

If you beat the
GYM LEADER here,
come see me.

I'll have a nice
gift for you.
entries.ChucksWifeGiveHMText:
That's CIANWOOD's
GYM BADGE!

Then you should
take this HM.
entries.ChucksWifeFlySpeechText:
Teach FLY to your
#MON.

You will be able
to FLY instantly

to anywhere you 
have visited.
entries.ChucksWifeChubbyText:
My husband lost to
you, so he needs
to train harder.

That's good, since
he was getting a
little chubby.
entries.CianwoodCityYoungsterText:
If you use FLY,
you can get back

to OLIVINE in-
stantly.
entries.CianwoodCityPokefanMText:
Boulders to the
north of town can
be crushed.

They may be hiding
something.

Your #MON could
use ROCK SMASH to
break them.
entries.CianwoodCityLassText:
CHUCK, the GYM
LEADER, spars with

his fighting #-
MON.
entries.CianwoodCityUnusedText:
There are several
islands between
here and OLIVINE.

A mythical sea
creature supposed-
ly lives there.
entries.EusineSuicuneText:
EUSINE: Yo,
<PLAYER>.

Wasn't that
SUICUNE just now?

I only caught a
quick glimpse, but

I thought I saw
SUICUNE running on
the waves.

SUICUNE is beau-
tiful and grand.

And it races
through towns and

roads at simply
awesome speeds.

It's wonderful…

I want to see
SUICUNE up close…

I've decided.

I'll battle you as
a trainer to earn
SUICUNE's respect!

Come on, <PLAYER>.
Let's battle now!
entries.EusineBeatenText:
I hate to admit
it, but you win.
entries.EusineAfterText:
You're amazing,
<PLAYER>!

No wonder #MON
gravitate to you.

I get it now.

I'm going to keep
searching for
SUICUNE.

I'm sure we'll see
each other again.

See you around!
entries.CianwoodCitySignText:
CIANWOOD CITY

A Port Surrounded
by Rough Seas
entries.CianwoodGymSignText:
CIANWOOD CITY
#MON GYM

LEADER: CHUCK

His Roaring Fists
Do the Talking
entries.CianwoodPharmacySignText:
500 Years of
Tradition

CIANWOOD CITY
PHARMACY

We Await Your
Medicinal Queries
entries.CianwoodPhotoStudioSignText:
CIANWOOD CITY
PHOTO STUDIO

Take a Snapshot as
a Keepsake!

entries.ChuckIntroText1:
WAHAHAH!

So you've come
this far!

Let me tell you,
I'm tough!

My #MON will
crush stones and
shatter bones!

Watch this!
entries.ChuckIntroText3:
There! Scared now,
are you?

What?
It has nothing to

do with #MON?
That's true!

Come on. We shall
do battle!
entries.ChuckLossText:
Wha? Huh?
I lost?

How about that!
You're worthy of
STORMBADGE!
entries.ChuckExplainBadgeText:
STORMBADGE makes
all #MON up to

L70 obey, even
traded ones.

It also lets your
#MON use FLY

when you're not in
a battle.

Here, take this
too!
entries.ChuckExplainTMText:
That is DYNAMIC-
PUNCH.

It doesn't always
hit, but when it

does, it causes
confusion!
entries.ChuckAfterText:
WAHAHAH! I enjoyed
battling you!

But a loss is a
loss!

From now on, I'm
going to train 24
hours a day!
entries.BlackbeltYoshiSeenText:
My #MON and I
are bound togeth-
er by friendship.

Our bond will
never be broken!
entries.BlackbeltYoshiAfterText:
You seem to have a
strong bond with
your #MON too!
entries.BlackbeltLaoAfterText:
Fighting #MON
are afraid of psy-
chics…
entries.BlackbeltNobSeenText:
Words are useless.
Let your fists do
the talking!
entries.BlackbeltLungSeenText:
My raging fists
will shatter your
#MON!
entries.BlackbeltLungAfterText:
My #MON lost…
My… my pride is
shattered…

entries.CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTeacherText:
You came from
OLIVINE?

Do you remember
the four islands
along the way?

I heard that a 
mythical sea crea-
ture is hiding in
them.
entries.CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseLassText:
I heard that you
can only see it if

you have a SILVER
WING.

It must have the
same scent as the
creature.
entries.CianwoodLugiaSpeechHouseTwinText:
I've heard that
the whirlpools

around the islands
are caused by the
sea creature.

You might need a
special move to
get past them.

entries.PharmacistGiveSecretpotionText:
Your #MON ap-
pear to be fine.

Is something wor- 
rying you?

…

The LIGHTHOUSE
#MON is in
trouble?

I got it!

This ought to do
the trick.
entries.PharmacistDescribeSecretpotionText:
My SECRETPOTION is
a tad too strong.

I only offer it in
an emergency.

entries.CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_Quest:
You have magnifi-
cent #MON with
you.

How about a photo
for a souvenir?
entries.CianwoodPhotoStudioFishingGuruText_No:
Oh, that's too
bad. I thought it

would be a great
memento…

entries.CianwoodPokecenter1FLassText:
Did you meet the
#MANIAC?

He's always brag-
ging about his
rare #MON.
entries.CianwoodGymGuideText:
The #MON GYM
trainers here are
macho bullies.

If I stick around,
they might come
after me.

Here's some ad-
vice: the GYM

LEADER uses the
fighting-type.

So you should
confound him with
psychic #MON.

Wipe out his #-
MON before they

can use their
physical strength.

And those boulders
in the middle of
the GYM?

If you don't move
them correctly,

you won't reach
the GYM LEADER.

If you get stuck,
go outside.
entries.CianwoodGymGuideWinText:
<PLAYER>! You won!
I could tell by
looking at you!
entries.CianwoodPokecenter1FUnusedText1:
Don't you get the
urge to show off

your #MON to
friends?

I wish I could
show the #MON I

raised to my pal
in VIOLET.
entries.CianwoodPokecenter1FUnusedText2:
I've been battling
my pal in VIOLET

using a MOBILE
ADAPTER link.

I'm down 5-7
against him. I've
gotta crank it up!
entries.CianwoodPokecenter1FSuperNerdText:
I love showing off
the #MON that

I've raised.
Don't you?

I'm going to get
into a bunch of

battles, and show
off my #MON!

entries.CinnabarIslandBlueText:
Who are you?

Well, it's plain
to see that you're
a trainer…

My name's BLUE.

I was once the
CHAMPION, although

it was for only a
short time…

That meddling RED
did me in…

Anyway, what do
you want? You want

to challenge me or
something?

…I hate to say
it, but I'm not in

the mood for a
battle now.

Take a good look
around you…

A volcano erupts,
and just like

that, a whole town
disappears.

We can go on win-
ning and losing in

#MON. But if
nature so much as

twitches, we can
lose in a second.

…

That's the way it
is…

But, anyway, I'm
still a trainer.

If I see a strong
opponent, it makes
me want to battle.

If you want to
battle me, come to
the VIRIDIAN GYM.

I'll take you on
then.
entries.CinnabarIslandGymSignText:
There's a notice
here…

CINNABAR GYM has
relocated to SEA-
FOAM ISLANDS.

BLAINE
entries.CinnabarIslandSignText:
CINNABAR ISLAND

The Fiery Town of
Burning Desire

entries.CinnabarPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
CINNABAR GYM's
BLAINE apparently

lives alone in the
SEAFOAM ISLANDS
cave…
entries.CinnabarPokecenter1FFisherText:
It's been a year
since the volcano
erupted.

entries.CopycatsHouse1FPokefanMText:
My daughter likes
to mimic people.

Her mimicry has
earned her the

nickname COPYCAT
around here.
entries.CopycatsHouse1FPokefanFText:
My daughter is so
self-centered…

She only has a few
friends.
entries.CopycatsHouse1FPokefanFText_ReturnedMach:
She recently lost
the # DOLL that

a boy gave her
three years ago.

Ever since then,
she's gotten even
better at mimicry…

entries.CopycatText_Male_1:
<PLAYER>: Hi! Do
you like #MON?

<PLAYER>: Uh, no, I
just asked you.

<PLAYER>: Huh?
You're strange!
entries.CopycatText_QuickMimicking:
COPYCAT: Hmm?
Quit mimicking?

But that's my
favorite hobby!
entries.CopycatText_Male_2:
<PLAYER>: Hi!
I heard that you

lost your favorite
# DOLL.

<PLAYER>: If I find
it, you'll give me
a rail PASS?

<PLAYER>: I'll go
find it for you.

You think you lost
it when you went
to VERMILION CITY?
entries.CopycatText_Worried:
COPYCAT: Pardon?

I shouldn't decide
what you should
do?

But I'm really
worried… What if
someone finds it?
entries.CopycatText_GiveDoll:
COPYCAT: Yay!
That's my CLEFAIRY
# DOLL!

See the tear where
the right leg is

sewn on? That's
proof!
entries.CopycatText_GivePass:
OK. Here's the
MAGNET TRAIN PASS
like I promised!
entries.CopycatText_ExplainPass:
COPYCAT: That's
the PASS for the
MAGNET TRAIN.

The rail company
man gave me that

when they tore
down our old house
for the STATION.
entries.CopycatText_Male_3:
<PLAYER>: Hi!
Thanks a lot for
the rail PASS!

<PLAYER>: Pardon?

<PLAYER>: Is it
that fun to mimic
my every move?
entries.CopycatText_ItsAScream:
COPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!
entries.CopycatText_Female_1:
<PLAYER>: Hi. You
must like #MON.

<PLAYER>: No, not
me. I asked you.

<PLAYER>: Pardon?
You're weird!
entries.CopycatText_Female_2:
<PLAYER>: Hi. Did
you really lose
your # DOLL?

<PLAYER>: You'll
really give me a

rail PASS if I
find it for you?

<PLAYER>: Sure,
I'll look for it!

You think you lost
it when you were
in VERMILION?
entries.CopycatText_Female_3:
<PLAYER>: Thank you
for the rail PASS!

<PLAYER>: …Pardon?

<PLAYER>: Is it
really that fun to

copy what I say
and do?
entries.CopycatsDodrioText2:
MIRROR, MIRROR ON
THE WALL, WHO'S

THE FAIREST ONE OF
ALL?
entries.CopycatsHouse2FDollText:
This is a rare
#MON! Huh?

It's only a doll…

entries.KimonoGirlNaokoSeenText:
You have lovely
#MON. May I see
them in battle?
entries.KimonoGirlNaokoAfterBattleText:
I enjoyed that
bout. I would like
to see you again.
entries.KimonoGirlSayoSeenText:
I always dance
with my #MON.

Of course, I also
train them.
entries.KimonoGirlSayoBeatenText:
Oh, so close!
I almost had you.
entries.KimonoGirlSayoAfterBattleText:
Rhythm is impor-
tant for both

dancing and #-
MON.
entries.KimonoGirlZukiSeenText:
Isn't my barrette
pretty?

Oh. A #MON
battle?
entries.KimonoGirlZukiAfterBattleText:
I put a different
flower in my bar-
rette every month.
entries.KimonoGirlKuniSeenText:
Oh, you're a cute
trainer. Would you
like to battle?
entries.KimonoGirlKuniAfterBattleText:
I trained a lot,
so I thought I was

a capable trainer.
I guess I'm not.
entries.KimonoGirlMikiSeenText:
Do you like my
dancing? I'm good
at #MON too.
entries.KimonoGirlMikiAfterBattleText:
I can keep dancing
because there are

people who enjoy
what I do.

My #MON keep my
spirits up too.
entries.SurfGuyNeverLeftAScratchText:
Not only are the
KIMONO GIRLS great

dancers, they're
also skilled at
#MON.

I always challenge
them, but I've

never even left a
scratch…
entries.SurfGuyLadGiftText:
Lad! If you can
defeat all the

KIMONO GIRLS, I'll
give you a gift.
entries.SurfGuyLassieGiftText:
Lassie, if you can
defeat all the

KIMONO GIRLS, I'll
give you a gift.
entries.SurfGuyLikeADanceText:
The way you bat-
tled, it was like
watching a dance.

It was a rare
treat to see!

I want you to have
this. Don't worry
--take it!
entries.SurfGuySurfExplanationText:
That's SURF.

It's a move that
lets #MON swim
across water.
entries.SurfGuyElegantKimonoGirlsText:
I wish my #MON
were as elegant as
the KIMONO GIRLS…
entries.DanceTheaterCooltrainerMText:
That man's always
with his RHYDON.

Says he wants a
#MON that can
SURF and dance.

Is he trying to
make a synchro-
nized swimming
#MON?
entries.DanceTheaterGrannyText:
The KIMONO GIRLS
are so beautiful…

But they have to
go through rigor-
ous training.

And they have to
learn to follow

customs before ap-
pearing in public.

But if you love
something, any-
thing is possible.
entries.DanceTheaterFancyPanelText:
It's a fancy panel
that's decorated
with flowers.

entries.DarkCaveBlackthornEntrancePharmacistText:
Whoa! You startled
me there!

I had my BLACK-
GLASSES on, so I

didn't notice you
at all.

What am I doing
here?

Hey, don't you
worry about it.

I'll give you a
pair of BLACK-
GLASSES, so forget
you saw me, OK?

BLACKGLASSES ups
the power of dark-
type moves.

entries.Text_DayCareManTalksAboutEggTicket:
I'm the DAY-CARE
MAN.

There's something
new in GOLDENROD

called the TRADE
CORNER.

I was given an EGG
TICKET that can be

traded in for a
ODD EGG.

But since we run a
DAY-CARE, we don't

need it. You may
as well have it.
entries.DayCareManText_GiveOddEgg:
I'm the DAY-CARE
MAN.

Do you know about
EGGS?

I was raising
#MON with my
wife, you see.

We were shocked to
find an EGG!

How incredible is
that?

Well, wouldn't you
like this EGG?

Then fine, this is
yours to keep!
entries.DayCareText_DescribeOddEgg:
I found that when
I was caring for

someone's #MON
before.

But the trainer
didn't want the

EGG, so I'd kept
it around.

entries.DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText1:
There's something
written here.

Read it?
entries.DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText2:
To my brothers and
sisters:

We take pride in
serving #MON
trainers.

When trainers talk
to you, give them
something useful.

Love,
MONICA

Keep reading?
entries.DayOfWeekSiblingsHousePokedexText3:
Monday, MONICA
ROUTE 40

Tuesday, TUSCANY
ROUTE 29

Wednesday, WESLEY
LAKE OF RAGE

Thursday, ARTHUR
ROUTE 36

Friday, FRIEDA
ROUTE 32

Saturday, SANTOS
BLACKTHORN CITY

Sunday, SUNNY
ROUTE 37

entries.DiglettsCavePokefanMText:
A bunch of DIGLETT
popped out of the

ground! That was
shocking.

entries.DragonShrineElderGreetingText:
Hm… Good to see
you here.

No need to explain
why you came.

CLAIR sent you
here, didn't she?

That girl is a
handful…

I am sorry, but I
must test you.

Not to worry, you
are to answer only
a few questions.

Ready?
entries.DragonShrineQuestion2Text:
What helps you to
win battles?
entries.DragonShrineQuestion3Text:
What kind of
trainer do you
wish to battle?
entries.DragonShrineQuestion4Text:
What is most
important for
raising #MON?
entries.DragonShrineQuestion5Text:
Strong #MON.
Weak #MON.

Which is more
important?
entries.DragonShrinePassedTestText:
Hm… I see…

You care deeply
for #MON.

Very commendable.

That conviction is
what is important!

<PLAYER>, don't
lose that belief.

It will see you
through at the
#MON LEAGUE.
entries.DragonShrineMustIInformLanceText:
CLAIR!

This child is
impeccable, in
skill and spirit!

Admit defeat and
confer the RISING-
BADGE!

…Or must I inform
LANCE of this?
entries.DragonShrineElderScoldsClairText:
CLAIR…

Reflect upon what
it is that you

lack and this
child has.
entries.DragonShrineComeAgainText:
Come again, if you
so desire.
entries.DragonShrineTakeThisDratiniText:
Hm… Good to see
you here.

Your arrival is
most fortunate.

I have something
for you.

Take this DRATINI
as proof that I

have recognized
your worth.
entries.DragonShrineSymbolicDragonText:
Dragon #MON are
symbolic of our
clan.

You have shown
that you can be

entrusted with
one.
entries.DragonShrineClairsGrandfatherText:
CLAIR appears to
have learned an

invaluable lesson
from you.

I thank you as her
grandfather.
entries.DragonShrineRivalIsInTrainingText:
A boy close to
your age is in
training here.

He is much like
CLAIR when she was

younger. It is a
little worrisome…
entries.DragonShrineWrongAnswerText1:
Hah? I didn't
quite catch that…
entries.DragonShrineElder2Text:
It's been quite
some time since a

trainer has gained
our MASTER's rare
approval.

In fact, not since
Master LANCE.
entries.DragonShrineElder3Text:
You know young
Master LANCE?

He looks so much
like our MASTER
did in his youth.

It's in their
blood.
entries.DragonShrineClairYouPassedText:
So how did it go?

I guess there's no
point in asking.

You did fail?

<……><……><……><……><……><……>

…What? You passed?
entries.DragonShrineClairYoureLyingText:
You're lying!

Even I haven't
been approved!
entries.DragonShrineHereRisingBadgeText:
Here, this is the
RISINGBADGE…

Hurry up! Take it!
entries.DragonShrineRisingBadgeExplanationText:
RISINGBADGE will
enable your

#MON to use the
move for climbing
waterfalls.

Also, all #MON
will recognize you

as a trainer and
obey your every

command without
question.

entries.ClairText_GiveDragonbreathDragonDen:
CLAIR: I'm sorry
about this.

Here, take this as
my apology.
entries.ClairText_DescribeDragonbreathDragonDen:
That contains
DRAGONBREATH.

No, it doesn't
have anything to
do with my breath.

If you don't want
it, you don't have
to take it.
entries.ClairText_NoRoom:
Oh? You don't have
any room for this.

I'm going back to
the GYM, so make

room, then come
see me there.
entries.ClairText_WhatsTheMatterDragonDen:
CLAIR: What's the
matter? Aren't you

going on to the
#MON LEAGUE?

Do you know how to
get there?

From here, go to
NEW BARK TOWN.

Then SURF east to
#MON LEAGUE.

The route there is
very tough.

Don't you dare
lose at the #-
MON LEAGUE!

If you do, I'll
feel even worse

about having lost
to you!

Give it everything
you've got.
entries.DragonShrineSignpostText:
DRAGON SHRINE

A shrine honoring
the dragon #MON

said to have lived
in DRAGON'S DEN.
entries.RivalText_Training1:
…
What? <PLAYER>?

…No, I won't
battle you now…

My #MON aren't
ready to beat you.

I can't push them
too hard now.

I have to be dis-
ciplined to become

the greatest #-
MON trainer…
entries.RivalText_Training2:
…

Whew…

Learn to stay out
of my way…
entries.CooltrainermDarinSeenText:
You! How dare you
enter uninvited!
entries.CooltrainermDarinAfterBattleText:
The SHRINE ahead
is home to the

MASTER of our
dragon-user clan.

You're not allowed
to just go in!
entries.CooltrainerfCaraAfterBattleText:
Soon I'm going to
get permission

from our MASTER to
use dragons.

When I do, I'm
going to become an

admirable dragon
trainer and gain

our MASTER's
approval.
entries.TwinsLeaandpia1SeenText:
It's a stranger we
don't know.
entries.TwinsLeaandpia1AfterBattleText:
It was like having
to battle LANCE.
entries.TwinsLeaandpia2AfterBattleText:
We'll tell on you.

MASTER will be
angry with you.
entries.Text_NoRoomForDragonFang:
But <PLAYER> can't
carry any more
items.

entries.AcademyEarlIntroText:
EARL, I am!

Wonderful are
#MON, yes!

Teach you I will
to be a better
trainer!

What you want to
know? Want to be
a winner is you?
entries.AcademyEarlTeachHowToWinText:
Good! Teach you,
I will!

In battle, #MON
top on list jump
out first!

Change order in
list, make battle
easy, maybe!

More from me you
want to hear?
entries.AcademyEarlTeachMoreText:
So, want to know
how to raise
#MON well?
entries.AcademyEarlTeachHowToRaiseWellText:
Fine! Teach you,
I will!

If #MON come
out in battle even

briefly, some EXP.
Points it gets.

At top of list put
weak #MON.

Switch in battle
quick!

This way, weak
#MON strong
become!
entries.AcademyEarlNoMoreToTeachText:
Oh! Smart student
you are! Nothing
more do I teach!

Good to #MON
you must be!
entries.EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster1Text:
I'm taking notes
of the teacher's
lecture.

I'd better copy
the stuff on the
blackboard too.
entries.EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid1Text:
I traded my best
#MON to the
guy beside me.
entries.EarlsPokemonAcademyGameboyKid2Text:
Huh? The #MON I
just got is hold-
ing something!
entries.EarlsPokemonAcademyYoungster2Text:
A #MON holding
a BERRY will heal
itself in battle.

Many other items
can be held by
#MON…

It sure is tough
taking notes…
entries.AcademyBlackboardText:
The blackboard
describes #MON

status changes in
battle.
entries.AcademyPoisonText:
If poisoned, a
#MON steadily
loses HP.

Poison lingers
after the battle,

and HP is lost as
you walk.

To cure it, use an
ANTIDOTE.
entries.AcademyParalysisText:
Paralysis reduces
speed and may
prevent movement.

It remains after
battle, so use
a PARLYZ HEAL.
entries.AcademySleepText:
If asleep, your
#MON can't make
a move.

A sleeping #MON
doesn't wake up
after battle.

Wake it up with
an AWAKENING.
entries.AcademyBurnText:
A burn steadily
consumes HP.

It also reduces
attack power.

A burn lingers
after battle.

Use a BURN HEAL as
the cure.
entries.AcademyFreezeText:
If your #MON is
frozen, it can't
do a thing.

It remains frozen
after battle.

Thaw it out with
an ICE HEAL.
entries.AcademyNotebookText:
It's this kid's
notebook…

Catch #MON
using # BALLS.

Up to six can be
in your party.

Keep reading?
entries.AcademyNotebookText1:
Before throwing a
# BALL, weaken
the target first.

A poisoned or
burned #MON is
easier to catch.

Keep reading?
entries.AcademyNotebookText2:
Some moves may
cause confusion.

Confusion may make
a #MON attack
itself.

Leaving battle
clears up any
confusion.

Keep reading?
entries.AcademyNotebookText3:
People who catch
and use #MON

in battle are
#MON trainers.

They are expected
to visit #MON

GYMS and defeat
other trainers.

The next page
is… Blank!

Boy: E-he-he…

I haven't written
anymore…
entries.AcademyStickerMachineText:
This super machine
prints data out as

stickers!

entries.UnusedMissingDaughterText:
Oh, no. Oh, no…

My daughter is
missing.

No… She couldn't
have gone to the
BURNED TOWER.

I told her not to
go near it…

People seem to
disappear there…

Oh, what should I
do…?
entries.EcruteakCityGramps1Text:
ECRUTEAK used to
have two towers:

one each in the
east and west.
entries.EcruteakCityGramps2Text:
Ah, child.
Have you learned

to dance like the
KIMONO GIRLS?

If you go to their
DANCE THEATER, an

odd old man will
give you something
nice, I hear.
entries.EcruteakCityLass1Text:
I'm going to prac-
tice at the DANCE

THEATER. Care to
join me?
entries.EcruteakCityLass2Text:
The tower that
used to be here…

My grandma told me
it used to be much
taller.
entries.EcruteakCityLass2Text_ReleasedBeasts:
Three big #MON
ran off in differ-
ent directions.
What were they?
entries.EcruteakCityFisherText:
I heard a rumor
about OLIVINE
LIGHTHOUSE.

The #MON that
serves as the

beacon fell ill.
Sounds like they
are in trouble.
entries.EcruteakCityFisherText_JasmineReturned:
The #MON at
OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE
has been cured.

Boats can safely
sail out to sea at
night again.
entries.EcruteakCityYoungsterText:
I hear #MON are
rampaging at the

LAKE OF RAGE. I'd
like to see that.
entries.EcruteakCityGramps3Text:
In the distant
past…

This tower burned
in a fire. Three

nameless #MON
perished in it.

A rainbow-colored
#MON descended

from the sky and
resurrected them…

It's a legend that
has been passed

down by ECRUTEAK
GYM LEADERS.

Me?

I was a trainer
way back when.
Hohoho!
entries.EcruteakCitySignText:
ECRUTEAK CITY
A Historical City

Where the Past
Meets the Present
entries.TinTowerSignText:
TIN TOWER

A legendary #-
MON is said to
roost here.
entries.EcruteakGymSignText:
ECRUTEAK CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: MORTY

The Mystic Seer of
the Future
entries.BurnedTowerSignText:
BURNED TOWER

It was destroyed
by a mysterious
fire.

Please stay away,
as it is unsafe.

entries.MortyIntroText:
Good of you to
have come.

Here in ECRUTEAK,
#MON have been
revered.

It's said that a
rainbow-colored

#MON will come
down to appear

before a truly
powerful trainer.

I believed that
tale, so I have

secretly trained
here all my life.

As a result, I can
now see what
others cannot.

Just a bit more…

With a little
more, I could see

a future in which
I meet the #MON
of rainbow colors.

You're going to
help me reach that
level!
entries.MortyWinLossText:
I'm not good
enough yet…

All right. This
BADGE is yours.
entries.MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech:
By having FOG-
BADGE, #MON up

to L50 will obey
you.

Also, #MON that
know SURF will be

able to use that
move anytime.

I want you to have
this too.
entries.MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech:
It's SHADOW BALL.
It causes damage

and may reduce
SPCL.DEF.

Use it if it
appeals to you.
entries.MortyFightDoneText:
I see…

Your journey has
taken you to far-
away places.

And you have wit-
nessed much more
than I.

I envy you for
that…
entries.SageJeffreySeenText:
I spent the spring
with my #MON.

Then summer, fall
and winter…

Then spring came
again. We have

lived together
for a long time.
entries.SageJeffreyBeatenText:
Wins and losses, I
experienced both.
entries.SagePingSeenText:
Can you inflict
any damage on our
#MON?
entries.SagePingAfterBattleText:
We use only ghost-
type #MON.

No normal-type
attack can harm
them!
entries.MediumMarthaAfterBattleText:
The one who wants
to win most--will!
entries.MediumGraceSeenText:
Stumped by our in-
visible floor?

Defeat me if you
want a hint!
entries.MediumGraceAfterBattleText:
Fine. I shall tell
you the secret of

the invisible
floor.

The path is right
before our eyes!
entries.EcruteakGymGuideText:
The trainers here
have secret mo-
tives.

If you win, they
may tell you some

deep secrets about
ECRUTEAK.
entries.EcruteakGymGuideWinText:
Whew, <PLAYER>.
You did great!

I was cowering in
the corner out of
pure terror!
entries.EcruteakGymClosedText:
MORTY, the GYM
LEADER, is absent.

Sorry, but you'll
have to leave.

Hohohoho.

entries.EcruteakItemfinderAdventureText:
Ah. You're on an
adventure with
your #MON?

Well, what's an
adventure without
treasure hunting?

Am I right, or am
I right?
entries.EcruteakItemfinderTrueSpiritText:
Good! You under-
stand the true

spirit of adven-
ture.

I like that! Take
this with you.
entries.ItemfinderExplanationText:
There are many
items lying about

that aren't ob-
vious.

Use ITEMFINDER to
check if there is

an item on the
ground near you.

It doesn't show
the exact spot,

so you'll have to
look yourself.

Oh yeah--I heard
there are items

in ECRUTEAK's
BURNED TOWER.
entries.EcruteakItemfinderToEachHisOwnText:
Oh… To each his
own, I suppose…
entries.EcruteakHistoryBookText:
HISTORY OF
ECRUTEAK

Want to read it?
entries.EcruteakTwoTowersText:
In ECRUTEAK, there
were two towers.

Each tower was the
roost of powerful
flying #MON.

But one of the
towers burned to
the ground.

The two #MON
haven't been seen
since…

Keep reading?
entries.EcruteakThreeMonText:
ECRUTEAK was also
home to three

#MON that raced
around the town.

They were said to
have been born of

water, lightning
and fire.

But they could not
contain their
excessive power.

So they say the
three ran like the

wind off into the
grassland.

entries.EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouseGrampsText:
This happened when
I was young.

The sky suddenly
turned black. A

giant flying #-
MON was blocking
out the sun.

I wonder what that
#MON was? 

It was like a bird
and a dragon.
entries.EcruteakLugiaSpeechHouseYoungsterText:
Is there really a
#MON that big?

If it exists, it
must be powerful.

entries.EcruteakMartSuperNerdText:
My EEVEE evolved
into an ESPEON.

But my friend's
EEVEE turned into
an UMBREON.

I wonder why? We
both were raising

our EEVEE in the
same way…
entries.EcruteakMartGrannyText:
If you use REVIVE,
a #MON that's

fainted will wake
right up.

entries.EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText1:
Hi, I'm BILL. And
who are you?

Hmm, <PLAYER>, huh?
You've come at the
right time.
entries.EcruteakPokecenter1F_BillText2:
I just finished
adjustments on my
TIME CAPSULE.

You know that
#MON can be
traded, right?

My TIME CAPSULE
was developed to

enable trades with
the past.

But you can't send
anything that

didn't exist in
the past.

If you did, the PC
in the past would
have a breakdown.

So you have to
remove anything

that wasn't around
in the past.

Put simply, no
sending new moves

or new #MON in
the TIME CAPSULE.

Don't you worry.
I'm done with the
adjustments.

Tomorrow, TIME
CAPSULES will be

running at all
#MON CENTERS.

I have to hurry on
back to GOLDENROD
and see my folks.

Buh-bye!
entries.EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMText:
The way the KIMONO
GIRLS dance is

marvelous. Just
like the way they
use their #MON.
entries.EcruteakPokecenter1FPokefanMTextMobile:
You must be hoping
to battle more

people, right?
There's apparently

some place where
trainers gather.

Where, you ask?

It's a little past
OLIVINE CITY.
entries.EcruteakPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
MORTY, the GYM
LEADER, is soooo
cool.

His #MON are
really tough too.
entries.EcruteakPokecenter1FGymGuideText:
LAKE OF RAGE…

The appearance of
a GYARADOS swarm…

I smell a conspir-
acy. I know it!

entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText:
TIN TOWER is off
limits to anyone

without ECRUTEAK
GYM's BADGE.

Sorry, but you'll
have to leave.
entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_GotFogB:
TIN TOWER is off
limits to anyone

without ECRUTEAK
GYM's BADGE.

Ah!

ECRUTEAK's GYM
BADGE! Please, go
right through.
entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_NoClear:
A momentous event
has occurred.

I beg your pardon,
but I must ask you
to leave.

…What soothes the
soul…

The WISE TRIO say
things that are so

very difficult to
understand…
entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_HearsCl:
A momentous event
has occurred.

I beg your pardon,
but I must ask you
to leave.

<……><……><……>

Ah!

The sound of that
CLEAR BELL!

It… It's sublime!

I've never heard
so beautiful a
sound before!

That bell's chime
is indicative of
the bearer's soul.

You…

You may be able to
make it through
TIN TOWER.

Please, do go on.
entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceSageText_HeardCl:
That bell's chime
is indicative of
the bearer's soul.

You…

You may be able to
make it through
TIN TOWER.

Please, do go on.
entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceWanderingSageTex:
The TIN TOWER
ahead is a nine-

tier tower of
divine beauty.

It soothes the
soul of all who
see it.

The TIN TOWER
shook! A #MON

must have returned
to the top!
entries.EcruteakTinTowerEntranceGrampsText:
Two towers…
Two #MON…

But when one
burned down, both

#MON flew away,
never to return.

entries.ElmsWifeText:
Hi, <PLAY_G>! My
husband's always

so busy--I hope
he's OK.

When he's caught
up in his #MON

research, he even
forgets to eat.
entries.ElmsSonText:
When I grow up,
I'm going to help
my dad!

I'm going to be a
great #MON
professor!
entries.ElmsHouseLabFoodText:
There's some food
here. It must be
for the LAB.
entries.ElmsHousePokemonFoodText:
There's some food
here. This must be
for #MON.
entries.ElmsHousePCText:
#MON. Where do
they come from? 

Where are they
going?

Why has no one
ever witnessed a
#MON's birth?

I want to know! I
will dedicate my

life to the study
of #MON!

…

It's a part of
PROF.ELM's re-
search papers.

entries.ElmText_Intro:
ELM: <PLAY_G>!
There you are!

I needed to ask
you a favor.

I'm conducting new
#MON research

right now. I was
wondering if you

could help me with
it, <PLAY_G>.

You see…

I'm writing a
paper that I want

to present at a
conference.

But there are some
things I don't

quite understand
yet.

So!

I'd like you to
raise a #MON

that I recently
caught.
entries.ElmText_Refused:
But… Please, I
need your help!
entries.ElmText_ResearchAmbitions:
When I announce my
findings, I'm sure

we'll delve a bit
deeper into the

many mysteries of
#MON.

You can count on
it!
entries.ElmText_GotAnEmail:
Oh, hey! I got an
e-mail!

<……><……><……>
Hm… Uh-huh…

Okay…
entries.ElmText_MissionFromMrPokemon:
Hey, listen.

I have an acquain-
tance called MR.
#MON.

He keeps finding
weird things and

raving about his
discoveries.

Anyway, I just got
an e-mail from him

saying that this
time it's real.

It is intriguing,
but we're busy

with our #MON
research…

Wait!

I know!

<PLAY_G>, can you
go in our place?
entries.ElmText_ChooseAPokemon:
I want you to
raise one of the

#MON contained
in these BALLS.

You'll be that
#MON's first
partner, <PLAY_G>!

Go on. Pick one!
entries.ElmText_LetYourMonBattleIt:
If a wild #MON
appears, let your
#MON battle it!
entries.LabWhereGoingText:
ELM: Wait! Where
are you going?
entries.TakeCyndaquilText:
ELM: You'll take
CYNDAQUIL, the
fire #MON?
entries.TakeTotodileText:
ELM: Do you want
TOTODILE, the
water #MON?
entries.TakeChikoritaText:
ELM: So, you like
CHIKORITA, the
grass #MON?
entries.DidntChooseStarterText:
ELM: Think it over
carefully.

Your partner is
important.
entries.ChoseStarterText:
ELM: I think
that's a great
#MON too!
entries.ElmDirectionsText1:
MR.#MON lives a
little bit beyond

CHERRYGROVE, the
next city over.

It's almost a
direct route

there, so you
can't miss it.

But just in case,
here's my phone

number. Call me if
anything comes up!
entries.ElmDirectionsText2:
If your #MON is
hurt, you should

heal it with this
machine.

Feel free to use
it anytime.
entries.ElmDescribesMrPokemonText:
MR.#MON goes
everywhere and
finds rarities.

Too bad they're
just rare and
not very useful…
entries.ElmPokeBallText:
It contains a
#MON caught by
PROF.ELM.
entries.ElmsLabHealingMachineText2:
Would you like to
heal your #MON?
entries.ElmAfterTheftText1:
ELM: <PLAY_G>, this
is terrible…

Oh, yes, what was
MR.#MON's big
discovery?
entries.ElmAfterTheftText2:
<PLAYER> handed
the MYSTERY EGG to
PROF.ELM.
entries.ElmAfterTheftText4:
But… Is it a
#MON EGG?

If it is, it is a
great discovery!
entries.ElmAfterTheftText5:
ELM: What?!?

PROF.OAK gave you
a #DEX?

<PLAY_G>, is that
true? Th-that's
incredible!

He is superb at
seeing the poten-
tial of people as
trainers.

Wow, <PLAY_G>. You
may have what it

takes to become
the CHAMPION.

You seem to be
getting on great
with #MON too.

You should take
the #MON GYM
challenge.

The closest GYM
would be the one
in VIOLET CITY.
entries.ElmAfterTheftText6:
…<PLAY_G>. The
road to the

championship will
be a long one.

Before you leave,
make sure that you
talk to your mom.
entries.ElmStudyingEggText:
ELM: Don't give
up! I'll call if

I learn anything
about that EGG!
entries.ElmAideHasEggText:
ELM: <PLAY_G>?
Didn't you meet my
assistant?

He should have met
you with the EGG

at VIOLET CITY's
#MON CENTER.

You must have just
missed him. Try to
catch him there.
entries.ElmWaitingEggHatchText:
ELM: Hey, has that
EGG changed any?
entries.ElmThoughtEggHatchedText:
<PLAY_G>? I thought
the EGG hatched.

Where is the
#MON?
entries.ShowElmTogepiText3:
The EGG hatched!
So, #MON are
born from EGGS…

No, perhaps not
all #MON are.

Wow, there's still
a lot of research
to be done.
entries.ElmGiveEverstoneText1:
Thanks, <PLAY_G>!
You're helping

unravel #MON
mysteries for us!

I want you to have
this as a token of
our appreciation.
entries.ElmGiveEverstoneText2:
That's an
EVERSTONE.

Some species of
#MON evolve

when they grow to
certain levels.

A #MON holding
the EVERSTONE
won't evolve.

Give it to a #-
MON you don't want
to evolve.
entries.ElmText_CallYou:
ELM: <PLAY_G>, I'll
call you if any-
thing comes up.
entries.AideText_AfterTheft:
…sigh… That
stolen #MON.

I wonder how it's
doing.

They say a #MON
raised by a bad

person turns bad
itself.
entries.ElmGiveMasterBallText1:
ELM: Hi, <PLAY_G>!
Thanks to you, my

research is going
great!

Take this as a
token of my
appreciation.
entries.ElmGiveMasterBallText2:
The MASTER BALL is
the best!

It's the ultimate
BALL! It'll catch

any #MON with-
out fail.

It's given only to
recognized #MON
researchers.

I think you can
make much better

use of it than I
can, <PLAY_G>!
entries.ElmGiveTicketText1:
ELM: <PLAY_G>!
There you are!

I called because I
have something for
you.

See? It's an
S.S.TICKET.

Now you can catch
#MON in KANTO.
entries.ElmGiveTicketText2:
The ship departs
from OLIVINE CITY.

But you knew that
already, <PLAY_G>.

After all, you've
traveled all over
with your #MON.

Give my regards to
PROF.OAK in KANTO!
entries.ElmsLabMonEggText:
It's the #MON
EGG being studied
by PROF.ELM.
entries.AideText_GiveYouPotion:
<PLAY_G>, I want
you to have this
for your errand.
entries.AideText_AlwaysBusy:
There are only two
of us, so we're
always busy.
entries.AideText_TheftTestimony:
There was a loud
noise outside…

When we went to
look, someone
stole a #MON.

It's unbelievable
that anyone would
do that!

…sigh… That
stolen #MON.

I wonder how it's
doing.

They say a #MON
raised by a bad

person turns bad
itself.
entries.AideText_ExplainBalls:
To add to your
#DEX, you have
to catch #MON.

Throw # BALLS
at wild #MON
to get them.
entries.ElmsLabOfficerText1:
I heard a #MON
was stolen here…

I was just getting
some information
from PROF.ELM.

Apparently, it was
a young male with
long, red hair…

What?

You battled a
trainer like that?

Did you happen to
get his name?
entries.ElmsLabOfficerText2:
OK! So <RIVAL>
was his name.

Thanks for helping
my investigation!
entries.ElmsLabWindowText1:
The window's open.

A pleasant breeze
is blowing in.
entries.ElmsLabTravelTip1Text:
<PLAYER> opened a
book.

Travel Tip 1:

Press START to
open the MENU.
entries.ElmsLabTravelTip2Text:
<PLAYER> opened a
book.

Travel Tip 2:

Record your trip
with SAVE!
entries.ElmsLabTravelTip3Text:
<PLAYER> opened a
book.

Travel Tip 3:

Open your PACK and
press SELECT to
move items.
entries.ElmsLabTravelTip4Text:
<PLAYER> opened a
book.

Travel Tip 4:

Check your #MON
moves. Press the

A Button to switch
moves.
entries.ElmsLabTrashcanText:
The wrapper from
the snack PROF.ELM
ate is in there…
entries.ElmsLabPCText:
OBSERVATIONS ON
#MON EVOLUTION

…It says on the
screen…

entries.FastShip1FSailor1Text_ToVermilion:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
is en route to
VERMILION CITY.

We will make an
announcement when
we arrive.
entries.FastShip1FSailor1Text_ToOlivine:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
is en route to
OLIVINE CITY.

We will make an
announcement when
we arrive.
entries.FastShip1FSailor2Text_FirstTime:
Here's your cabin.

If your #MON
are hurt, take a
nap in the bed.

That will heal
them.
entries.FastShip1FSailor2Text:
Here's your cabin.

You can heal your
#MON by taking
a nap in the bed.

The ship will
arrive while
you're sleeping.
entries.FastShip1FSailor3Text:
The passengers are
all trainers.

They're all itch-
ing to battle in
their cabins.
entries.FastShip1FGrandpaText:
Whoa! Excuse me.
I was in a hurry!

My granddaughter
is missing!

She's just a wee
girl. If you see

her, please let me
know!
entries.FastShip1FSailor1Text_InOlivine:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived in
OLIVINE CITY.
entries.FastShip1FSailor1Text_InVermilion:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived in
VERMILION CITY.

entries.FastShipB1FOnDutySailorText:
Hey, kid. Could I
get you to look
for my buddy?

He's goofing off
somewhere, that
lazy bum!

I want to go find
him, but I'm on
duty right now.
entries.FastShipB1FOnDutySailorRefusedText:
Oh, gee…

The CAPTAIN will
be furious…
entries.FastShipB1FOnDutySailorThanksText:
Thanks, kid!
I chewed him out

good so he'll quit
slacking off!
entries.FastShipB1FOnDutySailorSawLittleGirlText:
A little girl?

I may have seen
her go by here.
entries.FastShipB1FOnDutySailorDirectionsText:
The dining room is
up ahead.

The stairs at the
end lead to the
CAPTAIN's cabin.
entries.SailorJeffSeenText:
Nothing beats a
battle when I'm
on my break.
entries.SailorJeffBeatenText:
Win or lose, my
break's over!
entries.SailorJeffAfterBattleText:
I guess I can't
win if I don't get
serious.
entries.PicnickerDebraSeenText:
I'm so bored.
Want to battle?
entries.PicnickerDebraAfterBattleText:
SAFFRON, CELADON…
I hear there are

many big cities
in KANTO.
entries.JugglerFritzAfterBattleText:
No more ships for
me. Next time,

I'm taking the
MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.SailorGarrettSeenText:
This is where we
sailors work!
entries.SailorGarrettBeatenText:
I lost on my home
field…
entries.SailorGarrettAfterBattleText:
We get different
passengers from

VERMILION CITY to
OLIVINE CITY.
entries.FisherJonahSeenText:
Even though we're
out on the sea, I
can't fish!

This is boring!
Let's battle!
entries.FisherJonahAfterBattleText:
I plan to fish off
VERMILION's pier.
entries.BlackbeltWaiSeenText:
I'm building up my
legs by bracing

against the ship's
rocking!
entries.BlackbeltWaiAfterBattleText:
I couldn't find
the KARATE KING in
JOHTO.

He's supposed to
be training in a
cave somewhere.
entries.SailorKennethSeenText:
I'm a sailor man!

But I'm training
#MON, so I can
become the CHAMP!
entries.SailorKennethBeatenText:
My lack of train-
ing is obvious…
entries.SailorKennethAfterBattleText:
Eight BADGES!
They must prove

that you've beaten
GYM LEADERS.

No wonder you're
so good!
entries.TeacherShirleySeenText:
Don't lay a finger
on my students!
entries.TeacherShirleyAfterBattleText:
We're on a field
trip to the RUINS
outside VIOLET.
entries.SchoolboyNateSeenText:
Do you know the
RUINS OF ALPH?
entries.SchoolboyNateAfterBattleText:
Radios pick up
strange signals
inside the RUINS.
entries.SchoolboyRickySeenText:
There are some odd
stone panels in
the RUINS OF ALPH.
entries.SchoolboyRickyAfterBattleText:
I read that there
are four of those
stone panels.

entries.CooltrainermSeanSeenText:
I'm going to KANTO
to test my skills.
entries.CooltrainermSeanAfterBattleText:
Trainers from
JOHTO can battle

with KANTO GYM
LEADERS.
entries.CooltrainerfCarolSeenText:
I'm training to
become the CHAMP!
entries.CooltrainerfCarolBeatenText:
What's so differ-
ent between us?
entries.CooltrainerfCarolAfterBattleText:
I'm going to beat
you someday!
entries.PokemaniacEthanSeenText:
Do you know LILY?
She's a hot DJ in
KANTO.
entries.PokemaniacEthanAfterBattleText:
LILY's nice, but
MARY's the best!

I want to check
out JOHTO's radio
programs!
