entries.HikerNolandSeenText:
Are you alone?
Then let's battle!
entries.HikerNolandAfterBattleText:
I wonder if there
are any mountains

worth climbing in
KANTO?
entries.SailorStanlySeenText:
Yeah, I'm a sail-
or, all right.

I wasn't goofing
off!

This cabin was
vacant, so I just
took a quick nap!

Ah, forget it!
Let's battle!
entries.SailorStanlyAfterBattleText:
Being a sailor, I
have to do phys-
ical labor. It's
exhausting!
entries.GentlemanEdwardSeenText:
Oh, no. I've lost
something that's
very important.
entries.GentlemanEdwardAfterBattleText:
I give up.
You don't have to

look. Just forget
about it!
entries.BurglarCoreyAfterBattleText:
I found a pretty
coin here.

Someone must have
lost it…

entries.SSAquaCaptainExhaustingText:
Whew! Thanks for
coming along.

Keeping that lit-
tle girl amused
was exhausting.
entries.SSAquaCaptainHowDoYouLikeText:
How do you like
S.S.AQUA's ride?

She practically
skates across the
waves.
entries.SSAquaCantFindGranddaughterText:
Oh, hello…

I still can't find
my granddaughter.

If she's on the
ship, that's OK.

She's an energetic
child, so she may

be bugging some-
one. I'm worried…
entries.SSAquaEntertainedGranddaughterText:
<PLAY_G>, was it?
I heard you enter-
tained my grand-
daughter.

I want to thank
you for that.
entries.SSAquaGrandpaHaveThisText:
I know! I'd like
you to have this!
entries.SSAquaGranddaughterCaptainPlayWithMeText:
CAPTAIN, play with
me, please?

I'm bored! I want
to play more!
entries.SSAquaGranddaughterHasToFindGrandpaText:
Hi! Will you play
with me?

…Oh!

Grandpa's worried
about me?

I have to go!

I have to go find
Grandpa!
entries.SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingMText:
Grandpa, here I
am! I was playing

with the CAPTAIN
and this guy!
entries.SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingFText:
Grandpa, here I
am! I was playing

with the CAPTAIN
and this big girl!
entries.SSAquaGranddaughterHadFunText:
I had lots of fun
playing!
entries.PokefanmColinSeenText:
Hey, kid! Want to
battle with me?
entries.PokefanmColinAfterBattleText:
You're traveling
all alone?

Isn't your mom
worried?
entries.TwinsMegandpeg1SeenText:
You think I'm a
baby?
That's not fair!
entries.TwinsMegandpeg1AfterBattleText:
Baby is a rude
name to call us
girls!
entries.TwinsMegandpeg2SeenText:
I'm not a baby!

That's not nice to
say to a lady!
entries.TwinsMegandpeg2AfterBattleText:
Sometimes, kids
are smarter than
grown-ups!
entries.PsychicRodneySeenText:
Ssh! My brain is
picking up radio
signals!
entries.PsychicRodneyAfterBattleText:
I get it. You can
hear JOHTO's radio
on the FAST SHIP.
entries.PokefanmJeremySeenText:
What do you think?
My #MON are
beautiful, yes?
entries.PokefanmJeremyAfterBattleText:
I must go to the
#MON SALON and
fix them up nice!
entries.PokefanfGeorgiaSeenText:
I'm going to shop
at the DEPT.STORE
and then…
entries.PokefanfGeorgiaBeatenText:
What was I going
to do?
entries.PokefanfGeorgiaAfterBattleText:
Oh, yes! I have to
get my #MON out
of DAY-CARE!
entries.SupernerdShawnSeenText:
What kinds of #
BALLS do you have
with you?
entries.SupernerdShawnAfterBattleText:
You should use the
right BALLS to fit
the situation.
entries.SSAquaHasArrivedVermilionText:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived in
VERMILION CITY.

entries.FirebreatherLyleSeenText:
I'm going to KANTO
to put on fire-
breathing shows!
entries.FirebreatherLyleAfterBattleText:
I guess fire is
weak on the sea.

It doesn't matter?
Really?
entries.BugCatcherKenSeenText:
I'm visiting my
grandma to catch
me some bugs!
entries.BugCatcherKenAfterBattleText:
You can find lots
of #MON in the
trees of JOHTO!
entries.BeautyCassieSeenText:
I'm trying to
forget my woes.
Let's battle!
entries.BeautyCassieAfterBattleText:
A voyage is best
for getting over
a broken heart.

But a FAST SHIP
trip is too short
for grieving.
entries.GuitaristClydeSeenText:
I'm going to audi-
tion my songs at

GOLDENROD's RADIO
STATION.
entries.GuitaristClydeAfterBattleMobileText:
I was going to
make my debut at
the BATTLE TOWER…

I should go back
to VERMILION and
redo my training…
entries.GuitaristClydeAfterBattleText:
Speaking of the
RADIO STATION,

what's this week's
lucky number?
entries.FastShipBedText1:
A comfy bed!
Time to sleep…
entries.FastShipArrivedOlivineText:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived in
OLIVINE CITY.
entries.FastShipArrivedVermilionText:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived in
VERMILION CITY.

entries.FightingDojoBlackBeltText:
Hello!

KARATE KING, the
FIGHTING DOJO's

master, is in a
cave in JOHTO for
training.

entries.FuchsiaCityYoungsterText:
One of the ELITE
FOUR used to be

the LEADER of
FUCHSIA's GYM.
entries.FuchsiaCityPokefanMText:
KOGA's daughter
succeeded him as

the GYM LEADER
after he joined
the ELITE FOUR.
entries.FuchsiaCityTeacherText:
The SAFARI ZONE is
closed… It's sad,

considering it's
FUCHSIA's main
attraction.
entries.FuchsiaCitySignText:
FUCHSIA CITY

Behold! It's
Passion Pink!
entries.FuchsiaGymSignText:
FUCHSIA CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: JANINE

The Poisonous
Ninja Master
entries.SafariZoneOfficeSignText:
There's a notice
here…

SAFARI ZONE OFFICE
is closed until
further notice.
entries.SafariZoneClosedSignText:
The WARDEN is
traveling abroad.

Therefore, the
SAFARI ZONE is
closed.
entries.NoLitteringSignText:
No littering.

Please take your
waste with you.

entries.JanineText_DisappointYou:
Fufufufu…

I'm sorry to dis-
appoint you…

I'm only joking!

I'm the real deal!

JANINE of FUCHSIA
GYM, that's me!
entries.JanineText_ToughOne:
JANINE: You're a
tough one. You
definitely won…

Here's SOULBADGE.
Take it.
entries.JanineText_ToxicSpeech:
JANINE: You're so
tough! I have a
special gift!

It's TOXIC, a pow-
erful poison that

steadily saps the
victim's HP.
entries.JanineText_ApplyMyself:
JANINE: I'm going
to really apply

myself and improve
my skills.

I want to become
better than both
Father and you!
entries.LassAliceBeforeText:
Fufufu!

I'm JANINE, the
GYM LEADER!

No, I'm not!
Gotcha, sucker!
entries.LassAliceAfterText:
How will you dis-
tinguish our real
LEADER?
entries.LassLindaBeatenText:
Ooh… I lost…
You're not weak…
entries.PicnickerCindyBeforeText:
I'm JANINE!

How did you know I
was real?

Let's battle!
entries.PicnickerCindyBeatenText:
Darn it!
I wanted to win!
entries.CamperBarryBeatenText:
My disguise was
right on! Dang!
entries.CamperBarryAfterText:
Hey, you. Was my
disguise cute or
what, huh?
entries.FuchsiaGymGuideText:
Yo, CHAMP in
making!

Whoops! Take a
good look around

you. The trainers
all look like the
LEADER, JANINE.

Which of them is
the real JANINE?
entries.FuchsiaGymGuideWinText:
That was a great
battle, trainer
from JOHTO!

entries.FuchsiaMartFisherText:
I was hoping to
buy some SAFARI

ZONE souvenirs,
but it's closed…
entries.FuchsiaMartCooltrainerFText:
The SAFARI ZONE
WARDEN's grand-
daughter lives in
town.

entries.FuchsiaPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText:
Hey! You have a
brand new kind of
#DEX.

Did PROF.OAK give
that to you?
entries.FuchsiaPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
I got quite a
shock at the GYM.

There were all
these girls who
looked identical.
entries.FuchsiaPokecenter1FJanineImpersonatorTex:
See? I look just
like her now!

entries.GoldenrodBikeShopClerkIntroText:
…sigh… I moved
here, but I can't

sell my BICYCLES.
Why is that?

Could you ride a
BICYCLE and adver-
tise for me?
entries.GoldenrodBikeShopClerkAgreedText:
Really? Great!

Give me your name
and phone number,

and I'll loan you
a BICYCLE.
entries.GoldenrodBikeShopClerkFirstRateBikesText:
My BICYCLES are
first-rate! You

can ride them
anywhere.
entries.GoldenrodBikeShopClerkRefusedText:
…sigh… Oh, for
the kindness of
people…

entries.GoldenrodCityPokefanMText:
They built the new
RADIO TOWER to

replace the old,
creaky one.
entries.GoldenrodCityYoungster1Text:
I know there's a
new BIKE SHOP, but

I can't find it
anywhere.
entries.GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF1Text:
Is that man in
black dressed up

like a TEAM ROCKET
member? How silly!
entries.GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF1Text_ClearedRa:
Was that man in
black really part

of TEAM ROCKET? I
can't believe it!
entries.GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF2Text:
The RADIO TOWER in
GOLDENROD CITY is
a landmark.

They're running a
promotional cam- 
paign right now.

They'll modify
your #GEAR,

so it can also
serve as a radio.
entries.GoldenrodCityCooltrainerF2Text_GotRadioC:
Oh, your #GEAR
works as a radio!
entries.GoldenrodCityYoungster2Text:
E-he-he-he…

I got in trouble
for playing in the

basement of the
DEPT.STORE.
entries.GoldenrodCityLassText:
The man at that
house rates your
#MON names.

He can even rename
your #MON.
entries.GoldenrodCityGrampsText:
Whew! This is one
big town. I don't

know where any-
thing is.
entries.GoldenrodCityRocketScoutText1:
So this is the
RADIO TOWER…
entries.GoldenrodCityRocketScoutText2:
What do you want,
you pest? Scram!
entries.GoldenrodCityRocket1Text:
Stay out of the
way! Beat it!
entries.GoldenrodCityRocket2Text:
Take over the
RADIO TOWER…

What? It's none of
your business!
entries.GoldenrodCityRocket3Text:
#MON? They're
nothing more than

tools for making
money!
entries.GoldenrodCityRocket4Text:
Our dream will
soon come true…

It was such a long
struggle…
entries.GoldenrodCityRocket5Text:
Hey, brat! You
don't belong here!
Get lost!
entries.GoldenrodCityRocket6Text:
Come taste the
true terror of
TEAM ROCKET!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreSignText:
Full Selection of
#MON Goods!

GOLDENROD CITY
DEPT.STORE
entries.GoldenrodGymSignText:
GOLDENROD CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: WHITNEY

The Incredibly
Pretty Girl!
entries.GoldenrodCitySignText:
GOLDENROD CITY

The Festive City
of Opulent Charm
entries.GoldenrodCityBikeShopSignText:
The World is a
Cycle Path!
BIKE SHOP
entries.GoldenrodCityGameCornerSignText:
Your Playground!

GOLDENROD CITY
GAME CORNER
entries.GoldenrodCityNameRaterSignText:
NAME RATER

Get Your #MON
Nicknames Rated
entries.GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAskTeachAMoveText:
I can teach your
#MON amazing

moves if you'd
like.

Should I teach a
new move?
entries.GoldenrodCityMoveTutorAsk4000CoinsOkayTe:
It will cost you
4000 coins. Okay?
entries.GoldenrodCityMoveTutorWhichMoveShouldITe:
Wahahah! You won't
regret it!

Which move should
I teach?
entries.GoldenrodCityMoveTutorHmTooBadText:
Hm, too bad. I'll
have to get some
cash from home…
entries.GoldenrodCityMoveTutorIfYouUnderstandYou:
If you understand
what's so amazing

about this move,
you've made it as
a trainer.

entries.GoldenrodDeptStore1FGentlemanText:
The DEPT.STORE
has a decent se-
lection.

But some items
are only available

as GAME CORNER
prizes.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore1FPokefanFText:
I'm raring to shop
again today!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore1FBugCatcherText:
Mom's good at
bargain hunting.

She always buys
stuff at lower
prices.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore1FDirectoryText:
1F SERVICE COUNTER

2F TRAINER'S
   MARKET

3F BATTLE
   COLLECTION

4F MEDICINE BOX

5F TM CORNER

6F TRANQUIL SQUARE

ROOFTOP LOOKOUT

entries.GoldenrodDeptStore2FUnusedText1:
We intend to sell
items for #MON
to hold.

This is a free
gift. Have a #-
MON hold it.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore2FUnusedText2:
By giving #MON
items to hold, I

bet trainers will
develop new battle
techniques.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore2FYoungsterText:
#GEAR can store
up to ten phone
numbers.

It's hard to de-
cide which numbers
to keep.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore2FCooltrainerFText:
I got my ABRA at
the GAME CORNER.

Now it's my best
partner.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore2FGentlemanText:
This DEPT.STORE
makes me realize

that GOLDENROD is
a big city.

The selection here
is unmatched any-
where else.

entries.GoldenrodDeptStore3FSuperNerdText:
I, I, I'm really
impatient!

I use X SPEED in
battle to speed up
my #MON.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore3FRockerText:
Hey! When you bat-
tle, do you use X
SPECIAL?

It's awesome. It
really jacks up
SPECIAL ATTACK!

entries.GoldenrodDeptStore4FCooltrainerMText:
Hey. I love strong
#MON.

I feed them PRO-
TEIN to crank up
their ATTACK.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore4FGameboyKidText:
Some #MON
evolve only by

being traded via a
Game Link cable.

I know of four:
MACHOKE, KADABRA,

HAUNTER and, um,
GRAVELER.

I heard there are
others too.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore4FDirectoryText:
Let Us Pump Up
Your #MON!

4F MEDICINE BOX

entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistThisMove:
It's very attached
to you.

This move should
be perfect for a
pair like you.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistItsAdora:
It's adorable!

You should teach
it good TM moves.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistItLooksE:
It looks evil. How
about this TM for
it?
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FReceptionistThereAre:
There are sure to
be TMs that are

just perfect for
your #MON.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FCarrieMysteryGiftExp:
MYSTERY GIFT.

With just a
little beep, you
get a gift.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FCarrieMysteryGiftReq:
The MYSTERY GIFT
option requires a
Game Boy Color.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FLassText:
On Sundays, a lady
comes to check out
#MON.

She even gives
away TMs!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore5FPokefanMText:
You can't rename a
#MON you get in
a trade.

The name is a re-
flection of the

original trainer's
feelings for it.

entries.GoldenrodVendingText:
A vending machine!
Here's the menu.
entries.GoldenrodVendingNoSpaceText:
There's no more
room for stuff.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore6FLassText:
Do you listen to
LUCKY CHANNEL?

If you want to
win, trade #MON

with as many peo-
ple as possible to

get different ID
numbers.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore6FSuperNerdText:
If you're tired,
try the vending
machine's drinks.

Your #MON will
love them too.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStore6FDirectoryText:
Take a Break from
Shopping!

6F TRANQUIL SQUARE

entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt1Text:
Hey, kid! You're
holding us up!

Our policy is to
work behind the

scenes where no
one can see us!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt2Text:
I lose my passion
for work if some-
one's watching.

Come on, kid,
scoot!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreB1FBlackBelt3Text:
Oohah! Oohah!

The stuff on the
ground's junk.

Take it if you
want it!

entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanFText:
Whew, I'm tired.

I sometimes come
up to the rooftop

to take a break
from shopping.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofFisherText:
Pardon? Who says
an adult can't get
into this?

I'm going to be
back every day to

collect all the
dolls!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTwinText:
They have bargain
sales here every
so often.
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofPokefanMText:
There's something
I really want, but

I don't have the
necessary cash…

Maybe I'll sell
off the BERRIES
I've collected…
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofTeacherText:
Oh, everything is
so cheap!

I bought so much,
my PACK's crammed!
entries.GoldenrodDeptStoreRoofBugCatcherText:
My #MON always
get paralyzed or

poisoned when the
chips are down…

So I came to buy
some FULL HEAL.

I wonder if
there's any left?
entries.Binoculars1Text:
These binoculars
let me see far

away. Maybe I can
see my own house.

Is it the one with
the green roof?
entries.Binoculars2Text:
Hey! Some trainers
are battling on
the road!

A #MON fired a
flurry of leaves!

That makes me feel
like battling
right now!
entries.Binoculars3Text:
A FISHER caught a
lot of MAGIKARP…

They're SPLASHing
at the same time!

Look at the water
going everywhere!
entries.PokeDollVendingMachineText:
A vending machine
for #MON dolls?

Insert money, then
turn the crank…

But it's almost
empty…

entries.GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherMySisterWentTo:
Have you seen that
wiggly tree that's

growing on ROUTE
36?

My little sister
got all excited

and went to see
it…

I'm worried… Isn't
it dangerous?
entries.GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherAskWantToBorro:
Do you want to
borrow the water

bottle too?
I don't want you

doing anything
dangerous with it.
entries.GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherHeresTheSquirt:
Oh, you're better
than WHITNEY…

You'll be OK,
then. Here's the
SQUIRTBOTTLE!
entries.GoldenrodFlowerShopTeacherLalalaHavePlen:
Lalala lalalala.
Have plenty of
water, my lovely!
entries.GoldenrodFlowerShopFloriaWonderIfSisWill:
When I told my sis
about the jiggly

tree, she told me
it's dangerous.

If I beat WHITNEY,
I wonder if she'll

lend me her water
bottle…

entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorIntroText:
Welcome!

We exchange your
game coins for
fabulous prizes!
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoMoreRoom:
Sorry. You can't
carry any more.
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorQuitText:
OK. Please save
your coins and
come again!
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoCoinCase:
Oh? You don't have
a COIN CASE.
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerFText:
I won't quit until
I win!
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerGentlemanText:
I taught BLIZZARD
to my #MON.

It was hard to get
enough coins for

it, but it was
worth it.
entries.MoveTutorInsideText:
Wahahah! The coins
keep rolling in!
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerLeftTheirDrinkText:
Someone left their
drink.

It smells sweet.
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerMText:
Life is a gamble.
I'm going to flip
cards till I drop!
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPharmacistText:
I always play this
slot machine. It

pays out more than
others, I think.
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM1Text:
I just love this
new slot machine.

It's more of a
challenge than the
ones in CELADON.
entries.GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM2Text:
I couldn't win at
the slots, and I

blew it on card
flipping…

I got so furious,
I tossed out my

COIN CASE in the
UNDERGROUND.

entries.WhitneyBeforeText:
Hi! I'm WHITNEY!

Everyone was into
#MON, so I got
into it too!

#MON are
super-cute!

You want to bat-
tle? I'm warning
you--I'm good!
entries.WhitneyShouldntBeSoSeriousText:
Sob…

…Waaaaaaah!
You're mean!

You shouldn't be
so serious! You…
you child, you!
entries.WhitneyWhatDoYouWantText:
…Sniff…

What? What do you
want? A BADGE?

Oh, right.
I forgot. Here's
PLAINBADGE.
entries.WhitneyPlainBadgeText:
PLAINBADGE lets
your #MON use

STRENGTH outside
of battle.

It also boosts
your #MON's
SPEED.

Oh, you can have
this too!
entries.WhitneyAttractText:
It's ATTRACT!
It makes full use

of a #MON's
charm.

Isn't it just per-
fect for a cutie
like me?
entries.WhitneyGoodCryText:
Ah, that was a
good cry!

Come for a visit
again! Bye-bye!
entries.LassCarrieSeenText:
Don't let my
#MON's cute

looks fool you.
They can whip you!
entries.LassCarrieBeatenText:
Darn… I thought
you were weak…
entries.LassBridgetSeenText:
I like cute #-
MON better than
strong #MON.

But I have strong
and cute #MON!
entries.LassBridgetAfterBattleText:
I'm trying to beat
WHITNEY, but…
It's depressing.

I'm okay! If I
lose, I'll just

try harder next
time!
entries.BridgetWhitneyCriesText:
Oh, no. You made
WHITNEY cry.

It's OK. She'll
stop soon. She

always cries when
she loses.
entries.BeautyVictoriaSeenText:
Oh, you are a cute
little trainer! 

I like you, but I
won't hold back!
entries.BeautyVictoriaAfterBattleText:
Wow, you must be
good to beat me!
Keep it up!
entries.BeautySamanthaSeenText:
Give it your best
shot, or I'll take
you down!
entries.BeautySamanthaBeatenText:
No! Oh, MEOWTH,
I'm so sorry!
entries.BeautySamanthaAfterBattleText:
I taught MEOWTH
moves for taking
on any type…
entries.GoldenrodGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

This GYM is home
to normal-type
#MON trainers.

I recommend you
use fighting-type
#MON.
entries.GoldenrodGymGuideWinText:
You won? Great! I
was busy admiring
the ladies here.

entries.GoldenrodHappinessRaterTeacherText:
If you treat your
#MON nicely,

they will love you
in return.

Oh? Let me see
your @
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_LovesYouALo:
It looks really
happy! It must
love you a lot.
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_ReallyTrust:
I get the feeling
that it really
trusts you.
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_SortOfHappy:
It's friendly to-
ward you. It looks
sort of happy.
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_NotUsedToYo:
You should treat
it better. It's
not used to you.
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRatingText_LooksMean:
It doesn't seem to
like you at all.
It looks mean.
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRaterPokefanMText:
I keep losing in
battles, and my

#MON end up
fainting…

Maybe that's why
my #MON don't
like me much…
entries.GoldenrodHappinessRaterTwinText:
When I use an item
on my #MON, it
acts really glad!

entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerTheTra:
The train hasn't
come in…

I know! I'll carry
the passengers on
my back!

That won't work.
entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerAreYou:
We'll soon depart
for SAFFRON.

Are you coming
aboard?
entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerRightT:
May I see your
rail PASS, please?

OK. Right this
way, please.
entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerYouDon:
Sorry. You don't
have a rail PASS.
entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerHopeTo:
We hope to see you
again!
entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationOfficerArrive:
We have arrived in
GOLDENROD.

We hope to see you
again.
entries.GoldenrodMagnetTrainStationGentlemanText:
I'm the PRESIDENT.

My dream was to
build a train that

is faster than any
#MON.

It really brings
JOHTO much closer
to KANTO.

entries.GoldenrodPPSpeechHouseFisherText:
Once while I was
battling, my

#MON couldn't
make any moves.

The POWER POINTS,
or PP, of its

moves were all
gone.
entries.GoldenrodPPSpeechHouseLassText:
Sometimes, a
healthy #MON

may be unable to
use its moves.

If that happens,
heal it at a #-
MON CENTER or use
an item.

entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWelcomeToTradeCorn:
Hello! Welcome to
#COM CENTER
TRADE CORNER.

You can trade
#MON with other
people far away.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeMustHoldYourMonT:
To make a trade,
we must hold your
#MON.

Would you like to
trade?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhatMonDoYouWantTe:
What kind of
#MON do you
want in return?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeWillTradeYourMon:
Fine. We will try
to trade your

@

Fine. We will try
to trade your

@
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourMonHasBeenRece:
Your trade #MON
has been received.

It will take time
to find a trade

partner. Please
come back later.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterYouHaveOnlyOneMonT:
Oh? You have only
one #MON in
your party. 

Please come back
once you've in-
creased the size
of your party.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWeHopeToSeeYouAgai:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterCantAcceptLastMonT:
If we accept that
#MON, what will
you battle with?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterCantAcceptEggText:
Sorry. We can't
accept an EGG.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterCantAcceptAbnormal:
Sorry, but your
#MON appears to

be abnormal. We
can't accept it.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterAlreadyHoldingMonT:
Oh? Aren't we
already holding a
#MON of yours?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterCheckingTheRoomsTe:
We'll check the
rooms.

Please wait.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterTradePartnerHasBee:
Thank you for your
patience.

A trade partner
has been found.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterItsYourNewPartnerT:
It's your new
partner.

Please take care
of it with love.

We hope to see you
again.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourPartyIsFullTex:
Uh-oh. Your party
is already full.

Please come back
when you have room
in your party.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoTradePartnerFoun:
It's unfortunate,
but no one has

come forward as a
trade partner.

Would you like
your #MON back?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterYourMonIsLonelyTex:
It's unfortunate,
but no one has

come forward as a
trade partner.

We've held your
#MON for a long

time. As a result,
it is very lonely.

Sorry, but we must
return it to you.
entries.GoldenrodPokecenter1FWeHopeToSeeYouAgain:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterContinueToHoldYour:
Fine. We will
continue to hold
your #MON.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterRecentlyLeftYourMo:
Oh? You left your
#MON with us
only recently.

Please come back
later.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterSaveBeforeTradeCor:
We'll SAVE before
connecting to the
CENTER.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhichMonToTradeTex:
Which #MON do
you want to trade?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterTradeCanceledText:
Sorry, but we must
cancel the trade.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterEggTicketText:
Oh!

I see you have an
EGG TICKET!

It's a coupon that
special people can

redeem for a
special #MON!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterOddEggBriefingText:
Let me give you a
quick briefing.

Trades held at the
TRADE CORNER are

between two
trainers who don't

know each other's
identity.

As a result, it
may take time.

However, an ODD
EGG is available
just for you.

It will be sent to
you right away.

Please choose one
of the rooms in

the CENTER.
An ODD EGG will be

sent from the
chosen room.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterHereIsYourOddEggTe:
Thank you for
waiting.

We received your
ODD EGG.

Here it is!

Please raise it
with loving care.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterNoEggTicketService:
I'm awfully sorry.

The EGG TICKET
exchange service
isn't running now.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWhatToDoText:
What would you
like to do?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineExplana:
#MON NEWS is
news compiled from

the SAVE files of
#MON trainers.

When reading the
NEWS, your SAVE

file may be sent
out.

The SAVE file data
will contain your

adventure log and
mobile profile.

Your phone number
will not be sent.

The contents of
the NEWS will vary

depending on the
SAVE files sent by

you and the other
#MON trainers.

You might even be
in the NEWS!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterWouldYouLikeTheNew:
Would you like to
get the NEWS?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterReadingTheLatestNe:
Reading the latest
NEWS… Please wait.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterCorruptedNewsDataT:
The NEWS data is
corrupted.

Please download
the NEWS again.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterMakingPreparations:
We're making
preparations.

Please come back
later.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterSaveBeforeNewsMach:
We will SAVE your
progress before

starting the NEWS
MACHINE.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson1Text:
Whoa, this #MON
CENTER is huge.

They just built
this place. They

installed lots of
new machines too.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson2Text:
I thought up a fun
new thing for the
TRADE CORNER!

I make a PIDGEY
hold MAIL, then

put it up for
trade for another
one!

If everyone did
that, MAIL could

be traded with all
sorts of people!

I call it PIDGEY
MAIL!

If it becomes
popular, I might

make lots of new
friends!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson3Text:
They said you can
trade #MON with

total strangers up
here.

But they're still
adjusting things.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson4Text:
Some girl I don't
know sent me her

HOPPIP.
You should trade

for a #MON that
you want.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson5Text:
I received a
female HOPPIP, but
its named STANLEY!

That's my dad's
name!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson6Text:
What is the NEWS
MACHINE?

Does it get news
from a wider area
than the radio?
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson7Text:
The #COM CENTER
will link with all

#MON CENTERS in
a wireless net.

That must mean
I'll be able to

link with all
sorts of people.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson8Text:
The machines here
can't be used yet.

Still, it's nice
coming to a trendy

place before other
people.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson9Text:
My friend was in
the NEWS a while

back. I was really
surprised!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson10Text:
I get anxious if I
don't check out
the latest NEWS!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson11Text:
If I get in the
NEWS and become

famous, I bet I'll
be adored.

I wonder how I
could get in the
NEWS?
entries.GoldenrodPokecenter1FGameboyKidText:
The COLOSSEUM
upstairs is for
link battles.

Battle records are
posted on the

wall, so I can't
afford to lose.
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson12Text:
I came over here
when I got word

that GOLDENROD's
#MON CENTER has

new machines that
no one's ever seen
before.

But it looks like
they're still busy

with all their
preparations…
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterPerson13Text:
Just seeing all
these new things

here makes me feel
younger!
entries.GoldenrodPokecenter1FLassText:
A higher level
#MON doesn't
always win.

After all, it may
have a type dis-
advantage.

I don't think
there is a single

#MON that is
the toughest.
entries.GoldenrodPokeCenter1FLinkReceptionistPle:
<PLAYER>, isn't it?

Congratulations!

As a special deal,
a GS BALL has been
sent just for you!

Please accept it!
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterSignText:
#COM CENTER
1F INFORMATION

Left:
ADMINISTRATION

Center:
TRADE CORNER

Right:
#MON NEWS
entries.GoldenrodPokecomCenterNewsMachineNotYetT:
It's a #MON
NEWS MACHINE!

It's not in
operation yet…
entries.GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFDoYouHaveEo:
Oh my, your pack
looks so heavy!

Oh! Do you happen
to have something
named EON MAIL?

My daughter is
after one.

You can part with
one, can't you?
entries.GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFThisIsForYo:
Oh, that's great!
Thank you, honey!

Here, this is for
you in return!
entries.GoldenrodPokecenter1FPokefanFTooBadText:
Oh? You don't have
one? Too bad.

entries.SupernerdEricSeenText:
I got booted out
of the GAME COR-
NER.

I was trying to
cheat using my
#MON…
entries.SupernerdEricAfterBattleText:
I guess I have to
do things fair and
square…
entries.SupernerdTeruSeenText:
Do you consider
type alignments in
battle?

If you know your
type advantages,

you'll do better
in battle.
entries.SupernerdTeruAfterBattleText:
I know my #MON
type alignments.

But I only use one
type of #MON.
entries.PokemaniacIssacSeenText:
My #MON just
got a haircut!

I'll show you how
strong it is!
entries.PokemaniacIssacAfterBattleText:
Your #MON will
like you more if

you give them
haircuts.
entries.PokemaniacDonaldSeenText:
I think you have
some rare #MON
with you.

Let me see them!
entries.PokemaniacDonaldBeatenText:
Gaah! I lost!
That makes me mad!
entries.PokemaniacDonaldAfterBattleText:
Are you making a
#DEX? Here's a
hot tip.

The HIKER on ROUTE
33, ANTHONY, is a
good guy.

He'll phone you if
he sees any rare
#MON.
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundBasementKeyOpenedDoo:
The BASEMENT KEY
opened the door.
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherO:
Welcome!

I run the #MON
SALON!

I'm the older and
better of the two
HAIRCUT BROTHERS.

I can make your
#MON beautiful
for just ¥{d:GOLDENRODUNDERGROUND_OLDER_HAIRCUT_PRICE}.

Would you like me
to do that?
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherT:
Is that right?
That's a shame!
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherY:
You'll need more
money than that.
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundOlderHaircutBrotherO:
I do only one
haircut a day. I'm
done for today.
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundYoungerHaircutBrothe:
Welcome to the
#MON SALON!

I'm the younger
and less expen-
sive of the two
HAIRCUT BROTHERS.

I'll spiff up your
#MON for just
¥{d:GOLDENRODUNDERGROUND_YOUNGER_HAIRCUT_PRICE}.

So? How about it?

OK! I'll make it
look cool!

You're a little
short on funds.

I can do only one
haircut a day.

Sorry, but I'm all
done for today.

entries.UndergroundRivalBeforeText:
Hold it!

I saw you, so I
tailed you.

I don't need you
underfoot while I

take care of TEAM
ROCKET.

…Wait a second.
You beat me be-
fore, didn't you?

That was just a
fluke.

But I repay my
debts!
entries.UndergroundRivalWinText:
…Why…
Why do I lose?

I've assembled the
toughest #MON.

I didn't ease up
on the gas.

So why do I lose?
entries.UndergroundRivalAfterText:
…I don't under-
stand…

Is what that LANCE
guy said true?

That I don't treat
#MON properly?

Love…

Trust…

Are they really
what I lack?

Are they keeping
me from winning?

I… I just don't
understand.

But it's not going
to end here.

Not now. Not
because of this.

I won't give up my
dream of becoming

the world's best
#MON trainer!
entries.UndergroundRivalLossText:
Humph. This is my
real power, wimp.

I'll make TEAM
ROCKET history.

And I'm going to
grind that LANCE
under my heels.
entries.GoldenrodUndergroundSwitchRoomEntrances_:
I was challenged
to a battle down-
stairs.

It's rough down
there. You'd
better be careful.

There are some
shops downstairs…

But there are
also trainers.

I'm scared to go
down there.
entries.GruntM11SeenText:
Open one shutter,
another closes.

Bet you can't get
where you want!
entries.GruntM11BeatenText:
Drat! I was sunk
by indecision!
entries.GruntM11AfterBattleText:
I'm confused too…
The switch on the

end is the one to
press first, but…
entries.GruntM25SeenText:
Kwahaha!

Confounded by the
shutters, are we?

I'll let you in on
a secret if you
can beat me!
entries.GruntM25AfterBattleText:
All right. A hint!

Change the order
of switching.

That'll change the
ways the shutters
open and close.
entries.BurglarDuncanAfterBattleText:
Steal and sell!
That's basic in
crime, kid!
entries.BurglarEddieSeenText:
They ditched this
project before
they finished.

I'm searching for
leftover loot.
entries.BurglarEddieAfterBattleText:
UNDERGROUND WARE-
HOUSE?

What do you want
to go there for?

There's nothing
down there.
entries.GruntM13SeenText:
I don't care if
you're lost.

You show up here,
you're nothing but
a victim!
entries.GruntM13BeatenText:
Urk! Yeah, think
you're cool, huh?
entries.GruntM13AfterBattleText:
You must have ice
in your veins to
dis TEAM ROCKET.
entries.GruntF3SeenText:
Are you lost? No,
you can't be.

You don't have
that scared look.

I'll give you
something to be
scared about!
entries.GruntF3AfterBattleText:
Go wherever you'd
like! Get lost!
See if I care!

entries.GruntM24SeenText:
How did you get
this far?

I guess it can't
be helped. I'll
dispose of you.
entries.GruntM24AfterBattleText:
TEAM ROCKET will
keep going, wait-
ing for the return
of GIOVANNI.

We'll do whatever
it takes.
entries.GruntM14SeenText:
You're not going
any farther!

I don't show mercy
to my enemies, not
even brats!
entries.GruntM14AfterBattleText:
I lost…

Please forgive me,
GIOVANNI!
entries.GruntM15SeenText:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
I remember you!

You got me good
at our hideout!
entries.GruntM15AfterBattleText:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
That was a blast!
I'll remember you!
entries.DirectorIntroText:
DIRECTOR: Who?
What? You came to
rescue me?

Thank you!

The RADIO TOWER!

What's happening
there?

Taken over by TEAM
ROCKET?

Here. Take this
CARD KEY.
entries.DirectorCardKeyText:
DIRECTOR: Use that
to open the shut-
ters on 3F.
entries.DirectorAfterText:
I'm begging you to
help.

There's no telling
what they'll do if

they control the
transmitter.

They may even be
able to control

#MON using a
special signal!

You're the only
one I can call on.

Please save the
RADIO TOWER…

And all the #-
MON nationwide!

entries.GuideGentsHouseGuideGentText:
When I was a wee
lad, I was a hot-
shot trainer!

Here's a word of
advice: Catch lots
of #MON!

Treat them all
with kindness!

entries.HallOfFame_LanceText:
LANCE: It's been a
long time since I
last came here.

This is where we
honor the LEAGUE

CHAMPIONS for all
eternity.

Their courageous
#MON are also
inducted.

Here today, we
witnessed the rise

of a new LEAGUE
CHAMPION--a

trainer who feels
compassion for,

and trust toward,
all #MON.

A trainer who
succeeded through

perseverance and
determination.

The new LEAGUE
CHAMPION who has

all the makings
of greatness!

<PLAY_G>, allow me
to register you

and your partners
as CHAMPIONS!

entries.IlexForestApprenticeIntroText:
Oh, man… My boss
is going to be
steaming…

The FARFETCH'D
that CUTS trees

for charcoal took
off on me.

I can't go looking
for it here in the
ILEX FOREST.

It's too big, dark
and scary for me…
entries.IlexForestApprenticeAfterText:
Wow! Thanks a
whole bunch!

My boss's #MON
won't obey me be-
cause I don't have
a BADGE.
entries.Text_CharcoalMasterIntro:
Ah! My FARFETCH'D!

You found it for
us, kid?

Without it, we
wouldn't be able

to CUT trees for
charcoal.

Thanks, kid!

Now, how can I
thank you…

I know! Here, take
this.
entries.Text_CharcoalMasterOutro:
That's the CUT HM.
Teach that to a

#MON to clear
small trees.

Of course, you
have to have the

GYM BADGE from
AZALEA to use it.
entries.Text_CharcoalMasterTalkAfter:
Do you want to
apprentice as a

charcoal maker
with me?

You'll be first-
rate in ten years!
entries.Text_HeadbuttIntro:
What am I doing?

I'm shaking trees
using HEADBUTT.

It's fun. Here,
you try it too!
entries.Text_HeadbuttOutro:
Rattle trees with
HEADBUTT. Some-
times, sleeping
#MON fall out.
entries.Text_IlexForestLass:
Did something
happen to the
forest's guardian?
entries.IlexForestSignpostText:
ILEX FOREST is
so overgrown with

trees that you
can't see the sky.

Please watch out
for items that may
have been dropped.
entries.Text_IlexForestShrine:
ILEX FOREST
SHRINE…

It's in honor of
the forest's
protector…
entries.Text_ShrineCelebiEvent:
ILEX FOREST
SHRINE…

It's in honor of
the forest's
protector…

Oh? What is this?

It's a hole.
It looks like the

GS BALL would fit
inside it.

Want to put the GS
BALL here?
entries.Text_KurtCaughtCelebi:
Whew, wasn't that
something!

<PLAYER>, that was
fantastic. Thanks!

The legends about
that SHRINE were
real after all.

I feel inspired by
what I just saw.

It motivates me to
make better BALLS!

I'm going!
entries.BugCatcherWayneSeenText:
Don't sneak up on
me like that!

You frightened a
#MON away!
entries.BugCatcherWayneAfterBattleText:
A #MON I've
never seen before

fell out of the
tree when I used
HEADBUTT.

I ought to use
HEADBUTT in other
places too.

entries.IlexForestAzaleaGateOfficerText:
ILEX FOREST is
big. Be careful!
Don't get lost.
entries.IlexForestAzaleaGateGrannyText:
The FOREST is
watched over by
its protector.

Stay out of
mischief!

entries.IndigoPlateauPokecenter1FCooltrainerMTex:
At the #MON
LEAGUE, you'll get

tested by the
ELITE FOUR.

You have to beat
them all. If you

lose, you have to
start all over!
entries.PlateauRivalText1:
Hold it.

You're going to
take the #MON

LEAGUE challenge
now?

That's not going
to happen.

My super-well-
trained #MON

are going to pound
you.

<PLAYER>!
I challenge you!
entries.PlateauRivalText2:
…Darn… I still
can't win…

I… I have to think
more about my
#MON…

Humph! Try not to
lose!
entries.PlateauRivalLoseText:
…

Whew…
With my partners,

I'm going to be
the CHAMPION!
entries.TeleportGuyText1:
Ah! You're chal-
lenging the ELITE

FOUR? Are you sure
you're ready?

If you need to
train some more,

my ABRA can help
you.

It can TELEPORT
you home.

Would you like to
go home now?
entries.TeleportGuyYesText:
OK, OK. Picture
your house in your
mind…
entries.TeleportGuyNoText:
OK, OK. The best
of luck to you!

entries.KarenScript_KarenBeforeText:
I am KAREN of the
ELITE FOUR.

You're <PLAYER>?
How amusing.

I love dark-type
#MON.

I find their wild,
tough image to be

so appealing. And
they're so strong.

Think you can take
them? Just try to
entertain me.

Let's go.
entries.KarenScript_KarenBeatenText:
Well, aren't you
good. I like that
in a trainer.
entries.KarenScript_KarenDefeatText:
Strong #MON.

Weak #MON.

That is only the
selfish perception
of people.

Truly skilled
trainers should

try to win with
their favorites.

I like your style.
You understand
what's important.

Go on--the CHAM-
PION is waiting.

entries.KogaScript_KogaBeforeText:
Fwahahahaha!

I am KOGA of the
ELITE FOUR.

I live in shadows,
a ninja!

My intricate style
will confound and
destroy you!

Confusion, sleep,
poison…

Prepare to be the
victim of my sin-
ister technique!

Fwahahahaha!

#MON is not
merely about brute

force--you shall
see soon enough!
entries.KogaScript_KogaBeatenText:
Ah!
You have proven
your worth!
entries.KogaScript_KogaDefeatText:
I subjected you to
everything I could
muster.

But my efforts
failed. I must
hone my skills.

Go on to the next
room, and put your
abilities to test!

entries.KurtsHouseKurtMakingBallsMustWaitText:
Hm? Who are you?

<PLAYER>, eh? You
want me to make
some BALLS?

Sorry, but that'll
have to wait.

Do you know TEAM
ROCKET? Ah, don't

worry. I'll tell
you anyhow.

TEAM ROCKET's an
evil gang that

uses #MON for
their dirty work.

They're supposed
to have disbanded
three years ago.

Anyway, they're at
the WELL, cutting

off SLOWPOKETAILS
for sale!

So I'm going to
go give them a
lesson in pain!

Hang on, SLOWPOKE!
Old KURT is on his
way!
entries.KurtsHouseKurtHonoredToMakeBallsText:
KURT: Hi, <PLAYER>!

You handled your-
self like a real
hero at the WELL.

I like your style!

I would be honored
to make BALLS for

a trainer like
you.

This is all I have
now, but take it.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtBallsFromApricornsText:
KURT: I make BALLS
from APRICORNS.

Collect them from
trees and bring
'em to me.

I'll make BALLS
out of them.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtAskYouHaveAnApricornText:
KURT: You have an
APRICORN for me?

Fine! I'll turn it
into a BALL.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtItWillTakeADayText:
KURT: It'll take a
day to make you a

BALL. Come back
for it later.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtDontBotherMeText:
KURT: I'm working!
Don't bother me!
entries.KurtsHouseKurtJustFinishedYourBallText:
KURT: Ah, <PLAYER>!
I just finished
your BALL. Here!
entries.KurtsHouseKurtTurnedOutGreatText:
KURT: That turned
out great.

Try catching
#MON with it.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtGranddaughterHelpingWorkFa:
KURT: Now that my
granddaughter is

helping me, I can
work much faster.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtWhatIsThatText:
Wh-what is that?

I've never seen
one before.

It looks a lot
like a # BALL,

but it appears to
be something else.

Let me check it
for you.
entries.KurtsHouseKurtThisBallStartedToShakeText:
<PLAYER>!

This BALL started
to shake while I
was checking it.

There must be
something to this!
entries.KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeGoneText:
The SLOWPOKE are
gone… Were they

taken away by bad
people?
entries.KurtsGranddaughterSlowpokeBackText:
The SLOWPOKE my
dad gave me came

back! Its TAIL is
growing back too!
entries.KurtsGranddaughterDadText:
Dad works at SILPH
where he studies
# BALLS.

I have to stay
home with Grandpa
and SLOWPOKE.
entries.KurtsGranddaughterHelpText:
I get to help
Grandpa now!

We'll make good
BALLS for you, so
please wait!
entries.KurtsGranddaughterGSBallText:
Grandpa's checking
a BALL right now.

So I'm waiting
till he's done.
entries.KurtsHouseCelebiStatueText:
It's a statue of
the forest's pro-
tector.

entries.LakeOfRageLanceForcedToEvolveText:
This lake is full
of GYARADOS but
nothing else…

So the MAGIKARP
are being forced
to evolve…
entries.LakeOfRageLanceIntroText:
Did you come here
because of the
rumors?

You're <PLAYER>?
I'm LANCE, a
trainer like you.

I heard some ru-
mors, so I came to
investigate…

I saw the way you
battled earlier,
<PLAY_G>.

I can tell that
you're a trainer

with considerable
skill.

If you don't mind,
could you help me
investigate?
entries.LakeOfRageLanceRadioSignalText:
LANCE: Excellent!

It seems that the
LAKE's MAGIKARP

are being forced
to evolve.

A mysterious radio
broadcast coming

from MAHOGANY is
the cause.

I'll be waiting
for you, <PLAY_G>.
entries.LakeOfRageLanceRefusedText:
Oh… Well, if you
change your mind,
please help me.
entries.LakeOfRageLanceAskHelpText:
LANCE: Hm? Are you
going to help me?
entries.LakeOfRageGrampsText:
The GYARADOS are
angry!

It's a bad omen!
entries.LakeOfRageGrampsText_ClearedRocketHideou:
Hahah! The MAGI-
KARP are biting!
entries.LakeOfRageSuperNerdText:
I heard this lake
was made by ram-
paging GYARADOS.

I wonder if there
is any connection

to their mass out-
break now?
entries.LakeOfRageCooltrainerFText:
Did my eyes de-
ceive me? I saw a

red GYARADOS in
the LAKE…

But I thought
GYARADOS were
usually blue?
entries.FisherAndreSeenText:
Let me battle with
the #MON I just
caught!
entries.FisherAndreBeatenText:
I might be an ex-
pert angler, but

I stink as a #-
MON trainer…
entries.FisherAndreAfterBattleText:
I won't lose as an
angler! I catch
#MON all day.
entries.FisherRaymondSeenText:
No matter what I
do, all I catch

are the same #-
MON…
entries.FisherRaymondAfterBattleText:
Why can't I catch
any good #MON?
entries.CooltrainermAaronSeenText:
If a trainer spots
another trainer,

he has to make a
challenge.

That is our
destiny.
entries.CooltrainermAaronAfterBattleText:
#MON and their
trainer become

powerful through
constant battling.
entries.CooltrainerfLoisSeenText:
What happened to
the red GYARADOS?

It's gone?

Oh, darn. I came
here for nothing?

I know--let's
battle!
entries.CooltrainerfLoisAfterBattleText:
Come to think of
it, I've seen a
pink BUTTERFREE.
entries.MeetWesleyText:
WESLEY: Well, how
do you do?

Seeing as how it's
Wednesday today,

I'm WESLEY of
Wednesday.
entries.WesleyGivesGiftText:
Pleased to meet
you. Please take a
souvenir.
entries.WesleyGaveGiftText:
WESLEY: BLACKBELT
beefs up the power
of fighting moves.
entries.WesleyWednesdayText:
WESLEY: Since you
found me, you must

have met my broth-
ers and sisters.

Or did you just
get lucky?
entries.WesleyNotWednesdayText:
WESLEY: Today's
not Wednesday.
That's too bad.
entries.LakeOfRageSignText:
LAKE OF RAGE,
also known as
GYARADOS LAKE.

entries.HiddenPowerGuyText1:
…You have strayed
far…

Here I have medi-
tated. Inside me,

a new power has
been awakened.

Let me share my
power with your

#MON.
Take this, child.
entries.HiddenPowerGuyText2:
Do you see it? It
is HIDDEN POWER!

It draws out the
power of #MON
for attacking.

Remember this: its
type and power de-
pend on the #-
MON using it.

entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_LakeOfRageHistor:
LAKE OF RAGE is
actually a crater

made by rampaging
GYARADOS.

The crater filled
up with rainwater

and the LAKE was
formed.

That's the story
passed on from my

Grandpa's great-
great-grandpa.

It used to be that
you could catch

lively MAGIKARP
there, but…

I don't understand
what's happening.
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_MenInBlack:
The LAKE hasn't
been normal since

those men wearing
black arrived.
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_WorldsLargestMag:
LAKE OF RAGE is
back to normal.

The MAGIKARP have
returned.

I may yet realize
my dream of see-
ing the world's
largest MAGIKARP.

Do you have a ROD?
Please help me if
you do.
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_YouHaveAMagikarp:
Ah, you have a
MAGIKARP! Let's

see how big that
baby is.
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_Memento:
Wow! This one is
outstanding!

I tip my hat to
you!

Take this as a
memento!
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_Bonus:
The record is the
important thing.

Think of that as
a bonus!
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_TooShort:
Wow! This one is
outstanding!

…I wish I could
say that, but I've

seen a bigger one
before.
entries.MagikarpLengthRaterText_Refused:
Oh… So you didn't
get one good

enough to show me?
Maybe next time.

entries.LanceBattleIntroText:
LANCE: I've been
waiting for you.

<PLAY_G>!

I knew that you,
with your skills,

would eventually
reach me here.

There's no need
for words now.

We will battle to
determine who is

the stronger of
the two of us.

As the most power-
ful trainer and as

the #MON LEAGUE
CHAMPION…

I, LANCE the drag-
on master, accept
your challenge!
entries.LanceBattleWinText:
…It's over.

But it's an odd
feeling.

I'm not angry that
I lost. In fact, I
feel happy.

Happy that I
witnessed the rise

of a great new
CHAMPION!
entries.LanceBattleAfterText:
…Whew.

You have become
truly powerful,
<PLAY_G>.

Your #MON have
responded to your

strong and up-
standing nature.

As a trainer, you
will continue to

grow strong with
your #MON.
entries.LancesRoomMaryOhNoOakText:
MARY: Oh, no!
It's all over!

PROF.OAK, if you
weren't so slow…
entries.LancesRoomOakCongratulationsText:
PROF.OAK: Ah,
<PLAY_G>!

It's been a long
while.

You certainly look
more impressive.

Your conquest of
the LEAGUE is just
fantastic!

Your dedication,
trust and love for

your #MON made
this happen.

Your #MON were
outstanding too.

Because they be-
lieved in you as a

trainer, they per-
severed.

Congratulations,
<PLAY_G>!
entries.LancesRoomMaryInterviewText:
MARY: Let's inter-
view the brand new
CHAMPION!
entries.LancesRoomNoisyText:
LANCE: This is
getting to be a
bit too noisy…

<PLAY_G>, could you
come with me?
entries.LancesRoomMaryNoInterviewText:
MARY: Oh, wait!
We haven't done
the interview!

entries.LavRadioTower1FReceptionistText:
Welcome!
Feel free to look

around anywhere on
this floor.
entries.LavRadioTower1FOfficerText:
Sorry, but you can
only tour the
ground floor.

Ever since JOHTO's
RADIO TOWER was

taken over by a
criminal gang, we

have had to step
up our security.
entries.LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd1Text:
Many people are
hard at work here

in the RADIO
TOWER.

They must be doing
their best to put
on good shows.
entries.LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText:
Oh, no, no, no!

We've been off the
air ever since the

POWER PLANT shut
down.

All my efforts to
start this station

would be wasted if
I can't broadcast.

I'll be ruined!
entries.LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_ReturnedMac:
Ah! So you're the
<PLAY_G> who solved

the POWER PLANT's
problem?

Thanks to you, I
never lost my job.

I tell you, you're
a real lifesaver!

Please take this
as my thanks.
entries.LavRadioTower1FGentlemanText_GotExpnCard:
With that thing,
you can tune into

the radio programs
here in KANTO.

Gahahahaha!
entries.LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text:
Hey there!

I am the super
MUSIC DIRECTOR!

Huh? Your #GEAR
can't tune into my

music programs.
How unfortunate!

If you get an EXPN
CARD upgrade, you

can tune in. You'd
better get one!
entries.LavRadioTower1FSuperNerd2Text_GotExpnCar:
Hey there!

I am the super
MUSIC DIRECTOR!

I'm responsible
for the gorgeous

melodies that go
out over the air.

Don't be square.
Grab your music
off the air!
entries.LavRadioTower1FDirectoryText:
1F RECEPTION
2F SALES

3F PERSONNEL
4F PRODUCTION

5F DIRECTOR'S
   OFFICE
entries.LavRadioTower1FPokeFluteSignText:
Perk Up #MON
with Mellow Sounds

of the # FLUTE
on CHANNEL 20
entries.LavRadioTower1FReferenceLibraryText:
Wow! A full rack
of #MON CDs and
videos.

This must be the
reference library.

entries.LavenderMartPokefanMText:
REPEL is a neces-
sity if you are

going to explore a
cave.

Even though I like
exploring, I still

haven't made it to
all the caves.
entries.LavenderMartRockerText:
I heard about a
craftsman who

makes custom BALLS
in the JOHTO town

of AZALEA. I wish
I had some.

entries.LavenderPokecenter1FGentlemanText:
To the north of
LAVENDER is ROCK

TUNNEL. Go through
it to get to the
POWER PLANT.
entries.LavenderPokecenter1FTeacherText:
There's a radio
program that plays
# FLUTE music.

Oh? Ah, your radio
needs an EXPN CARD
to tune into it.
entries.LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText:
If the POWER PLANT
isn't running, the

MAGNET TRAIN won't
run either…

It also means the
RADIO STATION
can't broadcast…
entries.LavenderPokecenter1FYoungsterText_Return:
The DIRECTOR of
the RADIO STATION
sure was happy.

He said they're
back on the air

because the POWER
PLANT is running
smoothly again.

entries.LavenderSpeechHousePokefanFText:
LAVENDER is a
tiny, quiet town

at the foot of the
mountains.

It's gotten a bit
busier since the

RADIO TOWER was
built.

entries.LavenderTownPokefanMText:
That's quite some
building, eh?

It's KANTO's RADIO
TOWER.
entries.LavenderTownTeacherText:
KANTO has many
good radio shows.
entries.LavenderTownGrampsText:
People come from
all over to pay

their respects to
the departed souls
of #MON.
entries.LavenderTownYoungsterText:
You need a #
FLUTE to wake
sleeping #MON.

Every trainer has
to know that!
entries.LavenderTownSignText:
LAVENDER TOWN

The Noble Purple
Town
entries.KantoRadioStationSignText:
KANTO RADIO
STATION

Your Favorite
Programs On-Air
Around the Clock!
entries.SoulHouseSignText:
SOUL HOUSE

May the Souls of
#MON Rest Easy

entries.PryceText_Intro:
#MON have many
experiences in

their lives, just 
like we do. 

I, too, have seen
and suffered much
in my life.

Since I am your
elder, let me show
you what I mean.

I have been with
#MON since

before you were
born.

I do not lose
easily.

I, PRYCE--the
winter trainer--

shall demonstrate
my power!
entries.PryceText_Impressed:
Ah, I am impressed
by your prowess.

With your strong
will, I know you

will overcome all
life's obstacles.

You are worthy of
this BADGE!
entries.PryceText_GlacierBadgeSpeech:
That BADGE will
raise the SPECIAL
stats of #MON.

It also lets your
#MON use WHIRL-
POOL to get across
real whirlpools.

And this… This is
a gift from me!
entries.PryceText_IcyWindSpeech:
That TM contains
ICY WIND.

It inflicts damage
and lowers speed.

It demonstrates
the harshness of
winter.
entries.PryceText_CherishYourPokemon:
When the ice and
snow melt, spring
arrives.

You and your #-
MON will be to-

gether for many
years to come.

Cherish your time
together!
entries.BoarderRonaldSeenText:
I'll freeze your
#MON, so you
can't do a thing!
entries.BoarderRonaldBeatenText:
Darn. I couldn't
do a thing.
entries.BoarderRonaldAfterBattleText:
I think there's a
move a #MON

can use while it's
frozen.
entries.BoarderBradSeenText:
This GYM has a
slippery floor.

It's fun, isn't
it?

But hey--we're
not playing games
here!
entries.BoarderBradBeatenText:
Do you see how
serious we are?
entries.BoarderBradAfterBattleText:
This GYM is great.
I love boarding
with my #MON!
entries.BoarderDouglasBeatenText:
OK. I'll tell you
PRYCE's secret.
entries.BoarderDouglasAfterBattleText:
The secret behind
PRYCE's power…

He meditates under
a waterfall daily

to strengthen his
mind and body.
entries.SkierRoxanneSeenText:
To get to PRYCE,
our GYM LEADER,

you need to think
before you skate.
entries.SkierRoxanneBeatenText:
I wouldn't lose to
you in skiing!
entries.SkierRoxanneAfterBattleText:
If you don't skate
with precision,

you won't get far
in this GYM.
entries.SkierClarissaBeatenText:
No! You made me
wipe out!
entries.SkierClarissaAfterBattleText:
I shouldn't have
been bragging
about my skiing…
entries.MahoganyGymGuideText:
PRYCE is a veteran
who has trained

#MON for some
50 years.

He's said to be
good at freezing

opponents with
ice-type moves.

That means you
should melt him

with your burning
ambition!
entries.MahoganyGymGuideWinText:
PRYCE is some-
thing, but you're
something else!

That was a hot
battle that

bridged the gen-
eration gap!

entries.MahoganyMart1FRageCandyBarText:
Hello, kiddo!

How would you like
some RAGECANDYBAR?

It's the thing to
eat in MAHOGANY!
entries.MahoganyMart1FPharmacistText_LanceEntere:
Arrgh… You found
the secret stair-
way…
entries.MahoganyMart1FBlackBeltText:
Heheh! The experi-
ment worked like a
charm.

MAGIKARP are just
worthless, but

GYARADOS are big
moneymakers.
entries.MahoganyMart1FBlackBeltText_LanceEntered:
Urrgh…

That guy's dragon
#MON are tough…
entries.MahoganyMart1FLanceRadioText:
What took you,
<PLAY_G>?

Just as I thought,
that strange radio

signal is coming
from here.
entries.MahoganyMart1FLanceSplitUpText:
LANCE: <PLAY_G>, we
should split up to

check this place.
I'll go first.

entries.MahoganyPokecenter1FPokefanMText:
What's this? TEAM
ROCKET has come
back?

I saw some men in
black at LAKE OF
RAGE…
entries.MahoganyPokecenter1FYoungsterText:
I stop my #MON
from evolving too
early.

I make them learn
certain moves be-
fore I let them
evolve.
entries.MahoganyPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
#MON do become
stronger when they

evolve, but they
also learn moves
more slowly.

entries.MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseBlackBeltT:
I heard that a red
GYARADOS appeared
at the LAKE.

That's odd, since
even ordinary

GYARADOS are rare
in that lake…
entries.MahoganyRedGyaradosSpeechHouseTeacherTex:
My favorite radio
program? I'd say
#MON MUSIC.

I've been hearing
laughter on the

radio…
It's creepy.

entries.RageCandyBarMerchantTryOneText:
Hiya, kid!

I see you're new
in MAHOGANY TOWN.

Since you're new,
you should try a

yummy RAGECANDY-
BAR!

Right now, it can
be yours for just
¥{d:MAHOGANYTOWN_RAGECANDYBAR_PRICE}! Want one?
entries.RageCandyBarMerchantNoRoomText:
You don't have
room for this.
entries.RageCandyBarMerchantSoldOutText:
RAGECANDYBAR's
sold out.

I'm packing up.
Don't bother me,
kiddo.
entries.MahoganyTownGrampsText:
Are you off to see
the GYARADOS ram-
page at the LAKE?
entries.MahoganyTownGrampsText_ClearedRocketHide:
MAGIKARP have
returned to LAKE
OF RAGE.

That should be
good news for the
anglers there.
entries.MahoganyTownFisherText:
Since you came
this far, take the

time to do some
sightseeing.

You should head
north and check

out LAKE OF RAGE
right now.
entries.MahoganyTownLassText:
Visit Grandma's
shop. She sells

stuff that nobody
else has.
entries.MahoganyTownSignText:
MAHOGANY TOWN

Welcome to the
Home of the Ninja
entries.MahoganyTownRagecandybarSignText:
While visiting
MAHOGANY TOWN, try
a RAGECANDYBAR!
entries.MahoganyGymSignText:
MAHOGANY TOWN
#MON GYM
LEADER: PRYCE

The Teacher of
Winter's Harshness

entries.ManiaText_AskLookAfterShuckle:
I, I'm in shock!

A guy about your
age with piercing

eyes and long hair
came in.

He scared me into
giving him my
prized #MON!

I still have one
left, but what if
he comes back?

You look strong.
Could you look

after my #MON
for a while?
entries.ManiaText_TakeCareOfShuckle:
Oh, thank you!

Take good care of
it, please!
entries.ManiaText_IfHeComesBack:
Oh, no… What'll
I do if he comes
back?
entries.ManiaText_CanIHaveMyMonBack:
Hi! How's my #-
MON?

I think I'm safe
now, so may I have
it back?
entries.ManiaText_ShuckleNotThere:
Hey, you don't
have my #MON
with you.
entries.ManiaText_ShuckleLikesYou:
My #MON has
come to like you.

All right, you
should keep it.

But promise to
be good to it!
entries.ManiaText_SameAsBeingRobbed:
Oh, no, no… That's
the same as being
robbed.
entries.ManiaText_HappinessSpeech:
For #MON, hap-
piness is being

with a person who
treats them well.
entries.ManiaText_ShuckleIsYourLastMon:
If I take my #-
MON back, what are

you going to use
in battle?

entries.MobileBattleRoom_HealText:
Your #MON will
be fully healed
before battle.

entries.MountMoonRivalTextBefore:
<……> <……> <……>

It's been a while,
<PLAYER>.

…Since I lost to
you, I thought

about what I was
lacking with my
#MON…

And we came up
with an answer.

<PLAYER>, now we'll
show you!
entries.MountMoonRivalTextWin:
<……> <……> <……>

I thought I raised
my #MON to be

the best they
could be…

…But it still 
wasn't enough…
entries.MountMoonRivalTextAfter:
<……> <……> <……>

…You won, fair
and square.

I admit it. But
this isn't the
end.

I'm going to be
the greatest #-
MON trainer ever.

Because these guys
are behind me.

…Listen, <PLAYER>.

One of these days
I'm going to prove

how good I am by
beating you.
entries.MountMoonRivalTextLoss:
<……> <……> <……>

I've repaid my
debt to you.

With my #MON,
I'm going to beat

the CHAMPION and
become the world's
greatest trainer.

entries.MountMoonGiftShopLassText:
When the sun goes
down, CLEFAIRY
come out to play.

entries.PokemaniacMillerAfterBattleText:
A while back, this
karate dude wanted

to battle. He was
ridiculously good.

He just thrashed
us silly.

He went in deeper
saying it was for

his training. I
wonder how he is?
entries.SupernerdMarkusBeatenText:
I mistook you for
someone else…
entries.SupernerdMarkusAfterBattleText:
I came to explore
MT.MORTAR, but I

got separated from
my partner…

Did you run into a
trainer who uses a

SEADRA that knows
WATERFALL?

entries.SupernerdHughAfterBattleText:
I'm investigating
MT.MORTAR, but my
pal's gone AWOL.

Have you seen a
trainer who has a

SLOWPOKE that can
use STRENGTH?

entries.MountMortarB1FKiyoIntroText:
Hey!

I am the KARATE
KING!

I train alone here
in the dark!

You!
Battle with me!

Hwaaarggh!
entries.MountMortarB1FTyrogueRewardText:
I… I'm crushed…

My training is
still not enough…

But a loss is a
loss. I admit it.

As proof that you
defeated me, I'll

give you a rare
fighting #MON.
entries.MountMortarB1FKiyoGotTyrogueText:
TYROGUE is a
fighting-type.

It evolves into a
tougher #MON.

Keep up the hard
work. I'll keep
training too.

Farewell!
entries.MountMortarB1FKiyoFullPartyText:
You have no room
in your party!

entries.MrFujisHouseSuperNerdText:
MR.FUJI does live
here, but he's not

home now.

He should be at
the SOUL HOUSE.
entries.MrFujisHouseLassText:
Some cold-hearted
people stop caring
for their #MON.

Grandpa takes in
the poor homeless

#MON and takes
care of them.

entries.MrPokemonIntroText1:
Hello, hello! You
must be <PLAY_G>.

PROF.ELM said that
you would visit.
entries.MrPokemonIntroText2:
This is what I
want PROF.ELM to
examine.
entries.MrPokemonIntroText3:
I know a couple
who run a #MON
DAY-CARE service.

They gave me that
EGG.

I was intrigued,
so I sent mail to
PROF.ELM.

For #MON evolu-
tion, PROF.ELM is
the authority.
entries.MrPokemonIntroText5:
If my assumption
is correct, PROF.
ELM will know it.
entries.MrPokemonsHouse_MrPokemonHealText:
You are returning
to PROF.ELM?

Here. Your #MON
should have some
rest.
entries.MrPokemonText_AlwaysNewDiscoveries:
Life is delight-
ful! Always, new

discoveries to be
made!
entries.MrPokemonsHouse_OakText1:
OAK: Aha! So
you're <PLAY_G>!

I'm OAK! A #MON
researcher.

I was just visit-
ing my old friend
MR.#MON.

I heard you were
running an errand

for PROF.ELM, so I
waited here.

Oh! What's this?
A rare #MON!

Let's see…

Hm, I see!

I understand why
PROF.ELM gave you

a #MON for this
errand.

To researchers
like PROF.ELM and

I, #MON are our
friends.

He saw that you
would treat your

#MON with love
and care.

…Ah!

You seem to be
dependable.

How would you like
to help me out?

See? This is the
latest version of
#DEX.

It automatically
records data on

#MON you've
seen or caught.

It's a hi-tech
encyclopedia!
entries.MrPokemonsHouse_OakText2:
Go meet many kinds
of #MON and

complete that
#DEX!

But I've stayed
too long.

I have to get to
GOLDENROD for my
usual radio show.

<PLAY_G>, I'm
counting on you!
entries.MrPokemonText_GimmeTheScale:
Hm? That SCALE!
What's that?
A red GYARADOS?

That's rare! 
I, I want it…

<PLAY_G>, would you
care to trade it?

I can offer this
EXP.SHARE I got
from PROF.OAK.
entries.MrPokemonText_Disappointed:
That's disappoint-
ing. That happens
to be very rare.
entries.MrPokemonsHouse_ForeignMagazinesText:
It's packed with
foreign magazines.

Can't even read
their titles…
entries.MrPokemonsHouse_BrokenComputerText:
It's a big com-
puter. Hmm. It's
broken.
entries.MrPokemonsHouse_StrangeCoinsText:
A whole pile of
strange coins!

Maybe they're from
another country…

entries.MrPsychicText2:
TM29 is PSYCHIC.

It may lower the
target's SPCL.DEF.

entries.NationalParkLassText:
Look! Check out my
bag!

I printed out my
favorites from my

#DEX and stuck
them on my bag.
entries.NationalParkPokefanFText:
This is MAIL I got
from my daughter.
It cheers me up.
entries.NationalParkTeacher1Text:
Pay attention,
please!

…Oops, I have to
quit thinking like

a teacher all the
time.

You must be a
#MON trainer.

Since you're work-
ing so hard, I

want you to have
this.
entries.NationalParkTeacher1Text_GotQuickClaw:
Let a #MON hold
that QUICK CLAW.

Sometimes it will
strike first
during battle.
entries.NationalParkYoungster1Text:
I'm playing with
stickers I printed
from my #DEX.
entries.NationalParkYoungster2Text:
I get the other
guy's #DEX
sticker if I win.
entries.NationalParkTeacher2Text:
I take walks in
the PARK, but I

never go into the
grass.

Trainers always
want to battle…
entries.NationalParkGameboyKidText:
I'm printing out
my #DEX.

You can also print
out stuff like

MAIL and your PC
BOXES.
entries.SchoolboyJack1SeenText:
The world of
#MON is deep.

There are still
lots of things we
don't know.

But I know more
than you do!
entries.SchoolboyJackTradeMonText:
There is a lot
to learn.

For example…

There are {d:NUM_TMS} kinds
of TMs.

Traded #MON
level up faster.
entries.PokefanfBeverly1SeenText:
My #MON are
simply darling.

Let me tell you
how proud my
darlings make me.
entries.PokefanfBeverly1BeatenText:
I can beat you in
pride, but…
entries.PokefanBeverlyCuteMonText:
I must say, your
#MON are quite
cute, too.
entries.PokefanmWilliamSeenText:
We adore our #-
MON, even if they
dislike us.

That's what being
a FAN is about.
entries.PokefanmWilliamAfterBattleText:
I lost the battle,
but my #MON win

the prize for
being most lovely.
entries.PokefanFBeverlyMarillFriendText:
My friend keeps a
MARILL!

I find them very
endearing.

Oh, I wish for a
MARILL of my own…
entries.LassKriseSeenText:
Hello? Why are you
staring at me?

Oh, a battle?
entries.LassKriseAfterBattleText:
I thought you were
staring at me
because I'm cute!
entries.NationalParkBattleNoticeText:
What is this
notice?

Please battle only
in the grass.

NATIONAL PARK
WARDEN'S OFFICE
entries.NationalParkTrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

Print out MAIL by
opening it then
pressing START.

entries.BugCatchingContestant1AText:
DON: I'm going to
win! Don't bother
me.
entries.BugCatchingContestant2AText:
ED: My PARASECT
puts #MON to
sleep with SPORE.
entries.BugCatchingContestant3AText:
NICK: I'm raising
fast #MON for
battles.
entries.BugCatchingContestant4AText:
WILLIAM: I'm not
concerned about
winning.

I'm just looking
for rare #MON.
entries.BugCatchingContestant5AText:
BENNY: Ssh! You'll
scare off SCYTHER.

I'll talk to you
later.
entries.BugCatchingContestant6AText:
BARRY: You should
weaken bug #MON

first, then throw
a BALL.
entries.BugCatchingContestant7AText:
CINDY: I love bug
#MON.

I guess you must
like them too.
entries.BugCatchingContestant8AText:
JOSH: I've been
collecting bug

#MON since I
was just a baby.

There's no way I'm
going to lose!
entries.BugCatchingContestant9AText:
SAMUEL: If you've
got the time to

chat, go find some
bug #MON.
entries.BugCatchingContestant10AText:
KIPP: I've studied
about bug #MON
a lot.

I'm going to win
for sure.
entries.NationalParkBugContestBattleNoticeText:
What is this
notice?

Please battle only
in the grass.

NATIONAL PARK
WARDEN'S OFFICE
entries.NationalParkBugContestTrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

Print out MAIL by
opening it then
pressing START.

entries.Text_GearIsImpressive:
Wow, your #GEAR
is impressive!

Did your mom get
it for you?
entries.Text_WhatDoYouThinkYoureDoing:
What do you think
you're doing?
entries.Text_ItsDangerousToGoAlone:
It's dangerous to
go out without a
#MON!

Wild #MON
jump out of the

grass on the way
to the next town.
entries.Text_YourMonIsAdorable:
Oh! Your #MON
is adorable!
I wish I had one!
entries.Text_TellMomIfLeaving:
Hi, <PLAY_G>!
Leaving again?

You should tell
your mom if you
are leaving.
entries.Text_CallMomOnGear:
Call your mom on
your #GEAR to

let her know how
you're doing.
entries.Text_ElmDiscoveredNewMon:
Yo, <PLAYER>!

I hear PROF.ELM
discovered some
new #MON.
entries.NewBarkTownRivalText1:
<……>

So this is the
famous ELM #MON
LAB…
entries.NewBarkTownSignText:
NEW BARK TOWN

The Town Where the
Winds of a New
Beginning Blow

entries.OakWelcomeKantoText:
OAK: Ah, <PLAY_G>!
It's good of you

to come all this
way to KANTO.

What do you think
of the trainers

out here?
Pretty tough, huh?
entries.OakLabDexCheckText:
How is your #-
DEX coming?

Let's see…
entries.OakLabGoodbyeText:
If you're in the
area, I hope you
come visit again.
entries.OakOpenMtSilverText:
OAK: Wow! That's
excellent!

You collected the
BADGES of GYMS in
KANTO. Well done!

I was right in my
assessment of you.

Tell you what,
<PLAY_G>. I'll make

arrangements so
that you can go to
MT.SILVER.

MT.SILVER is a big
mountain that is

home to many wild
#MON.

It's too dangerous
for your average

trainer, so it's
off limits. But

we can make an
exception in your
case, <PLAY_G>.

Go up to INDIGO
PLATEAU. You can

reach MT.SILVER
from there.
entries.OakNoKantoBadgesText:
OAK: Hmm? You're
not collecting
KANTO GYM BADGES?

The GYM LEADERS in
KANTO are as tough

as any you battled
in JOHTO.

I recommend that
you challenge
them.
entries.OakYesKantoBadgesText:
OAK: Ah, you're
collecting KANTO
GYM BADGES.

I imagine that
it's hard, but the

experience is sure
to help you.

Come see me when
you get them all.

I'll have a gift
for you.

Keep trying hard,
<PLAY_G>!
entries.OaksAssistant1Text:
The PROF's #MON
TALK radio program

isn't aired here
in KANTO.

It's a shame--I'd
like to hear it.
entries.OaksAssistant2Text:
Thanks to your
work on the #-
DEX, the PROF's

research is coming
along great.
entries.OaksAssistant3Text:
Don't tell anyone,
but PROF.OAK'S

#MON TALK isn't
a live broadcast.
entries.OaksLabPoster1Text:
Press START to
open the MENU.
entries.OaksLabPoster2Text:
The SAVE option is
on the MENU.

Use it in a timely
manner.
entries.OaksLabPCText:
There's an e-mail
message on the PC.

…

PROF.OAK, how is
your research
coming along?

I'm still plugging
away.

I heard rumors
that <PLAY_G> is

getting quite a
reputation.

I'm delighted to
hear that.

ELM in NEW BARK
TOWN 8-)

entries.OlivineCafeStrengthSailorText:
Hah! Your #MON
sure look like
lightweights!

They don't have
the power to move
boulders aside.

Here, use this
and teach them
STRENGTH!
entries.OlivineCafeStrengthSailorText_GotStrengt:
On the sea, the
only thing you can

count on is your
own good self!

I'm so proud of my
buff bod!
entries.OlivineCafeFishingGuruText:
OLIVINE CAFE's
menu is chock full

of hearty fare for
beefy SAILORS!
entries.OlivineCafeSailorText:
Whenever I roll
into this town, I

always visit the
OLIVINE CAFE.

Everything on the
menu makes me feel

stronger. I can't
stop eating!

entries.OlivineCityRivalText:
…

You again?

There's no need to
panic. I don't

bother with wimps
like you.

Speaking of weak-
lings, the city's

GYM LEADER isn't
here.

Supposedly taking
care of a sick

#MON at the
LIGHTHOUSE.

Humph! Boo-hoo!
Just let sick
#MON go!

A #MON that
can't battle is
worthless!

Why don't you go
train at the
LIGHTHOUSE?

Who knows. It may
make you a bit
less weak!
entries.OlivineCitySailor1Text:
Dark roads are
dangerous at
night.

But in the pitch-
black of night,

the sea is even
more treacherous!

Without the beacon
of the LIGHTHOUSE

to guide it, no
ship can sail.
entries.OlivineCityStandingYoungsterPokegearText:
That thing you
have--it's a #-
GEAR, right? Wow,
that's cool.
entries.OlivineCityStandingYoungsterPokedexText:
Wow, you have a
#DEX!

That is just so
awesome.
entries.OlivineCitySailor2Text:
The sea is sweet!

Sunsets on the sea
are marvelous!

Sing with me! 
Yo-ho! Blow the
man down!…
entries.OlivineCitySignText:
OLIVINE CITY

The Port Closest
to Foreign Lands
entries.OlivineGymSignText:
OLIVINE CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: JASMINE

The Steel-Clad
Defense Girl
entries.OlivineLighthouseSignText:
OLIVINE LIGHTHOUSE
Also known as the
GLITTER LIGHTHOUSE

entries.OfferGoodRodText:
OLIVINE is on the
sea!

And if it's on the
sea, there are
bound to be fish!

I've fished here
for 30 years.

Would you like to
face the sea and
fish?
entries.GiveGoodRodText:
Ah, hahah!
We have ourselves
a new angler!
entries.GaveGoodRodText:
Fish aren't found
in the sea alone.

They go wherever
there is water.
entries.DontWantGoodRodText:
Whaaat? You don't
like to fish!?
Incomprehensible!
entries.HaveGoodRodText:
How are things?
Land the big one?

entries.Jasmine_SteelTypeIntro:
…Thank you for
your help at the
LIGHTHOUSE…

But this is dif-
ferent. Please

allow me to intro-
duce myself.

I am JASMINE, a
GYM LEADER. I use
the steel-type.

…Do you know about
the steel-type?

It's a type that
was only recently
discovered.

…Um… May I begin?
entries.Jasmine_BetterTrainer:
…You are a better
trainer than me,

in both skill and
kindness.

In accordance with
LEAGUE rules, I

confer upon you
this BADGE.
entries.Jasmine_BadgeSpeech:
MINERALBADGE
raises #MON's
DEFENSE.

…Um… Please take
this too…
entries.Jasmine_IronTailSpeech:
…You could use
that TM to teach
IRON TAIL.
entries.Jasmine_GoodLuck:
Um… I don't know
how to say this,
but good luck…
entries.OlivineGymGuideText:
JASMINE uses the
newly discovered
steel-type.

I don't know very
much about it.
entries.OlivineGymGuideWinText:
That was awesome.

The steel-type,
huh?

That was a close
encounter of an
unknown kind!
entries.OlivineGymGuidePreText:
JASMINE, the GYM
LEADER, is at the
LIGHTHOUSE.

She's been tending
to a sick #MON.

A strong trainer
has to be compas-
sionate.

entries.OlivineHouseBetaTeacherText:
When my #MON
got sick, the

PHARMACIST in
ECRUTEAK made some
medicine for me.

entries.OlivineLighthouse1FSailorText:
People train at
this LIGHTHOUSE.

It's not easy to
climb because of
all the trainers.
entries.OlivineLighthouse1FPokefanFText:
In the past, #-
MON used to light

the sea around
OLIVINE at night.

The LIGHTHOUSE was
made in honor of
those #MON.

entries.SailorHueySeenText:
Men of the sea are
always spoiling
for a good fight!
entries.SailorHueyUnusedText:
What power!
How would you like

to sail the seas
with me?
entries.GentlemanAlfredSeenText:
Hm? This is no
place for playing.
entries.GentlemanAlfredBeatenText:
Ah! I can see that
you're serious.
entries.GentlemanAlfredAfterBattleText:
Up top is a #-
MON that keeps the
LIGHTHOUSE lit.

But I hear that
it's sick now and

can't be cured by
ordinary medicine.
entries.SailorHueyGiveProteinText:
Man! You're as
tough as ever!

Anyway, here's
that medicine from
before.

entries.BirdKeeperTheoSeenText:
Why are you here?
Are you just going

to gawk? I suggest
that you leave!
entries.BirdKeeperTheoAfterBattleText:
How the heck do
you go up?

I want to visit
the sick #MON,

but I can't get up
there…
entries.SailorTerrellSeenText:
Sailors are both
kind and strong.
How about you?
entries.SailorTerrellBeatenText:
You are both kind
and strong…
entries.SailorTerrellAfterBattleText:
Every time I come
back to OLIVINE, I
visit the GYM.

The GYM LEADER's
#MON type has

changed without me
noticing.
entries.GentlemanPrestonSeenText:
I travel the world
to train my #-
MON. I wish to
battle with you.
entries.GentlemanPrestonAfterBattleText:
JASMINE used to
use rock #MON
like ONIX.

entries.SailorKentSeenText:
JASMINE must be
worried sick about
the #MON here.

She won't even
smile these days.
entries.SailorKentBeatenText:
I can't manage a
smile either…
entries.SailorKentAfterBattleText:
Speaking of sick,
I've heard there's

a good PHARMACY in
CIANWOOD.
entries.LassConnie1SeenText:
JASMINE is this
city's GYM LEADER.

I mean to bring
her back with me.

Nobody had better
get in my way!
entries.LassConnie1AfterBattleText:
Right. Anybody
would be worried
if his or her own
#MON were hurt.

I'll pray for the
#MON here, so

JASMINE can come
back to the GYM.

entries.SailorErnestSeenText:
I wanted to battle
JASMINE, but she's

not up to it now.
So, how about you?
entries.SailorErnestAfterBattleText:
A GYM LEADER isn't
just about being

strong. A LEADER
also needs to be
compassionate.
entries.BirdKeeperDenisSeenText:
We're pretty high
up here. My bird

#MON are in
prime form.
entries.BirdKeeperDenisAfterBattleText:
My #MON learned
how to use FLY in
CIANWOOD.

Well, since I'm a
loser, I'll FLY
across the sea…

entries.JasmineCianwoodPharmacyText:
JASMINE: … This
#MON always

kept the sea lit
at night.

…But it suddenly
got sick… It's
gasping for air…

…I understand
that there is a

wonderful PHARMACY
in CIANWOOD…

But that's across
the sea…

And I can't leave
AMPHY unattended…
entries.JasmineGetSomeMedicineText:
…May I ask you to
get some medicine
for me? Please?
entries.JasmineDontBeOffendedText:
JASMINE: …Um,
please don't be
offended…

…AMPHY will not
take anything from
anyone but me…
entries.JasmineAmphyHowAreYouFeelingText:
JASMINE: …

AMPHY, how are you
feeling?
entries.JasmineThankYouText:
JASMINE: …Oh, I'm
so relieved…

This is just so
wonderful…

Thank you so very,
very much.

…I will return to
the GYM…

entries.OlivineMartCooltrainerFText:
Do your #MON
already know the

move for carrying
people on water?
entries.OlivineMartLassText:
My BUTTERFREE came
from my boyfriend
overseas.

It carried some
MAIL from him.

Want to know what
it says?

Let's see… Nope!
It's a secret!

entries.OlivinePokecenter1FFisherText:
The SAILOR in the
OLIVINE CAFE next

door is really
generous.

He taught my
#MON STRENGTH.

Now it can move
big boulders.
entries.OlivinePokecenter1FTeacherText:
There's a person
in CIANWOOD CITY
across the sea.

I heard him brag-
ging about his
rare #MON.

entries.OlivinePortSailorGetOnBoardText:
We're departing
soon. Please get
on board.
entries.OlivinePortAskBoardText:
Welcome to FAST
SHIP S.S.AQUA.

Will you be board-
ing today?
entries.OlivinePortComeAgainText:
We hope to see you
again!
entries.OlivinePortFlashTicketText:
<PLAYER> flashed
the S.S.TICKET.

That's it.
Thank you!
entries.OlivinePortNoTicketText:
<PLAYER> tried to
show the S.S.
TICKET…

…But no TICKET!

Sorry!
You may board only

if you have an
S.S.TICKET.
entries.OlivinePortMondayShipText:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Monday.
entries.OlivinePortFridayShipText:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Friday.
entries.OlivinePortFishingGuru1Text:
SHELLDER are easy
to catch here.

They're kind of
rare elsewhere.
entries.OlivinePortFishingGuru2Text:
How many RODS do
you have?

Different RODS
catch different
#MON.
entries.OlivinePortYoungsterText:
S.S.AQUA uses jets
to skim over the
waves!
entries.OlivinePortCooltrainerFText:
There are lots of
#MON in KANTO.

I wish I could go…
entries.OlivinePortSailorBeforeHOFText:
We don't want you
to fall into the

sea, so you're not
allowed in.

entries.OlivinePortPassagePokefanMText:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
sails to KANTO on

Mondays and Fri-
days.

entries.OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouseDadText:
Along the way to
CIANWOOD, there

are four deserted
islands.

Bad kids are taken
to the islands as
punishment!
entries.OlivinePunishmentSpeechHouseDaughterText:
Whenever I get in
trouble, Daddy
always scares me.

entries.PalletTownTeacherText:
I'm raising #-
MON too.

They serve as my
private guards.
entries.PalletTownFisherText:
Technology is
incredible!

You can now trade
#MON across
time like e-mail.
entries.PalletTownSignText:
PALLET TOWN

A Tranquil Setting
of Peace & Purity

entries.PewterCityCooltrainerFText:
Have you visited
PEWTER GYM?

The LEADER uses
rock-type #MON.
entries.PewterCityBugCatcherText:
At night, CLEFAIRY
come out to play
at MT.MOON.

But not every
night.
entries.PewterCityGrampsText:
Ah, you came all
the way out here
from JOHTO?

That brings back
memories. When I

was young, I went
to JOHTO to train.

You remind me so
much of what I was

like as a young
man.

Here. I want you
to have this item
I found in JOHTO.
entries.PewterCityGrampsText_GotSilverWing:
Going to new, un-
known places and
seeing new people…

Those are the joys
of travel.
entries.PewterCitySignText:
PEWTER CITY
A Stone Gray City
entries.PewterGymSignText:
PEWTER CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: BROCK

The Rock Solid
#MON Trainer
entries.PewterMuseumSignText:
There's a notice
here…

PEWTER MUSEUM OF
SCIENCE is closed
for renovations…
entries.PewterCityMtMoonGiftShopSignText:
There's a notice
here…

MT.MOON GIFT SHOP
NOW OPEN!

entries.BrockIntroText:
BROCK: Wow, it's
not often that we

get a challenger
from JOHTO.

I'm BROCK, the
PEWTER GYM LEADER.

I'm an expert on
rock-type #MON.

My #MON are im-
pervious to most

physical attacks.
You'll have a hard

time inflicting
any damage.

Come on!
entries.BrockWinLossText:
BROCK: Your #-
MON's powerful at-
tacks overcame my
rock-hard defense…

You're stronger
than I expected…

Go ahead--take
this BADGE.
entries.BrockBoulderBadgeText:
BROCK: <PLAY_G>,
thanks. I enjoyed

battling you, even
though I am a bit
upset.

That BOULDERBADGE
will make your

#MON even more
powerful.
entries.BrockFightDoneText:
BROCK: The world
is huge. There are

still many strong
trainers like you.

Just wait and see.
I'm going to be-
come a lot strong-
er too.
entries.CamperJerrySeenText:
The trainers of
this GYM use rock-
type #MON.

The rock-type has
high DEFENSE.

Battles could end
up going a long

time. Are you
ready for this?
entries.CamperJerryBeatenText:
I have to win
these battles…
entries.CamperJerryAfterBattleText:
Hey, you! Trainer
from JOHTO! BROCK

is tough. He'll
punish you if you

don't take him
seriously.
entries.PewterGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! You're

really rocking.
Are you battling

the GYM LEADERS of
KANTO?

They're strong and
dedicated people,

just like JOHTO's
GYM LEADERS.
entries.PewterGymGuideWinText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making! That GYM

didn't give you
much trouble.

The way you took
charge was really

inspiring. I mean
that seriously.

entries.PewterMartYoungsterText:
Hi! Check out my
GYARADOS!

I raised it from a
MAGIKARP. I can't

believe how strong
it has become.
entries.PewterMartSuperNerdText:
There once was a
weird old man who
sold MAGIKARP.

He was saying the
MAGIKARP from the

LAKE OF RAGE were
excellent.

entries.PewterPokecenter1FTeacherText:
