…Yeah, and the
GYM in CINNABAR's

gone. I was really
amazed.

…Yes? I'm on the
phone. Go away!
entries.PewterPokecenter1FBugCatcherText:
Most #MON get
drowsy if they

hear a JIGGLYPUFF
singing.

There are several
moves that can be

used only while a
#MON is asleep.

entries.PewterSnoozeSpeechHouseGrampsText:
I like snoozing
with the radio on…
…Zzzz…

entries.ElmsLookingForYouText:
Oh, <PLAYER>…! Our
neighbor, PROF.

ELM, was looking
for you.

He said he wanted
you to do some-
thing for him.

Oh! I almost for-
got! Your #MON

GEAR is back from
the repair shop.

Here you go!
entries.MomGivesPokegearText:
#MON GEAR, or
just #GEAR.

It's essential if
you want to be a
good trainer.

Oh, the day of the
week isn't set.

You mustn't forget
that!
entries.IsItDSTText:
Is it Daylight
Saving Time now?
entries.ComeHomeForDSTText:
Come home to
adjust your clock

for Daylight
Saving Time.

By the way, do you
know how to use
the PHONE?
entries.KnowTheInstructionsText:
Don't you just
turn the #GEAR

on and select the
PHONE icon?
entries.DontKnowTheInstructionsText:
I'll read the
instructions.

Turn the #GEAR
on and select the
PHONE icon.
entries.InstructionsNextText:
Phone numbers are
stored in memory.

Just choose a name
you want to call.

Gee, isn't that
convenient?
entries.HurryUpElmIsWaitingText:
PROF.ELM is wait-
ing for you.

Hurry up, baby!
entries.SoWhatWasProfElmsErrandText:
So, what was PROF.
ELM's errand?

…

That does sound
challenging.

But, you should be
proud that people
rely on you.
entries.ImBehindYouText:
<PLAYER>, do it!

I'm behind you all
the way!
entries.NeighborText:
<PLAY_G>, have you
heard?

My daughter is
adamant about

becoming PROF.
ELM's assistant.

She really loves
#MON!
entries.PlayersHouse1FSinkText:
The sink is spot-
less. Mom likes it
clean.
entries.PlayersHouse1FFridgeText:
Let's see what's
in the fridge…

FRESH WATER and
tasty LEMONADE!
entries.PlayersHouse1FTVText:
There's a movie on
TV: Stars dot the

sky as two boys
ride on a train…

I'd better get
rolling too!

entries.PlayersRadioText1:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK! Please tune
in next time!
entries.PlayersRadioText3:
This is DJ MARY,
your co-host!

entries.PlayersNeighborsDaughterText:
PIKACHU is an
evolved #MON.

I was amazed by
PROF.ELM's find-
ings.

He's so famous for
his research on
#MON evolution.

…sigh…

I wish I could be
a researcher like
him…
entries.PlayersNeighborText:
My daughter is
adamant about

becoming PROF.
ELM's assistant.

She really loves
#MON!

But then, so do I!
entries.PlayerNeighborRadioText1:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK! Please tune
in next time!
entries.PlayerNeighborRadioText3:
This is DJ MARY,
your co-host!

entries.Text_BattleReceptionistMobile:
Would you like to
battle over a GAME

LINK cable or by
mobile phone?
entries.Text_TradeReceptionistMobile:
Would you like to
trade over a GAME

LINK cable or by
mobile phone?
entries.Text_ThisWayToMobileRoom:
This way to the
MOBILE ROOM.
entries.Text_BattleReceptionistIntro:
Welcome to CABLE
CLUB COLOSSEUM.

You may battle a
friend here.

Would you like to
battle?
entries.Text_TradeReceptionistIntro:
Welcome to CABLE
TRADE CENTER.

You may trade your
#MON here with
a friend.

Would you like to
trade?
entries.Text_TimeCapsuleReceptionistIntro:
Welcome to CABLE
CLUB TIME CAPSULE.

You can travel to
the past and trade
your #MON.

Would you like to
trade across time?
entries.Text_MustSaveGame:
Before opening the
link, you must
save your game.
entries.Text_LinkTimedOut:
The link has been
closed because of
inactivity.

Please contact
your friend and
come again.
entries.Text_TemporaryStagingInLinkRoom:
We'll put you in
the link room for
the time being.
entries.Text_CantLinkToThePast:
You can't link to
the past here.
entries.Text_TimeCapsuleClosed:
I'm sorry--the
TIME CAPSULE is
being adjusted.
entries.Text_TradeRoomClosed:
I'm sorry--the
TRADE MACHINE is
being adjusted.
entries.Text_BattleRoomClosed:
I'm sorry--the
BATTLE MACHINE is
being adjusted.
entries.Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_Intro:
Hello! You're
<PLAYER>, right?

I have some-
thing for you.
entries.Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_Outro:
We hope to serve
you again.
entries.Text_MysteryGiftDeliveryGuy_NoRoom:
Oh, you have no
space for this.

Stop in at any
#MON CENTER

across the country
to pick it up.
entries.Text_ChangeTheLook:
We need to change
the look here…
entries.Text_LikeTheLook:
How does this
style look to you?
entries.Text_BrokeStadiumRules:
Excuse me!

For STADIUM rules,
please bring six

different #MON,
excluding EGGS.

The six #MON
must be different.

Also, they must
not be holding
identical items.

Please come back
when you're ready.

entries.PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist1:
#COM CENTER and
MOBILE CENTER were

built to satisfy
demands for trades

and battles with
trainers far away

and with total
strangers.
entries.PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist2:
When you linked
with someone by

mobile phone for
the first time,

weren't you
impressed?

When my first try
worked, I was so

impressed that I
got the shakes!
entries.PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileScientist3:
They were able to
build this huge

facility thanks to
advances in wire-
less technology.
entries.PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer1T:
It's a notice
about where MOBILE

ADAPTERS are to be
used…

There's a #COM
CLUB upstairs in

any #MON
CENTER.

There, you can
battle or trade

with a friend far
away by using a
MOBILE ADAPTER.

To link up, your
friend must have

the same kind of
MOBILE ADAPTER as
you.

To use the TRADE
CORNER or read the

#MON NEWS, you
need to phone the
MOBILE CENTER.

You must register
at the MOBILE

CENTER before
connecting there.
entries.PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer2T:
It's a notice
about using the
phone…

Please ensure that
your phone and

MOBILE ADAPTER are
properly linked.

Please make sure
the wireless phone
signal is strong.

Don't touch or
hang up the phone
while linking.

If the server is
busy, it may not

be possible to log
on.

If so, please call
back later.

If you are unable
to log on or don't

understand the
error messages,

call a support
center or read the
instructions.
entries.PokecomCenterAdminOfficeMobileComputer3T:
The ADMINISTRATION
OFFICE received an
e-mail. It says…

<……> <……> <……>

To the #COM
CENTER staff…

Wireless communi-
cation has enabled

#MON trainers
to interact across

the nation. Let's
keep working for

the day when all
the trainers in

the world can link
without barriers!

<……> <……> <……>

entries.PokemonFanClubChairmanDidYouVisitToHearA:
I'm the CHAIRMAN
of the #MON FAN
CLUB.

I've raised over
150 #MON.

I'm very fussy
when it comes to
#MON.

Did you visit just
to hear about my
#MON?
entries.PokemonFanClubChairmanRapidashText:
Good!
Then listen up!

So… my favorite
RAPIDASH…

It… cute… lovely…
smart… unbearably…
plus… amazing… oh…
you think so?…
Too much… wild…
beautiful… kindly…
love it!

Hug it… when…
sleeping… warm and
cuddly… Oh, and…
spectacular…
ravishing… simply
divine…
Oops! Look at the
time! I've kept
you too long!
entries.PokemonFanClubChairmanIWantYouToHaveThis:
Thanks for hearing
me out. I want you
to have this!
entries.PokemonFanClubChairmanItsARareCandyText:
It's a RARE CANDY
that makes #MON
stronger.

I prefer making my
#MON stronger

by battling, so
you can have it.
entries.PokemonFanClubChairmanMoreTalesToTellTex:
Hello, <PLAY_G>!

Did you come see
me about my #-
MON again?

No? Oh… I had more
tales to tell…
entries.PokemonFanClubChairmanHowDisappointingTe:
How disappointing…

Come back if you
want to listen.
entries.PokemonFanClubReceptionistText:
Our CHAIRMAN is
very vocal when it
comes to #MON…
entries.PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyClefairyIsSoAdo:
I love the way
CLEFAIRY waggles

its finger when
it's trying to use

METRONOME.
It's so adorable!
entries.PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyMakingDoWithADo:
I love CLEFAIRY,
but I could never

catch one. So I'm
making do with a

# DOLL that I
found.
entries.PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyTakeThisDollBac:
Oh, I see now. The
girl who lost this

# DOLL is sad…

OK. Could you take
this # DOLL

back to that poor
little girl?

I'll befriend a
real CLEFAIRY on

my own one day.
No worries!
entries.PokemonFanClubClefairyGuyGoingToGetAReal:
You watch. I'm
going to get a

real CLEFAIRY as
my friend.
entries.PokemonFanClubTeacherText:
Look at my darling
BAYLEEF!

The leaf on its
head is so cute!
entries.PokemonFanClubClefairyDollText:
It's a CLEFAIRY!
Huh?

Oh, right. It's a
CLEFAIRY #
DOLL.
entries.PokemonFanClubListenSignText:
Let's all listen
politely to other
trainers.
entries.PokemonFanClubBraggingSignText:
If someone brags,
brag right back!

entries.PowerPlantOfficer1AThiefBrokeInText:
A thief broke into
the POWER PLANT…

What is the world
coming to?
entries.PowerPlantOfficer1CeruleanShadyCharacter:
I just got word
from CERULEAN.

It appears that a
shady character

has been loitering
around.
entries.PowerPlantOfficer1CouldIAskForYourCooper:
Could I ask for
your cooperation?
entries.PowerPlantOfficer1HaveToBeefUpSecurityTe:
We'll have to beef
up our security
presence.
entries.PowerPlantGymGuide1SomeoneStoleAPartText:
Someone made off
with a part that's

essential for the
generator.

Without it, the
new generator's
useless!
entries.PowerPlantGymGuide1GeneratorUpAndRunning:
The generator's up
and running. It's

making electricity
to spare.
entries.PowerPlantGymGuide2PowerPlantUpAndRunnin:
This POWER PLANT
had been abandoned
in the past.

We got it back up
and running to

provide power to
the MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenSadAndFu:
The POWER PLANT's
MANAGER is up
ahead.

But since someone
wrecked the gener-
ator, he's been
both sad and
furious…
entries.PowerPlantOfficer2ManagerHasBeenCheerful:
Since the gener-
ator's been fixed,

the MANAGER has
been cheerful.
entries.PowerPlantGymGuide4MagnetTrainConsumesEl:
The MAGNET TRAIN
consumes a lot of
electricity.

It can't move if
the new generator
isn't operating.
entries.PowerPlantGymGuide4WeCanGetMagnetTrainRu:
All right! We can
finally get the

MAGNET TRAIN
running again.
entries.PowerPlantManagerWhoWouldRuinMyGenerator:
MANAGER: I, I, I'm
ready to blast
someone!

Who would dare
ruin my generator?

I spent so much
time on it!

If I catch him,
he's going to get

a taste of my ZAP
CANNON!
entries.PowerPlantManagerIWontForgiveCulpritText:
MANAGER: I won't
forgive him!

The culprit can
cry and apologize,

but I'll still
hammer him!

Gahahahah!
entries.PowerPlantManagerThatsThePartText:
MANAGER: Ah! Yeah!

That's the missing
PART from my be-
loved generator!
You found it?
entries.PowerPlantManagerTakeThisTMText:
Wahah! Thanks!

Here! Take this TM
as a reward!
entries.PowerPlantManagerTM07IsZapCannonText:
MANAGER: TM07 is
my ZAP CANNON.

It's a powerful
technique!

It's not what any-
one would consider

accurate, but it
packs a wallop!
entries.PowerPlantManagerMyBelovedGeneratorText:
MANAGER: My be-
loved generator!

Keep pumping the
electricity out!

entries.RadioTower1FReceptionistNoToursText:
Hello. I'm sorry,
but we're not
offering any tours
today.
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManAskToPlayText:
Hi, are you here
for the LUCKY NUM-
BER SHOW?

Want me to check
the ID numbers of
your #MON?

If you get lucky,
you win a prize.
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManCheckIfMatchTe:
Let's see if you
have a match.
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManComeAgainText:
Please come back
next week for the
next LUCKY NUMBER.
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManPerfectMatchTe:
Wow! You have a
perfect match of
all five numbers!

We have a grand
prize winner!

You have won a
MASTER BALL!
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManOkayMatchText:
Hey! You've
matched the last
three numbers!

You've won second
prize, an EXP.
SHARE!
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManWeakMatchText:
Ooh, you've
matched the last
two numbers.

You've won third
prize, a PP UP.
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManNoneOfYourIDNu:
Nope, none of your
ID numbers match.
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyNumberManNoRoomForYourP:
You've got no room
for your prize.

Make room and come
back right away.
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanOfferQuizText:
We have a special
quiz campaign on
right now.

Answer five ques-
tions correctly to
win a RADIO CARD.

Slide it into your
#GEAR to play

the radio anytime,
anywhere.

Would you like to
take the quiz?
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion1Text:
Question 1:

Is there a #MON
that appears only
in the morning?
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion2Text:
Correct!
Question 2:

Is this statement
correct?

You can't buy a
BERRY at a MART.
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion3Text:
Bull's-eye!
Question 3:

Does HM01 contain
the move FLASH?
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion4Text:
So far so good!
Question 4:

Is FALKNER the
VIOLET GYM LEADER

who uses bird
#MON?
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanQuestion5Text:
Wow! Right again!
Here's the final
question:

Do GOLDENROD GAME
CORNER's slots

have CHARMANDER
on their reels?
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanYouWinText:
Bingo! You got it!
Congratulations!

Here's your prize,
a RADIO CARD!
entries.RadioTower1FPokegearIsARadioText:
<PLAYER>'s #GEAR
can now double as
a radio!
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanTuneInText:
Please tune in to
our radio shows.
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanWrongAnswerTex:
Oh, dear.
Sorry, but you

got it wrong.
Please try again!
entries.RadioTower1FRadioCardWomanNotTakingQuizT:
Oh. I see. Please
see me if you
change your mind.
entries.RadioTower1FLassText:
BEN is a fabulous
DJ.

His sweet voice
makes me melt!
entries.RadioTower1FYoungsterText:
I love MARY, from
#MON TALK.

I only know what
she sounds like,
though.
entries.GruntM3SeenText:
We've finally
taken over the
RADIO TOWER!

Now everyone will
get to experience

the true terror of
TEAM ROCKET!

We'll show you
how scary we are!
entries.GruntM3BeatenText:
Too strong! We
must watch you…
entries.GruntM3AfterBattleText:
You're too strong.

Our plan could be
ruined. I must
warn the others…
entries.RadioTower1FDirectoryText:
1F RECEPTION
2F SALES

3F PERSONNEL
4F PRODUCTION

5F DIRECTOR'S
   OFFICE
entries.RadioTower1FLuckyChannelSignText:
LUCKY CHANNEL!

Win with #MON
ID numbers!

Trade your #MON
to collect differ-
ent ID numbers!

entries.RadioTower2FSuperNerdText:
You can listen to
the radio any-
where. Tune in!
entries.RadioTower2FTeacherText:
Lullabies on the
radio may make
#MON sleep.
entries.RadioTower2FTeacherText_Rockets:
Why would they
want to take over
the RADIO TOWER?
entries.RadioTower2FBlackBelt1Text:
Sorry. Authorized
personnel only
beyond this point.

It wasn't that way
before.

There's something
wrong with the
DIRECTOR…
entries.RadioTower2FBlackBelt2Text:
Feel free to look
around anywhere.

The DIRECTOR is
nice again, just
as he was before.
entries.GruntM4SeenText:
Three years ago,
TEAM ROCKET was
forced to disband.

But we're making a
comeback here!
entries.GruntM4AfterBattleText:
We won't let you
ruin our plans
for our comeback!
entries.GruntM5SeenText:
We're TEAM ROCKET,
the exploiters of
#MON!

We love being
evil! Scared?
entries.GruntM5AfterBattleText:
We're not always
evil. We just do
whatever we like.
entries.GruntM6SeenText:
Hey, hey! Keep out
of our way!
entries.GruntM6AfterBattleText:
Our EXECUTIVES are
trying to take
this place over.

They have some big
plan. I wonder
what that is?
entries.GruntF2SeenText:
Hahaha!

How boring.
It was far too

easy to take over
this place!

Come on, keep me
amused!
entries.GruntF2AfterBattleText:
You beat me, and
I won't forget it!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaShowIntroductionText:
BUENA: Hi! I'm
BUENA!

Do you know about
a radio program
called PASSWORD?

If you can tell me
the password from

the program, you
will earn points.

Save up those
points and trade

them to that sweet
young lady over

there for some
choice prizes!

Here you go!

It's your very own
point card!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInToMyShowText:
BUENA: Tune in to
my PASSWORD SHOW!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaDoYouKnowPasswordText:
BUENA: Hi!
Did you tune in to
my radio show?

Do you remember
today's password?
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaJoinTheShowText:
BUENA: Oh, wow!
Thank you!

What was your name
again?

…<PLAY_G>, OK!

Come on, <PLAY_G>.
Join the show.
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaEveryoneSayPasswordText:
BUENA: Everyone
ready?

I want to hear you
shout out today's

password for
<PLAY_G>!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaComeBackAfterListeningT:
BUENA: Come back
after you listen

to my show, OK?
Catch ya later!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaAlreadyPlayedText:
BUENA: Sorry…

You get just one
chance each day.

Come back tomorrow
for another try!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaCorrectAnswerText:
BUENA: YIPPEE!
That's right!

You did tune in!
I'm so happy!

You earned one
point! Congrats!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaDidYouForgetText:
BUENA: Aww…
That's not it…

Did you forget the
password?
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaThanksForComingText:
BUENA: Yup! Our
contestant was

<PLAY_G>.
Thanks for coming!

I hope all you
listeners will

come too!
I'll be waiting!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaPasswordIsHelpText:
BUENA: Huh?
Today's password?

HELP, of course!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaCardIsFullText:
BUENA: Your BLUE
CARD's full.

Trade it in for a
fabulous prize!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInAfterSixText:
BUENA: Tune in to
PASSWORD every

night from six to
midnight!

Tune in, then drop
in for a visit!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaNoBlueCardText:
BUENA: Oh? You
forgot to bring
your BLUE CARD?

I can't give you
points if you
don't have it.
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaOfferPhoneNumberText:
BUENA: Oh! Your
BLUE CARD reached

{d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} points today!
That's so wild!

Hmm… There isn't a
prize for hitting
{d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} points, but…

You came by so
often, <PLAY_G>.

I'll make you a
special deal!

How would you like
my phone number?
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaOfferNumberAgainText:
BUENA: <PLAY_G>,
do you want to

register my phone
number?
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaCallMeText:
BUENA: I look
forward to hearing
from you!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaSadRejectedText:
BUENA: Aww… It's a
special prize…
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaYourPhoneIsFullText:
BUENA: <PLAY_G>,
your phone list

has no room left
for me…
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistPointsForPr:
You can cash in
your saved points

for a lovely prize
of your choice!
entries.RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistNoCardText:
You can't trade in
points without
your BLUE CARD.

Don't forget your
BLUE CARD!
entries.RadioTower2FOaksPKMNTalkSignText:
PROF.OAK'S #MON
TALK

The Hottest Show
on the Air!

entries.RadioTower3FSuperNerdText:
We have recordings
of the cries of

all #MON that
have been found.

We must have about
200 kinds.
entries.RadioTower3FGymGuideText_Rockets:
To trainers, #-
MON are their
beloved partners.

It's terrible how
TEAM ROCKET is

trying to control
#MON.
entries.RadioTower3FGymGuideText:
We run 24 hours a
day to broadcast

entertaining pro-
grams.

I'll do my best to
run around the
clock too!
entries.RadioTower3FCooltrainerFPleaseSaveDirect:
The TEAM ROCKET
boss has locked
himself in.

But the DIRECTOR
can open it.

He's up on the
fifth floor.

Please save him!
entries.RadioTower3FCooltrainerFYoureMyHeroText:
Thank you!
You're my hero!

This is a token of
my appreciation.
entries.RadioTower3FCooltrainerFItsSunnyDayText:
It's SUNNY DAY.
It powers up fire-
type moves for a
while.
entries.GruntM7SeenText:
I've been given
strict orders.

I'm to crush any-
one who challenges
TEAM ROCKET!
entries.GruntM7AfterBattleText:
I failed in my
duties…

I'll be docked pay
for this…
entries.GruntM8SeenText:
It feels great
ordering #MON
to commit crimes.
entries.GruntM8AfterBattleText:
I feel lousy over
losing!

Darn it! I hate
useless #MON!
entries.GruntM9SeenText:
Why did the shut-
ter open? Did you

have something to
do with this?
entries.GruntM9AfterBattleText:
What?! You made it
past our men in
the UNDERGROUND?

How could you?
entries.ScientistMarcSeenText:
An unknown child
wandering here?

Who are you?
entries.ScientistMarcBeatenText:
Tch! I took you
too lightly!
entries.ScientistMarcAfterBattleText:
Bwahahaha…

I can transmit as
strong a signal as
I need from here.

entries.RadioTower4FFisherText:
I listened to the
radio while I was
at the RUINS.

I heard a strange
broadcast there.
entries.RadioTower4FDJMaryText:
MARY: Why? Why do
I have to suffer
through this?

MEOWTH, help me!
entries.RadioTower4FDJMaryText_ClearedRockets:
MARY: Oh! You're
my little savior!

Will you take this
as my thanks?
entries.RadioTower4FDJMaryText_GivePinkBow:
MARY: It's just
right for #MON

that know normal-
type moves.
entries.RadioTower4FDJMaryText_After:
MARY: Please tune
into me on PROF.

OAK'S #MON TALK
show.
entries.GruntM10SeenText:
You plan to rescue
the DIRECTOR?

That won't be pos-
sible because I'm
going to beat you!
entries.GruntM10AfterBattleText:
I don't believe
it! I was beaten!
entries.Executivem2SeenText:
Stop! I'm known as
the TEAM ROCKET
fortress!

You're not taking
another step!
entries.Executivem2AfterBattleText:
You've earned my
respect, so here's
some advice.

It's not too late.
You can still turn
back.
entries.GruntF4SeenText:
Don't I think
#MON are cute?

I'll think my
#MON are cute--

after they beat
yours!
entries.GruntF4AfterBattleText:
I love my
beautiful self!

Who cares about
#MON?
entries.ScientistRichSeenText:
Most excellent.

This RADIO TOWER
will fulfill our
grand design.
entries.ScientistRichBeatenText:
Hmmm…

All grand plans
come with snags.
entries.ScientistRichAfterBattleText:
Do you honestly
believe you can
stop TEAM ROCKET?

entries.FakeDirectorTextBefore1:
Y-you! You came to
rescue me?
entries.FakeDirectorTextBefore2:
Is that what you
were expecting?

Wrong!
I'm an imposter!

I pretended to be
the real thing to

prepare for our
takeover.

Do you want to
know where we hid
the real DIRECTOR?

Sure, I'll tell
you. But only if
you can beat me!
entries.FakeDirectorWinText:
OK, OK. I'll tell
you where he is.
entries.FakeDirectorTextAfter:
We stashed the
real DIRECTOR in

the UNDERGROUND
WAREHOUSE.

It's at the far
end of the UNDER-
GROUND.

But I doubt you'll
get that far.
entries.Executivef1SeenText:
Remember me from
the HIDEOUT in
MAHOGANY TOWN?

I lost then, but I
won't this time.
entries.Executivef1BeatenText:
This can't be
happening!

I fought hard, but
I still lost…
entries.Executivef1AfterBattleText:
<PLAYER>, isn't it?

A brat like you
won't appreciate

the magnificence
of TEAM ROCKET.

That's too bad.
I really admire
your power.
entries.RadioTower5FRocketBossBeforeText:
Oh? You managed to
get this far?

You must be quite
the trainer.

We intend to take
over this RADIO

STATION and an-
nounce our come-
back.

That should bring
our boss GIOVANNI

back from his solo
training.

We are going to
regain our former
glory.

I won't allow you
to interfere with
our plans.
entries.RadioTower5FRocketBossAfterText:
How could this be?

Our dreams have
come to naught.

I wasn't up to the
task after all.

Like GIOVANNI did
before me, I will

disband TEAM
ROCKET here today.

Farewell.
entries.RadioTower5FDirectorThankYouText:
DIRECTOR: <PLAY_G>,
thank you!

Your courageous
actions have saved

#MON nation-
wide.

I know it's not
much, but please
take this.
entries.RadioTower5FDirectorDescribeClearBellTex:
There used to be a
tower right here
in GOLDENROD CITY.

But it was old and
creaky.

So we replaced it
with our RADIO
TOWER.

We dug up that
bell during
construction.

I heard that all
sorts of #MON

lived in GOLDENROD
in the past.

Perhaps…

That bell has some
connection to the

TIN TOWER in
ECRUTEAK CITY…

Ah!

That reminds me…

I overheard TEAM
ROCKET whispering.

Apparently, some-
thing is going on
at the TIN TOWER.

I have no idea
what is happening,

but you might look
into it.

OK, I better go to
my OFFICE.
entries.RadioTower5FDirectorText:
DIRECTOR: Hello,
<PLAY_G>!

You know, I love
#MON.

I built this RADIO
TOWER so I could

express my love
of #MON.

It would be nice
if people enjoyed
our programs.
entries.BenText:
BEN: Do you listen
to our music?

entries.RedsMomText1:
Hi!

RED's been away
for a long time.

He hasn't called
either, so I have

no idea where he
is or what he's
been doing.

They say that no
word is proof that

he's doing fine,
but I do worry
about him.
entries.RedsMomText2:
I worry about RED
getting hurt or

sick, but he's a
boy. I'm proud

that he is doing
what he wants to

do.
entries.RedsHouse1FTVText:
They have programs
that aren't shown
in JOHTO…

entries.RedsHouse2FN64Text:
<PLAYER> played the
N64.

Better get going--
no time to lose!
entries.RedsHouse2FPCText:
It looks like it
hasn't been used
in a long time…

entries.SchoolboyDannySeenText:
If trainers meet,
the first thing to
do is battle.
entries.SchoolboyDannyBeatenText:
Awww… I've got a
losing record…
entries.SchoolboyDannyAfterBattleText:
For trainers, it's
a given that we'll

battle whenever we
meet.
entries.CooltrainerfQuinnAfterBattleText:
You're strong.

You obviously must
have trained hard.

entries.Route10Pokecenter1FGentlemanText:
A #MON CENTER
near a cave?

That's mighty
convenient.
entries.Route10Pokecenter1FGymGuideText:
The POWER PLANT's
MANAGER is looking

for a strong #-
MON trainer.

He needs help
getting back

something that
was stolen.
entries.Route10Pokecenter1FGymGuideText_Returned:
I hear TEAM ROCKET
got back together

in JOHTO but fell
apart right away.

I didn't know any-
thing about that.
entries.Route10Pokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
When you go out-
side, you can see

the roof of a big
building.

That's the POWER
PLANT.

entries.HikerJimAfterBattleText:
Hay fever is
making me sneeze!
Ahahah-CHOO!
entries.PokefanmRobertSeenText:
You like #MON,
don't you?

Me too!
entries.PokefanmRobertBeatenText:
I'd have to say
that's my loss.
entries.PokefanmRobertAfterBattleText:
Look what you did
to my #MON…

I won't forget
this…

entries.YoungsterOwenSeenText:
There's no cheat-
ing in #MON.

Let's keep it fair
and square!
entries.YoungsterOwenAfterBattleText:
I fought fair and
square with honor.

I don't regret
this at all.
entries.YoungsterJasonSeenText:
It itches and
tickles a bit when

I wear shorts in
the grass.
entries.YoungsterJasonAfterBattleText:
I'm going to catch
more #MON in
the grass.
entries.PsychicHermanAfterBattleText:
…

I lost while I had
my eyes closed…
entries.PsychicFidelSeenText:
I can see it…

Everything to see
about you…
entries.PsychicFidelAfterBattleText:
Strength in con-
viction…

You're strong be-
cause you believe
in your #MON.

entries.FisherMartinSeenText:
Patience is the
key to both fish-
ing and #MON.
entries.FisherStephenSeenText:
I feel so content,
fishing while lis-
tening to some
tunes on my radio.
entries.FisherStephenAfterBattleText:
Have you checked
out KANTO's radio

programs? We get a
good variety here.
entries.FisherBarneySeenText:
What's most impor-
tant in our every-
day lives?
entries.FisherBarneyBeatenText:
The answer is
coming up next!
entries.FisherBarneyAfterBattleText:
I think electric-
ity is the most

important thing in
our daily lives.

If it weren't,
people wouldn't

have made such a
fuss when the

POWER PLANT went
out of commission.
entries.FisherKyleAfterBattleText:
The tug you feel
on the ROD when

you hook a #-
MON…

That's the best
feeling ever for
an angler like me.

entries.OfferSuperRodText:
I'm the FISHING
GURU's younger
brother.

I can see that you
like fishing.

There's no doubt
in my mind at all!

So? I know I'm
right.
entries.GiveSuperRodText:
Yes, yes. Just as
I thought!

Here, fishing fan!
Take this--it's a
SUPER ROD.
entries.GaveSuperRodText:
Try your hand at
fishing wherever
there is water.

Remember--you can
catch different

#MON using
different RODS.
entries.DontWantSuperRodText:
Huh? My own eyes
deceived me?

entries.PokefanmAlexBeatenText:
How… How dare you
mock royalty!
entries.PokefanmAlexAfterBattleText:
Doesn't everyone
wish to someday be
a king?
entries.PokefanmJoshuaSeenText:
Nihihi! Would you
like to battle my
PIKACHU gang?
entries.PokefanmJoshuaAfterBattleText:
You look like you
have many #MON,

but PIKACHU is
still the best.
entries.BirdKeeperPerrySeenText:
Agility is the key
attribute of bird
#MON.
entries.BirdKeeperPerryBeatenText:
You beat me with
your speed…
entries.BirdKeeperBretSeenText:
Check out my #-
MON. Just look at

their coloring and
their plumage.
entries.BirdKeeperBretAfterBattleText:
If you groom them,
#MON get happy.
entries.HikerKennySeenText:
I should go to
ROCK TUNNEL to get
myself an ONIX.
entries.HikerKennyAfterBattleText:
Geological fea-
tures don't appear
to change.

But they actually
change, little by
little.
entries.Route13TrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

Look! Right there,
at the left side
of the post.
entries.Route13DirectionsSignText:
NORTH TO LAVENDER
TOWN

WEST TO FUCHSIA
CITY

entries.PokefanmCarterSeenText:
Let me tell you,
I had a hard time

catching my prized
#MON.
entries.PokefanmCarterAfterBattleText:
SQUIRTLE, CHARMAN-
DER and BULBASAUR…

I think that's a
well-balanced mix.
entries.BirdKeeperRoySeenText:
My dream is to fly
with my beloved
bird #MON.
entries.BirdKeeperRoyBeatenText:
I can dream, but I
can't ever fly…
entries.BirdKeeperRoyAfterBattleText:
You have #MON
that know the HM

move FLY, don't
you? I envy you.
entries.PokefanmTrevorSeenText:
Hi. Did you know…?

#MON get more
friendly if you

train them in a
place that they
remember.
entries.PokefanmTrevorBeatenText:
Where did I meet
this PSYDUCK?
entries.PokefanmTrevorAfterBattleText:
If only there were
an easy way to

identify where I
got my #MON…

entries.TeacherColetteAfterBattleText:
Before I became a
teacher, I used to

forget a lot of
things.
entries.TeacherHillarySeenText:
On sunny days, I
think that the

kids would rather
be playing in the

schoolyard than
studying in class.
entries.TeacherHillaryAfterBattleText:
Studying is impor-
tant, but exercise
is just as vital.
entries.SchoolboyKippSeenText:
Hang on. I have to
phone my mom.
entries.SchoolboyKippAfterBattleText:
My mom worries so
much about me, I

have to phone her
all the time.
entries.SchoolboyTommyBeatenText:
I forgot to do my
homework!
entries.SchoolboyTommyAfterBattleText:
Sayonara! I just
learned that in my
Japanese class.
entries.SchoolboyJohnnySeenText:
We're on a field
trip to LAVENDER

RADIO TOWER for
social studies.
entries.SchoolboyJohnnyAfterBattleText:
I'm tired of walk-
ing. I need to
take a break.
entries.SchoolboyBillyBeatenText:
Oh, no!
How could I lose?
entries.SchoolboyBillyAfterBattleText:
If #MON were a
subject at school,
I'd be the best!

entries.Route15FuchsiaGateOfficerText:
You're working on
a #DEX? That's

really something.
Don't give up!

entries.CyclingRoadSignText:
CYCLING ROAD

DOWNHILL COASTING
ALL THE WAY!

entries.Route16FuchsiaSpeechHouseSuperNerdText:
If you cruise down
CYCLING ROAD, you

will end up in
FUCHSIA CITY.

entries.Route16GateOfficerText:
CYCLING ROAD
starts here.

It's all downhill,
so it's totally
exhilarating.

It's a great sort
of feeling that

you can't get from
a ship or train.
entries.Route16GateCannotPassText:
Hey! Whoa! Stop!

You can't go out
on the CYCLING

ROAD without a
BICYCLE.

entries.BikerRileySeenText:
Hey, you! You're
from JOHTO, huh?
entries.BikerRileyAfterBattleText:
Don't get cocky,
you JOHTO punk!
entries.BikerJoelBeatenText:
But you don't just
look cool…
entries.BikerJoelAfterBattleText:
I look cool, but
I'm weak, so I'm
not really cool.

I have to train
harder…
entries.BikerGlennSeenText:
Hey! Want to have
a speed battle?
entries.BikerGlennAfterBattleText:
Hands-free riding
is considered cool
on CYCLING ROAD.
entries.BikerCharlesAfterBattleText:
Reckless driving
causes accidents!
Take it easy!

entries.Route17Route18GateCannotPassText:
Hang on! Don't you
have a BICYCLE?

The CYCLING ROAD
is beyond here.

You have to have a
BICYCLE to go on.

entries.BirdKeeperBorisSeenText:
If you're looking
for #MON, you

have to look in
the tall grass.
entries.BirdKeeperBorisAfterBattleText:
Since you're so
strong, it must be
fun to battle.
entries.BirdKeeperBobSeenText:
CYCLING ROAD is a
quick shortcut to
CELADON.
entries.BirdKeeperBobAfterBattleText:
If you don't have
a BICYCLE, you're

not allowed to use
the shortcut.

entries.SwimmermHaroldSeenText:
Have you ever gone
swimming in the
sea at night?
entries.SwimmermHaroldAfterBattleText:
At night, the sea
turns black. It

feels like it will
swallow you up.
entries.SwimmermTuckerSeenText:
Pant, pant…
Just… a little…

farther… to…
FUCHSIA…
entries.SwimmermTuckerAfterBattleText:
I… asked my girl-
friend to swim to
FUCHSIA… Gasp…
entries.SwimmerfDawnBeatenText:
I could beat you
at swimming…
entries.SwimmerfDawnAfterBattleText:
It's a quick swim
between FUCHSIA

and SEAFOAM IS-
LANDS…

Sheesh, some big
man my boyfriend

is! What a wimp!
entries.SwimmermJeromeSeenText:
Swimming?
I'm lousy at it.

I'm just splashing
around in these
shallow waters.
entries.SwimmermJeromeAfterBattleText:
I might be bad at
swimming, but I
love the sea.
entries.Route19Fisher1Text:
Sorry. This road
is closed for
construction.

If you want to get
to CINNABAR, you'd

better go south
from PALLET TOWN.
entries.Route19Fisher1Text_RocksCleared:
I'm all sweaty.
Time for a swim!
entries.Route19Fisher2Text:
Who knows how long
it would take to
move this boulder…
entries.Route19Fisher2Text_RocksCleared:
The roadwork is
finally finished.

Now I can go
fishing again.
entries.CarefulSwimmingSignText:
Please be careful
if you are swim-
ming to SEAFOAM
ISLANDS.

FUCHSIA POLICE

entries.Route19FuchsiaGateOfficerText:
CINNABAR's volcano
erupted.

It hurled boulders
that cut off ROUTE
19 indefinitely.

I wonder if the
people of CINNABAR
are safe…
entries.Route19FuchsiaGateOfficerText_RocksClear:
No CINNABAR citi-
zens were injured

by the eruption.
That's great!

entries.BugCatcherRobSeenText:
My bug #MON are
tough. Prepare to
lose!
entries.BugCatcherRobAfterBattleText:
I'm going to look
for stronger bug
#MON.
entries.BugCatcherEdSeenText:
If you walk in
tall grass wearing

shorts, do you get
nicks and cuts?
entries.BugCatcherEdAfterBattleText:
They'll really
sting when you
take a bath.
entries.BugCatcherDougAfterBattleText:
Bug #MON squish
like plush toys

when you squeeze
their bellies.

I love how they
feel!

entries.SwimmerfNicoleSeenText:
I feel so much
lighter in water.
entries.SwimmerfNicoleAfterBattleText:
Swimming exercises
your full body.

It's really good
for you.
entries.SwimmerfLoriSeenText:
What an impressive
collection of GYM

BADGES. We should
battle!
entries.SwimmerfLoriAfterBattleText:
SURF is no longer
the only HM move
you use in water.
entries.SwimmermCameronSeenText:
I guess it's im-
possible to swim

all the way to
JOHTO.
entries.SwimmermCameronAfterBattleText:
Besides the sea, I
can also swim in
ponds and rivers.
entries.CinnabarGymSignText:
What does this
sign say?

CINNABAR GYM
LEADER: BLAINE

entries.SwimmermSethAfterBattleText:
This arrogant guy
was at CINNABAR's
volcano.
entries.SwimmerfNikkiSeenText:
If I win, you have
to help me with my
suntan lotion!
entries.SwimmerfNikkiAfterBattleText:
I have to watch
out for blemishes
caused by the sun.
entries.FisherArnoldSeenText:
I'm bored by fish-
ing. Let's battle!
entries.FisherArnoldAfterBattleText:
I'll just go back
to fishing…

entries.IndigoPlateauSignText:
INDIGO PLATEAU

The Ultimate Goal
for Trainers!

#MON LEAGUE HQ

entries.Route24RocketSeenText:
Hey, kid! Me am a
TEAM ROCKET member
kind of guy!

Come from another
country, a trainer
number one, me!

Think I did, if
stop the energy,

be big panic for
here people!

Secret it is my
mission, so tell
you I not!

But! If win you do
versus me, a man I

be and mine secret
to you I tell.

Hey, kid! Battle
begin we do!
entries.Route24RocketBeatenText:
Ayieeeh! No, no,
no, believe it I
can't!

Strong very much
be you! Match I am
not to you!
entries.Route24RocketAfterBattleText:
OK. Tell you mine
secret will I.

MACHINE PART steal
by me, hide it I

did in GYM of the
CERULEAN.

Inside water put
it I did. Look for

in water center of
GYM at.

But you forget me
not!

Beat you for sure
will TEAM ROCKET.

Come from JOHTO
will they, mine

friends, yes. Will
revenge they are.
entries.Route24RocketDisappearsText:
…

You say what? TEAM
ROCKET bye-bye a

go-go? Broken it
is says you?

Oh, no! Should I
do what now on
from, me?

entries.Route25MistyDateText:
MISTY: Aww! Why
did you have to

show up and bug us
now?

Do you know what
they call people
like you?

Pests! You heard
me right, pest!

…

…Oh? Those BADGES
you have… Are they
JOHTO GYM BADGES?

If you have eight,
you must be good.

OK, then. Come to
CERULEAN GYM.

I'll be happy to
take you on.

I'm MISTY, the
GYM LEADER in
CERULEAN.
entries.SchoolboyDudleySeenText:
Beat the six of us
trainers to win a
fabulous prize!

Think you've got
what it takes?
entries.SchoolboyDudleyAfterBattleText:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.LassEllenAfterBattleText:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.SchoolboyJoeSeenText:
Here's No. 3!
I won't be easy.
entries.SchoolboyJoeAfterBattleText:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.LassLauraAfterBattleText:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.CamperLloydSeenText:
OK! I'm No. 5.
I'll stomp you!
entries.CamperLloydAfterBattleText:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.LassShannonSeenText:
I'm the last in
line, but I tell
you, I'm tough!
entries.LassShannonAfterBattleText:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
entries.SupernerdPatSeenText:
Mufufufu…

I have nothing to
do with the six-
pack trainers.

I waited here to
beat you when you

were tired out by
all the battles.
entries.SupernerdPatAfterBattleText:
I'm sorry… I won't
cheat anymore…
entries.CooltrainermKevinNuggetText:
You took on one
more battle than

you expected, but
you won anyway.

As promised, you
win a prize.
entries.CooltrainermKevinSeenText:
But after seeing
how you battle, I

want to see how
I'll fare.

How about it? Let
me take you on.
entries.CooltrainermKevinBeatenText:
I've never had a
battle this good!
entries.CooltrainermKevinAfterBattleText:
That was a great
battle!

You and your #-
MON are truly out-
standing!

entries.CooltrainermJakeSeenText:
I'm making my
final preparations

for the #MON
LEAGUE.
entries.CooltrainermJakeAfterBattleText:
It's going to be
tough to win at
the LEAGUE.

I need to do some
more training.

I hear that the
LEAGUE's ELITE

FOUR are tougher
than GYM LEADERS.
entries.CooltrainermGaven3SeenText:
By experiencing
tough battles, you
gain power.
entries.CooltrainermGavenAfterText:
To get to #MON
LEAGUE, you have

to get through
VICTORY ROAD.

But VICTORY ROAD
is tough.

Practically nobody
goes there!
entries.CooltrainerfJoyceSeenText:
Since you've come
this far, you must
be good.

I'm going to give
this battle every-
thing I've got!
entries.CooltrainerfJoyceAfterBattleText:
I've defeated
eight GYM LEADERS,

so I was feeling
confident.

I'll have to try
harder next time.
entries.CooltrainerfBeth1SeenText:
I lost to a train-
er named <RIVAL>.

He was really
strong, but…

It was as if he
absolutely had to
win at any cost.

I felt sorry for
his #MON.
entries.PsychicRichardSeenText:
Wow, look at all
those BADGES!
I'm impressed.

But you're not
satisfied by just

collecting them,
right?
entries.PsychicRichardAfterBattleText:
People and #MON
grow from their
experiences.

Don't get lazy and
complacent.
entries.FisherScottSeenText:
I'm feeling great
today!

I feel like I
could boot even
the LEAGUE CHAMP!
entries.FisherScottAfterBattleText:
Just like in fish-
ing, it's all over

in #MON if you
give up.

entries.Route26HealHouseRestAWhileText:
Your #MON look
a little tired.

You should rest
them a while.
entries.Route26HealHouseKeepAtItText:
There!

Your #MON are
looking good!

Keep at it!

entries.Route27FisherText:
Do you know what
you just did?

You've taken your
first step into
KANTO.

Check your #-
GEAR MAP and see.
entries.CooltrainermBlakeSeenText:
You look pretty
strong.
Let me battle you!
entries.CooltrainermBlakeAfterBattleText:
If you prevail on
this harsh trek,

the truth will be
revealed!

Heh, sorry, I just
wanted to say
something cool.
entries.CooltrainermBrianAfterBattleText:
A good trainer can
recognize other
good trainers.
entries.CooltrainerfReenaSeenText:
You shouldn't
underestimate the

wild #MON in
these parts.
entries.CooltrainerfReenaAfterBattleText:
You're just a kid,
but you're not to

be underestimated
either.
entries.CooltrainerfMeganSeenText:
It's rare to see
anyone come here.

Are you training
on your own?
entries.CooltrainerfMeganAfterBattleText:
I'm checking out
pre- and post-
evolution #MON.

Evolution really
does make #MON
stronger.

But evolved forms
also learn moves
later on.
entries.PsychicGilbertSeenText:
Don't say a thing!

Let me guess what
you're thinking.

Mmmmmmm…

I got it! You're
on the #MON
LEAGUE challenge!
entries.PsychicGilbertAfterBattleText:
With your skills,
you'll do well at
the LEAGUE.

That's what my
premonition says.
entries.BirdKeeperJose2AfterBattleText:
BIRD KEEPERS like
me mimic bird

whistles to com-
mand #MON.
entries.TohjoFallsSignText:
TOHJO FALLS

THE LINK BETWEEN
KANTO AND JOHTO

entries.SandstormHouseWomanText1:
Where are you off
to with #MON?

#MON LEAGUE?

Are your #MON
loyal enough for
you to win?

Let me see…
entries.SandstormHouseWomanLoyalText:
Ah! Your #MON
trusts you very
much.

It's nice to see a
good trainer.

Here. A gift for
your journey.
entries.SandstormHouseSandstormDescription:
TM37 happens to be
SANDSTORM.

It's a move that
inflicts damage on
both battlers.

It's for advanced
trainers only.

Use it if you
dare. Good luck!
entries.SandstormHouseWomanDisloyalText:
If it doesn't come
to trust you some

more, it could be
tough going.

Trust is the tie
that binds #MON
and trainers.

entries.CelebrityText1:
Oh, dear.
You've found me.

Please don't tell
anyone about me.

I'll give you this
for keeping my
secret. Please?
entries.CelebrityText2:
It's tough being a
top celebrity.

Everywhere I go,
people chase me.

I just want to be
left alone…

entries.CatchingTutorialBoxFullText:
#MON hide in
the grass. Who

knows when they'll
pop out…
entries.CatchingTutorialIntroText:
I've seen you a
couple times. How

many #MON have
you caught?

Would you like me
to show you how to
catch #MON?
entries.CatchingTutorialDebriefText:
That's how you do
it.

If you weaken them
first, #MON are
easier to catch.
entries.CatchingTutorialDeclinedText:
Oh. Fine, then.

Anyway, if you
want to catch

#MON, you have
to walk a lot.
entries.CatchingTutorialRepeatText:
Huh? You want me
to show you how to
catch #MON?
entries.Route29YoungsterText:
Yo. How are your
#MON?

If they're weak
and not ready for

battle, keep out
of the grass.
entries.Route29TeacherText:
See those ledges?
It's scary to jump
off them.

But you can go to
NEW BARK without

walking through
the grass.
entries.Route29FisherText:
I wanted to take a
break, so I saved

to record my
progress.
entries.Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForDay:
I'm waiting for
#MON that

appear only in the
daytime.
entries.Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForNight:
I'm waiting for
#MON that

appear only at
night.
entries.Route29CooltrainerMText_WaitingForMornin:
I'm waiting for
#MON that

appear only in the
morning.
entries.MeetTuscanyText:
TUSCANY: I do be-
lieve that this is

the first time
we've met?

Please allow me to
introduce myself.

I am TUSCANY of
Tuesday.
entries.TuscanyGivesGiftText:
By way of intro-
duction, please

accept this gift,
a PINK BOW.
entries.TuscanyGaveGiftText:
TUSCANY: Wouldn't
you agree that it
is most adorable?

It strengthens
normal-type moves.

I am certain it
will be of use.
entries.TuscanyTuesdayText:
TUSCANY: Have you
met MONICA, my
older sister?

Or my younger
brother, WESLEY?

I am the second of
seven children.
entries.TuscanyNotTuesdayText:
TUSCANY: Today is
not Tuesday. That
is unfortunate…
entries.Route29Sign1Text:
ROUTE 29

CHERRYGROVE CITY -
NEW BARK TOWN
entries.Route29Sign2Text:
ROUTE 29

CHERRYGROVE CITY -
NEW BARK TOWN

entries.Route29Route46GateOfficerText:
You can't climb
ledges.

But you can jump
down from them to
take a shortcut.
entries.Route29Route46GateYoungsterText:
Different kinds of
#MON appear
past here.

If you want to
catch them all,

you have to look
everywhere.

entries.Route2GateScientistText:
Are you <PLAY_G>?

I work as PROF.
OAK's AIDE.

I had no idea that
you were out here.

PROF.OAK's LAB is
nearby in PALLET
TOWN.

entries.Route2NuggetHouseFisherText:
Hi! Wow, I'm glad
to see you.

You're the first
visitor I've had
in a long time.

I'm super-happy!
Let me give you a
little present.
entries.Route2NuggetHouseFisherText_GotNugget:
That's a NUGGET.

I can't give you
any nuggets of

wisdom, so that'll
have to do!

entries.FirebreatherOtisSeenText:
Ah! The weather's
as fine as ever.
entries.FirebreatherOtisBeatenText:
It's sunny, but
I'm all wet…
entries.FirebreatherOtisAfterBattleText:
When it rains,
it's hard to get
ignition…
entries.YoungsterWarrenSeenText:
Hmmm… I don't know
what to do…
entries.YoungsterWarrenAfterBattleText:
You looked strong.

I was afraid to
take you on…
entries.YoungsterJimmySeenText:
I can run like the
wind!
entries.YoungsterJimmyAfterBattleText:
I wear shorts the
whole year round.

That's my fashion
policy.
entries.FirebreatherBurtSeenText:
Step right up and
take a look!
entries.FirebreatherBurtAfterBattleText:
The greatest fire-
breather in KANTO,
that's me.

But not the best
trainer…
entries.Route3MtMoonSquareSignText:
MT.MOON SQUARE

Just go up the
stairs.

entries.Text_ThisIsABigBattle:
What? This is a
big battle!
Leave me alone!
entries.YoungsterJoey1SeenText:
I just lost, so
I'm trying to find
more #MON.

Wait! You look
weak! Come on,
let's battle!
entries.YoungsterJoey1BeatenText:
Ack! I lost again!
Doggone it!
entries.YoungsterJoey1AfterText:
Do I have to have
more #MON in

order to battle
better?

No! I'm sticking
with this one no
matter what!
entries.YoungsterMikeySeenText:
You're a #MON
trainer, right?

Then you have to
battle!
entries.YoungsterMikeyAfterText:
Becoming a good
trainer is really
tough.

I'm going to bat-
tle other people
to get better.
entries.BugCatcherDonSeenText:
Instead of a bug
#MON, I found
a trainer!
entries.BugCatcherDonAfterText:
I ran out of #
BALLS while I was
catching #MON.

I should've bought
some more…
entries.Route30YoungsterText_DirectionsToMrPokem:
MR.#MON's
house? It's a bit
farther ahead.
entries.Route30YoungsterText_EveryoneIsBattling:
Everyone's having
fun battling!
You should too!
entries.Route30CooltrainerFText:
I'm not a trainer.

But if you look
one in the eyes,
prepare to battle.
entries.Route30TrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

No stealing other
people's #MON!

# BALLS are to
be thrown only at
wild #MON!
entries.YoungsterJoeyText_GiveHPUpAfterBattle:
I lost again…
Gee, you're tough!

Oh yeah, I almost
forgot that I had
to give you this.

Use it to get even
tougher, OK?

I'm going to get
tougher too.

entries.Route30BerrySpeechHouseMonEatBerriesText:
You know, #MON
eat BERRIES.

Well, my #MON
got healthier by
eating a BERRY.

Here. I'll share
one with you!
entries.Route30BerrySpeechHouseCheckTreesText:
Check trees for
BERRIES. They just
drop right off.

entries.Route31CooltrainerMText:
DARK CAVE…

If #MON could
light it up, I'd
explore it.
entries.BugCatcherWade1SeenText:
I caught a bunch
of #MON. Let me
battle with you!
entries.BugCatcherWade1AfterText:
You can catch
#MON even if

you have six with
you.

If you catch one,
it'll go to your
BOX automatically.
entries.Text_Route31SleepyMan:
… Hnuurg… Huh?

I walked too far
today looking for
#MON.

My feet hurt and
I'm sleepy…

If I were a wild
#MON, I'd be
easy to catch…

…Zzzz…
entries.Text_Route31SleepyManGotMail:
…Zzzz… Huh?

What's that? You
have MAIL for me?
entries.Text_Route31HandOverMailMon:
<PLAYER> handed
over the #MON
holding the MAIL.
entries.Text_Route31ReadingMail:
Let's see…

…DARK CAVE leads
to another road…

That's good to
know.

Thanks for bring-
ing this to me.

My friend's a good
guy, and you're
swell too!

I'd like to do
something good in
return too!

I know! I want you
to have this!
entries.Text_Route31DescribeNightmare:
TM50 is NIGHTMARE.

It's a wicked move
that steadily cuts

the HP of a sleep-
ing enemy.

Ooooh…
That's scary…

I don't want to
have bad dreams.
entries.Text_Route31MissingMail:
Why is this #-
MON so special?

It doesn't have
any MAIL.
entries.Text_Route31CantTakeLastMon:
If I take that
#MON from you,

what are you going
to use in battle?
entries.Route31YoungsterText:
I found a good
#MON in DARK
CAVE.

I'm going to raise
it to take on
FALKNER.

He's the leader of
VIOLET CITY's GYM.

entries.Route31VioletGateOfficerText:
Hi there!
Did you visit
SPROUT TOWER?
entries.Route31VioletGateCooltrainerFText:
I came too far
out. I'd better
phone home!

entries.Route32CooltrainerMText_AideIsWaiting:
<PLAYER>, right?
Some guy wearing

glasses was look-
ing for you.

See for yourself.
He's waiting for

you at the #MON
CENTER.
entries.Route32CooltrainerMText_UnusedSproutTowe:
Have you gone to
SPROUT TOWER?

If you ever visit
VIOLET CITY, 

they'll expect you
to train there.

That's basic for
trainers. Go to
SPROUT TOWER!
entries.Route32CooltrainerMText_VioletGym:
Have you gone to
the #MON GYM?

You can test your
#MON and your-
self there.

It's a rite of
passage for all
trainers!
entries.Route32CooltrainerMText_HaveThisSeed:
You have some good
#MON there.

It must be from
the training you

gave them around
VIOLET CITY.

The training at
the GYM must have

been especially
helpful.

As a souvenir of
VIOLET CITY, take
this.

It increases the
power of grass-
type moves.
entries.Route32CooltrainerMText_ExperiencesShoul:
Your experiences
in VIOLET CITY

should be useful
for your journey.
entries.Text_MillionDollarSlowpokeTail:
How would you like
to have this

tasty, nutritious
SLOWPOKETAIL?

For you right now,
just ¥1,000,000!

You'll want this!
entries.Text_ThoughtKidsWereLoaded:
Tch! I thought
kids these days
were loaded…
entries.Text_RefusedToBuySlowpokeTail:
You don't want it?
Then scram. Shoo!
entries.FisherJustinSeenText:
Whoa!

You made me lose
that fish!
entries.FisherJustinAfterText:
Calm, collected…
The essence of

fishing and #-
MON is the same.
entries.FisherRalph1SeenText:
I'm really good at
both fishing and
#MON.

I'm not about to
lose to any kid!
entries.FisherRalph1BeatenText:
Tch! I tried to
rush things…
entries.FisherRalphAfterText:
Fishing is a life-
long passion.

#MON are life-
long friends!
entries.FisherRalphSwarmText:
One, two, three…
Muahahaha, what a

great haul!
I'm done! Go ahead

and catch as many
as you can, kid!
entries.Route32UnusedFisher1SeenText:
I keep catching
the same #MON…

Maybe a battle
will turn things
around for me.
entries.Route32UnusedFisher1BeatenText:
Nothing ever goes
right for me now…
entries.Route32UnusedFisher1AfterText:
How come the guy
next to me catches
good #MON?
entries.Route32UnusedFisher2SeenText:
Heh, I'm on a roll
today. How about a
battle, kid?
entries.Route32UnusedFisher2BeatenText:
Oof. I wasn't
lucky that time.
entries.Route32UnusedFisher2AfterText:
You have to have a
good ROD if you

want to catch good
#MON.
entries.FisherHenryAfterText:
Freshly caught
#MON are no

match for properly
raised ones.
entries.YoungsterAlbertSeenText:
I haven't seen you
around before.

So you think you
are pretty tough?
entries.YoungsterAlbertAfterText:
I'm going to try
to be the best
with my favorites.

I'm not using the
same tough #MON
as everyone else.
entries.YoungsterGordonSeenText:
I found some good
#MON in the
grass!

I think they'll do
it for me!
entries.YoungsterGordonBeatenText:
Darn. I thought I
could win.
entries.YoungsterGordonAfterText:
The grass is full
of clingy things.
entries.CamperRolandAfterText:
If you don't want
to battle, just
avoid eye contact.
entries.PicnickerLiz1SeenText:
Uh-huh. Yeah, and
you know…

Pardon? Battle?
I'm on the phone.

Oh, all right. But
make it fast.
entries.PicnickerLiz1BeatenText:
Oh! I've got to
relieve my anger!
entries.PicnickerLiz1AfterText:
I was having a
nice chat too.
entries.BirdKeeperPeterSeenText:
That BADGE! It's
from VIOLET CITY!

You beat FALKNER?
entries.BirdKeeperPeterBeatenText:
I know what my
weaknesses are.
entries.BirdKeeperPeterAfterText:
I should train
again at the GYM
in VIOLET CITY.
entries.Route32UnusedText:
The fishermen
yelled at me for
bugging them…
entries.Text_RoarIntro:
WROOOOAR!
PEOPLE RUN WHEN I

ROAR! BUT YOU
CAME LOOKING!

THAT PLEASES ME!
NOW TAKE THIS!
entries.Text_RoarOutro:
WROOOAR!
IT'S ROAR!

EVEN #MON RUN
FROM A GOOD ROAR!
entries.MeetFriedaText:
FRIEDA: Yahoo!
It's Friday!

I'm FRIEDA of
Friday!

Nice to meet you!
entries.FriedaGivesGiftText:
Here's a POISON
BARB for you!
entries.FriedaGaveGiftText:
FRIEDA: Give it to
a #MON that has
poison-type moves.

Oh!

It's wicked!

You'll be shocked
how good it makes
poison moves!
entries.FriedaFridayText:
FRIEDA: Hiya! What
day do you like?

I love Friday. No
doubt about it!

Don't you think
it's great too?
entries.FriedaNotFridayText:
FRIEDA: Isn't it
Friday today?

It's so boring
when it's not!

entries.Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Quest:
This is a great
fishing spot.

You saw people
fishing? How
about you?

Would you like one
of my RODS?
entries.Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Yes:
Heh, that's good
to hear.

Now you're an
angler too!
entries.Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_GiveO:
Fishing is great!

If there's water,
be it the sea or a

stream, try out
your ROD.
entries.Route32Pokecenter1FFishingGuruText_After:
Yo, kid. How are
they biting?
entries.Route32Pokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
What should I make
my #MON hold?

Maybe an item that
increases ATTACK
power…

entries.Route32RuinsOfAlphGateOfficerText:
RUINS OF ALPH

A Look-and-Touch
Tourist Site

Try the sliding
stone panels!
entries.Route32RuinsOfAlphGatePokefanMText:
You're studying
the RUINS?

I see a scientist
in the making.
entries.Route32RuinsOfAlphGateYoungsterText:
There are drawings
on stone panels.

I tried moving
them. I wonder
what they are.

entries.HikerAnthony2SeenText:
I came through the
tunnel, but I

still have plenty
of energy left.
entries.HikerAnthony2BeatenText:
Whoa! You've got
more zip than me!
entries.HikerAnthony2AfterText:
We HIKERS are at
our best in the
mountains.
entries.HikerAnthonyDunsparceText:
Hey, did you get a
DUNSPARCE?

I caught one too.

Take a look at it
in the light. It's
got a funny face!
entries.Route33LassText:
Pant, pant…

I finally got
through that cave.

It was much bigger
than I'd expected.

I got too tired to
explore the whole

thing, so I came
outside.

entries.YoungsterSamuelSeenText:
This is where I do
my training!
entries.YoungsterSamuelMobileText:
Have you been to
GOLDENROD CITY?

Weren't you amazed
by how they've

changed the
#MON CENTER?
entries.YoungsterSamuelAfterText:
I'm going to train
even harder.

After all, I'm
trying to become
a GYM LEADER.
entries.YoungsterIanSeenText:
I'm the best in my
class at #MON.
entries.YoungsterIanBeatenText:
No! There are bet-
ter trainers…
entries.YoungsterIanAfterText:
I'm trying hard so
I can be the star
in my class.
entries.CamperTodd1SeenText:
I'm confident in
my ability to
raise #MON.

Want to see?
entries.CamperTodd1BeatenText:
Did I screw up my
training?
entries.CamperTodd1AfterText:
Maybe I should
take one to a DAY-

CARE. Or maybe use
some items…
entries.CamperToddSaleText:
Shopping under the
sky!

It feels so nice
up on a rooftop.
entries.PicnickerGina1SeenText:
Are you a trainer?

Let's have a
practice battle.
entries.PicnickerGina1BeatenText:
Oh, no! I just
can't win…
entries.PicnickerGina1AfterText:
You're too strong
to be a practice
partner.
entries.OfficerKeithSeenText:
Who goes there?
What are you up
to?
entries.OfficerKeithAfterText:
Yep, I see nothing
wrong today. You

be good and stay
out of trouble.
entries.OfficerKeithDaytimeText:
I'm on patrol for
suspicious indi-
viduals.
entries.PokefanmBrandonSeenText:
I just got my
#MON back from
DAY-CARE.

Let's see how much
stronger it got!
entries.PokefanmBrandonBeatenText:
Why does it end
this way?
entries.PokefanmBrandonAfterText:
My #MON knew
moves I didn't
know it had.

That confounded me
to no end!
entries.CooltrainerfIreneAfterText1:
IRENE: My sister
KATE will get you
for this!
entries.CooltrainerfIreneAfterText2:
IRENE: Isn't this
beach great?

It's our secret
little getaway!
entries.CooltrainerfJennSeenText:
JENN: You can't
beat IRENE and go
unpunished!
entries.CooltrainerfJennAfterText1:
JENN: Don't get
cocky! My sister
KATE is tough!
entries.CooltrainerfJennAfterText2:
JENN: Sunlight
makes your body
stronger.
entries.CooltrainerfKateSeenText:
KATE: You sure
were mean to my
little sisters!
entries.CooltrainerfKateBeatenText:
KATE: No! I can't
believe I lost.
entries.CooltrainerfKateOfferSoftSandText:
KATE: You're too
strong. I didn't
stand a chance.

Here. You deserve
this.
entries.CooltrainerfKateAfterText:
KATE: I'm sorry we
jumped you.

We never expected
anyone to find us

here. You sure
startled us.
entries.Route34SignText:
ROUTE 34

GOLDENROD CITY -
AZALEA TOWN

ILEX FOREST
SOMEWHERE BETWEEN
entries.Route34TrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

BERRY trees grow
new BERRIES
every day.

Make a note of
which trees bear
which BERRIES.
entries.DayCareSignText:
DAY-CARE

LET US RAISE YOUR
#MON FOR YOU!

entries.Route34IlexForestGateTeacherText:
Oh, honey. You're
making a #DEX?

It must be hard if
#MON won't

appear. Try using
this TM.
entries.Route34IlexForestGateTeacher_GotSweetSce:
It's SWEET SCENT.

Use it wherever
#MON appear.

#MON will be
enticed by it.
entries.Route34IlexForestGateTeacher_ForestIsRes:
Something's wrong
in ILEX FOREST…

You should stay
away right now.
entries.Route34IlexForestGateLassText:
Did you see the
shrine honoring
the protector?

It watches over
the FOREST from
across time.

I think that it
must be a grass-
type #MON.

entries.CamperIvanSeenText:
I've been getting
#MON data off

my radio. I think
I'm good.
entries.CamperIvanAfterBattleText:
Music on the radio
changes the moods
of wild #MON.
entries.CamperElliotSeenText:
I'm gonna show my
girlfriend I'm hot
stuff!
entries.CamperElliotBeatenText:
I wish you would
have lost for me…
entries.CamperElliotAfterBattleText:
I was humiliated
in front of my
girlfriend…
entries.PicnickerBrookeSeenText:
My boyfriend's
weak, so I can't
rely on him.
entries.PicnickerBrookeAfterBattleText:
I can count on my
#MON more than
my boyfriend.
entries.PicnickerKimSeenText:
Are you going to
the GYM? Me too!
entries.PicnickerKimAfterBattleText:
The GYM BADGES are
pretty. I collect
them.
entries.BirdKeeperBryanSeenText:
What kinds of
BALLS do you use?
entries.BirdKeeperBryanAfterBattleText:
Some #MON flee
right away.

Try catching them
with KURT's FAST
BALL.

Whenever I find a
WHT APRICORN, I
take it to KURT.

He turns it into a
custom BALL.
entries.JugglerIrwinAfterBattleText:
I was going to
dazzle you with my
prize #MON.

But your prowess
electrified me!
entries.BugCatcherArnieSeenText:
I'll go anywhere
if bug #MON
appear there.
entries.BugCatcherArnieBeatenText:
Huh? I shouldn't
have lost that…
entries.BugCatcherArnieAfterBattleText:
My VENONAT won me
the Bug-Catching

Contest at the
NATIONAL PARK.
entries.BugCatcherArnieYanmaText:
Wow… Look at all
those YANMA!

I'm so blown away,
I can't move.
entries.FirebreatherWaltBeatenText:
Ow! I scorched the
tip of my nose!
entries.FirebreatherWaltAfterBattleText:
The #MON March
on the radio lures
wild #MON.
entries.OfficerDirkAfterBattleText:
You know, night-
time is fun in its
own ways.

But don't overdo
it, OK?
entries.OfficerDirkPrettyToughText:
Your #MON look
pretty tough.

You could go any-
where safely.

entries.Route35GoldenrodGateRandyAskTakeThisMonT:
Excuse me, kid!
Can you do a guy
a favor?

Can you take this
#MON with MAIL
to my friend?

He's on ROUTE 31.
entries.Route35GoldenrodGateRandyThanksText:
You will? Perfect!
Thanks, kid!

My pal's a chubby
guy who snoozes
all the time.

You'll recognize
him right away!
entries.Route35GoldenrodGateRandyWeirdTreeBlocki:
You can read it,
but don't lose it!
ROUTE 31!

Oh, yeah. There
was a weird tree
blocking the road.

I wonder if it's
been cleared?
entries.Route35GoldenrodGateRandySomethingForYou:
Thanks, kid! You
made the delivery
for me!

Here's something
for your trouble!
entries.Route35GoldenrodGateRandyMyPalWasSnoozin:
My pal was snooz-
ing, right? Heh,
what'd I say?
entries.Route35GoldenrodGatePokefanFText:
A strange tree is
blocking the road.

It wriggles around
if you talk to it.

I heard it became
wild when someone

watered it with a
SQUIRTBOTTLE.
entries.Route35GoldenrodGatePokefanFText_FoughtS:
I like the #MON
Lullaby they play
on the radio.
entries.Route35GoldenrodGateFisherText:
I wonder how many
kinds of #MON

there are in the
world.

Three years ago,
PROF.OAK said that

there were 150
different kinds.

entries.Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1GiveParkB:
Here are the PARK
BALLS for the
Contest.
entries.Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1ExplainsR:
The person who
gets the strong-
est bug #MON
is the winner.

You have {d:BUG_CONTEST_MINUTES}
minutes.

If you run out of
PARK BALLS, you're
done.

You can keep the
last #MON you
catch as your own.

Go out and catch
the strongest bug

#MON you can
find!
entries.Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToUseF:
Uh-oh…

You have more than
one #MON.

You'll have to use
@
entries.Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldY:
Fine, we'll hold
your other #MON
while you compete.

#MON you catch.

you want to use,
then come see me.

the North Gate for

the announcement
of the winners.

OK. Please get
back outside and
finish up.

Today's Contest is
over. We hope you

will participate
in the future.
entries.Route35NationalParkGateOfficer1WeHoldCon:
We hold Contests
regularly in the

PARK. You should
give it a shot.
entries.Route35NationalParkGateYoungsterText:
When is the next
Bug-Catching Con-
test going to be?
entries.BugCatchingContestExplanationText:
The Bug-Catching
Contest is held on

Tuesday, Thursday
and Saturday.

Not only do you
earn a prize just

for participating,
you also get to

keep the bug
#MON you may

have at the end of
the contest.

entries.UseSquirtbottleText:
It's a weird tree.
Use SQUIRTBOTTLE?
entries.SudowoodoAttackedText:
The weird tree
doesn't like the
SQUIRTBOTTLE!

The weird tree
attacked!
entries.FloriaText1:
I'm the FLOWER
SHOP's FLORIA!

Listen, listen!

When I sprinkled
water on that

wiggly tree, it
jumped right up!

It just has to be
a #MON.

I bet it would be
shocked out of its

disguise if you
soaked it!

I know! I'll tell
my sis and borrow
her water bottle!
entries.FloriaText2:
When I told my sis
about the jiggly

tree, she said
it's dangerous.

If I beat WHITNEY,
I wonder if she'll

lend me her water
bottle…
entries.RockSmashGuyText1:
Wa-hey!

I was going to
snap that tree

with my straight-
arm punch.

But I couldn't!
I'm a failure!
entries.RockSmashGuyText2:
Did you clear that
wretched tree?

I'm impressed!
I want you to
have this.
entries.RockSmashGuyText3:
That happens to be
ROCK SMASH.

You can shatter
rocks with just a

single well-aimed
smack.

If any rocks are
in your way, just
smash 'em up!
entries.UnusedOddTreeText:
An odd tree is
blocking the way
to GOLDENROD CITY.

I wanted to go see
the huge #MON

CENTER they just
opened…
entries.Route36LassText:
An odd tree is
blocking the way
to GOLDENROD CITY.

It's preventing
me from shopping.

Something should
be done about it.
entries.Route36LassText_ClearedSudowoodo:
That odd tree dis-
appeared without a
trace.

Oh! That tree was
really a #MON?
entries.PsychicMarkSeenText:
I'm going to read
your thoughts!
entries.PsychicMarkAfterBattleText:
I'd be strong if
only I could tell

what my opponent
was thinking.
entries.SchoolboyAlan1SeenText:
Thanks to my stud-
ies, I'm ready for
any #MON!
entries.SchoolboyAlanBooksText:
Darn. I study five
hours a day too.

There's more to
learning than just
reading books.
entries.MeetArthurText:
ARTHUR: Who are
you?

I'm ARTHUR of
Thursday.
entries.ArthurGaveGiftText:
ARTHUR: A #MON
that uses rock-

type moves should
hold on to that.

It pumps up rock-
type attacks.
entries.ArthurThursdayText:
ARTHUR: I'm ARTHUR
of Thursday. I'm

the second son out
of seven children.
entries.ArthurNotThursdayText:
ARTHUR: Today's
not Thursday. How
disappointing.
entries.Route36TrainerTips1Text:
TRAINER TIPS

#MON stats
vary--even within
the same species.

Their stats may be
similar at first.

However, differ-
ences will become

pronounced as the
#MON grow.
entries.Route36TrainerTips2Text:
TRAINER TIPS

Use DIG to return
to the entrance of
any place.

It is convenient
for exploring

caves and other
landmarks.

entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1GiveParkB:
Here are the PARK
BALLS for the
Contest.
entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1ExplainsR:
The person who
gets the strong-
est bug #MON
is the winner.

You have {d:BUG_CONTEST_MINUTES}
minutes.

If you run out of
PARK BALLS, you're
done.

You can keep the
last #MON you
catch as your own.

Go out and catch
the strongest bug

#MON you can
find!
entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1AskToUseF:
Uh-oh…

You have more than
one #MON.

You'll have to use
@
entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldY:
Fine, we'll hold
your other #MON
while you compete.

were left with the

entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1SomeMonOn:
Some #MON can
only be seen in
the PARK.
entries.BugCatchingContestant1BText:
DON: Wow, you beat
me. You're pretty
good.
entries.BugCatchingContestant1BStillCompetingTex:
DON: Luck plays a
big part in this.

You never know
what #MON will
appear.
entries.BugCatchingContestant2BText:
ED: I envy you.
I just couldn't
do it this time.
entries.BugCatchingContestant2BStillCompetingTex:
ED: Maybe you win
with big #MON?
entries.BugCatchingContestant3BText:
NICK: Well done!
I'm going to raise
my #MON better.
entries.BugCatchingContestant3BStillCompetingTex:
NICK: Maybe you
get a higher score

for a #MON of
an unusual color.
entries.BugCatchingContestant4BText:
WILLIAM: You're
the winner? What
did you catch?
entries.BugCatchingContestant4BStillCompetingTex:
WILLIAM: Well, I'm
satisfied because

I caught a #MON
that I wanted.
entries.BugCatchingContestant5BText:
BENNY: Congrats!
You have earned my
respect!
entries.BugCatchingContestant5BStillCompetingTex:
BENNY: I caught a
SCYTHER before,
but I didn't win.
entries.BugCatchingContestant6BText:
BARRY: That #-
MON you caught…
it's awesome!
entries.BugCatchingContestant6BStillCompetingTex:
BARRY: It's easier
to win if you get

a high-level bug
#MON.

But I think they
also consider some
other points.
entries.BugCatchingContestant7BText:
CINDY: You won?
That's great!

Do you feel like
looking for bug
#MON with me?
entries.BugCatchingContestant8BText:
JOSH: I… I can't
believe I lost at
bug-catching…
entries.BugCatchingContestant8BStillCompetingTex:
JOSH: I heard that
somebody won with
a CATERPIE!
entries.BugCatchingContestant9BText:
SAMUEL: Next time,
I'm going to win.
entries.BugCatchingContestant9BStillCompetingTex:
SAMUEL: Darn.
I thought I would
score higher…
entries.BugCatchingContestant10BText:
KIPP: Could you
give me some tips?

I want to study
your style.
entries.BugCatchingContestant10BStillCompetingTe:
KIPP: I study a
lot, but that's

not good enough to
win.
entries.UnusedSilphScope2Text:
I hear there's a
#MON that looks
just like a tree.

You can reveal its
identity using a
SILPHSCOPE 2.
entries.UnusedBugCatchingContestExplanationText:
The Bug-Catching
Contest is held on

Tuesday, Thursday
and Saturday.

Not only do you
earn a prize just

for participating,
you also get to

keep the bug
#MON you may

have at the end of
