entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1WellHoldP:
Uh-oh… Your PACK
is full.

We'll hold on to
your prize, but
only for today.

Please make room,
then come see me.
entries.Route36NationalParkGateOfficer1HeresTheP:
<PLAYER>?

Here's the prize
we were holding
for you.

entries.Route36RuinsOfAlphGateOfficerText:
Don't you wonder
who'd make some-
thing like this?
And why?
entries.Route36RuinsOfAlphGateGrampsText:
Did you see that
strange tree in
the road?

That may explain
why fewer people

are visiting the
RUINS OF ALPH.

entries.TwinsAnnandanne1SeenText:
ANN: ANNE and I
are in this to-
gether!
entries.TwinsAnnandanne1BeatenText:
ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A
little too strong.
entries.TwinsAnnandanne1AfterBattleText:
ANN: I can tell
what my sister and

my #MON are
thinking.
entries.TwinsAnnandanne2SeenText:
ANNE: ANN and I
are in this to-
gether!
entries.TwinsAnnandanne2BeatenText:
ANN & ANNE: Nnn… A
little too strong.
entries.TwinsAnnandanne2AfterBattleText:
ANNE: We share the
same feelings as
our #MON.
entries.PsychicGregSeenText:
#MON can't do a
thing if they are
asleep.

I'll show you how
scary that is!
entries.PsychicGregAfterBattleText:
Putting #MON to
sleep or paralyz-
ing them are good
battle techniques.
entries.MeetSunnyText:
SUNNY: Hi!

I'm SUNNY of Sun-
day, meaning it's
Sunday today!
entries.SunnyGivesGiftText1:
I was told to give
you this if I saw
you!
entries.SunnyGivesGiftText2:
I was told to give
you this if I saw
you!
entries.SunnyGaveGiftText:
SUNNY: That thing…

Um…

… What was it now…

…

Oh! I remember
now!

A #MON that
knows electric

moves should hold
it.

My sis MONICA said
it powers up
electric moves!
entries.SunnySundayText:
SUNNY: My sisters
and brothers are
MONICA, TUSCANY,
WESLEY, ARTHUR,
FRIEDA and SANTOS.

They're all older
than me!
entries.SunnyNotSundayText:
SUNNY: Isn't today
Sunday?
Um… I forgot!

entries.BirdKeeperTobySeenText:
Fly high into the
sky, my beloved
bird #MON!
entries.BirdKeeperTobyBeatenText:
I feel like just
flying away now.
entries.BirdKeeperTobyAfterBattleText:
I plan to train in
CIANWOOD CITY to

teach my #MON
how to FLY.
entries.SchoolboyChad1SeenText:
Let me try some-
thing I learned
today.
entries.SchoolboyChad1BeatenText:
I didn't study
enough, I guess.
entries.SchoolboyChadSoManyTestsText:
I have to take so
many tests, I

don't have much
time for #MON.

So when I do get
to play, I really
concentrate.
entries.LassDana1SeenText:
You seem to be
good at #MON.

If you are, how
about giving me
some advice?
entries.LassDana1BeatenText:
I see. So you can
battle that way.
entries.LassDanaMoomooMilkText:
I know something
good!

MOOMOO FARM's milk
is famous for its
flavor.
entries.BeautyValerieSeenText:
Hi! Aren't you a
cute trainer!

May I see your
#MON?
entries.BeautyValerieBeatenText:
I'm glad I got to
see your #MON!
entries.BeautyValerieAfterBattleText:
When I see #-
MON, it seems to
soothe my nerves.
entries.SailorHarrySeenText:
I've been over-
seas, so I know

about all sorts of
#MON!
entries.SailorHarryAfterBattleText:
All kinds of peo-
ple around the

world live happily
with #MON.
entries.BeautyOliviaSeenText:
Don't you think my
#MON and I are
beautiful?
entries.BeautyOliviaBeatenText:
We drink MOOMOO
MILK every day.
entries.BeautyOliviaAfterBattleText:
MOOMOO MILK is
good for beauty

and health, but
inconveniently,

they only sell a
bottle at a time.
entries.Route38TrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

If a #MON is
trying to evolve,
you can stop it.

Press the B But-
ton during evolu-
tion.

That startles the
#MON and stops
its evolution.

entries.Route38EcruteakGateOfficerText:
Where did you say
you're from?

NEW BARK TOWN?

PROF.ELM lives
over there, right?

You've come a long
way to get here.

entries.SailorEugeneSeenText:
I just got back to
OLIVINE.

So how about a
#MON battle?
entries.SailorEugeneAfterBattleText:
My #MON were
caught and raised
overseas.

They're my compan-
ions on those long
voyages.
entries.PokefanmDerekSeenText:
This is a good
time to brag about
my PIKACHU!
entries.PokefanmDerekBeatenText:
I had no time to
show off PIKACHU…
entries.PokefanMDerekText_NotBragging:
I'm not listening
to your bragging!

We # FANS have
a policy of not

listening to other
people brag!
entries.PokefanfRuthSeenText:
Such darling
#MON.

Let's show our
#MON together
at the same time.
entries.PokefanfRuthAfterBattleText:
Do you know about
baby #MON?

I bet they're just
adorable!
entries.PokefanMDerekPikachuIsItText:
PIKACHU is it!
Don't you agree?
entries.PsychicNormanSeenText:
Let me see what
your #MON are
capable of.
entries.PsychicNormanAfterBattleText:
You know how #-
MON have different
abilities?

People are like
that too. Every-
one has different
potential.
entries.PokefanfJaimeHopeItGetsDarkText:
Ufufufu… I hope it
gets dark soon.
entries.PokefanfJaimeSeenText:
You came at just
the right time.

Let's battle.
entries.PokefanfJaimeAfterBattleText:
I met my MEOWTH at
night, right here
on ROUTE 39.

I'm not sure why,
but it seems to

like it when I
train here.

It seems to become
friendlier by

training here than
anywhere else.
entries.MoomooFarmSignText:
MOOMOO FARM

Enjoy Our Fresh
and Tasty Milk
entries.Route39TrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

Use HEADBUTT on
trees to shake
#MON out.

Different kinds of
#MON drop out
of trees.

Use HEADBUTT on
any tree you see!

entries.Route39BarnTwinMoomooIsSickText:
MOOMOO is sick…

She needs lots of
BERRIES.
entries.Route39BarnRefusedBerryText:
<PLAYER> wouldn't
give a BERRY.

MILTANK looks sad.

entries.FarmerMText_SickCow:
My MILTANK ain't
givin' me milk
n'more.

This here FARM's
got famous milk.

Most everyone
wants a drink.

It'll give me lots
o' milk if'n I

feed it lots o'
BERRIES, I reckon.
entries.FarmerMText_BuyMilk:
How'd you like my
MOOMOO MILK?

It's my pride and
joy, there.

Give it to #MON
to restore HP!

I'll give it to ya
fer just ¥{d:ROUTE39FARMHOUSE_MILK_PRICE}.
entries.FarmerMText_GotMilk:
Here ya go!
Drink up'n enjoy!
entries.FarmerMText_NoMoney:
Sorry, there.
No cash, no sale!
entries.FarmerMText_NoSale:
You don't want it?
Come again, hear?
entries.FarmerMText_Milking:
I best go do my
milkin'.
entries.FarmerFText_InTrouble:
Our milk even goes
out to KANTO.

So if our own
MILTANK won't give

us any milk, we're
in trouble.
entries.FarmerFText_HealedMiltank:
You fixed our
MILTANK, hon. Now

it gives MOOMOO
MILK again.

Here's somethin'
fer your trouble.
entries.FarmerFText_SnoreSpeech:
That there's
SNORE.

It's a rare move
that only works

while the #MON
is asleep.

You best think how
you ought to use
it, hon.

entries.BirdKeeperHankSeenText:
I'm raising my
#MON. Want to
battle with me?
entries.BirdKeeperHankAfterBattleText:
If you have a
specific #MON

that you want to
raise, put it out

first, then switch
it right away.

That's how to do
it.
entries.PicnickerHopeSeenText:
I have a feeling
that I can win.

Let's see if I'm
right!
entries.PicnickerHopeAfterBattleText:
I heard CLEFAIRY
appear at MT.MOON.

But where could
they be?
entries.MtMoonSquareSignText:
MT.MOON SQUARE

Just go up the
stairs.

entries.SwimmermSimonSeenText:
You have to warm
up before going
into the water.

That's basic.
entries.SwimmermSimonAfterBattleText:
CIANWOOD CITY is
a good distance
away from here.
entries.SwimmermRandallSeenText:
Hey, you're young
and fit!

Don't ride your
#MON! Swim!
entries.SwimmermRandallAfterBattleText:
Swimming exercises
your entire body.
It's healthy.
entries.SwimmerfElaineSeenText:
Are you going to
CIANWOOD?

How about a quick
battle first?
entries.SwimmerfElaineAfterBattleText:
I'd say I'm a bet-
ter swimmer than
you. Yeah!
entries.SwimmerfPaulaSeenText:
No inner tube for
me.

I'm hanging on to
a sea #MON!
entries.SwimmerfPaulaAfterBattleText:
While I float like
this, the waves
carry me along.
entries.Route40Lass1Text:
Although you can't
see it from here,

CIANWOOD is across
the sea.
entries.Route40PokefanMText:
Hm! There's a big
building up ahead!

What is it?
entries.Route40PokefanMText_Mobile:
Hm! Look at all
those serious-
looking trainers
streaming in.

What? What?
entries.Route40Lass2Text:
I came to OLIVINE
by ship to see the

sights and soak up
the atmosphere.

Being a port, it
feels so different
from a big city.
entries.Route40StandingYoungsterText:
Have you gone to
the BATTLE TOWER?

I think a lot of
tough trainers

have gathered
there already.

But since you have
so many BADGES,

you shouldn't do
badly at all.
entries.MeetMonicaText:
MONICA: Glad to
meet you. I'm

MONICA of Monday.
entries.MonicaGivesGiftText:
As a token of our
friendship, I have
a gift for you!
entries.MonicaGaveGiftText:
MONICA: It's an
item that raises

the power of fly-
ing-type moves.

You should equip a
bird #MON with
that item.
entries.MonicaMondayText:
MONICA: My broth-
ers and sisters

are all over the
place.

See if you could
find them all!
entries.MonicaNotMondayText:
MONICA: I don't
think today is
Monday. How sad…

entries.Route40BattleTowerGateUnusedText1:
Did you come to
see the BATTLE
TOWER too?

But I guess you
can't go in yet.
entries.Route40BattleTowerGateUnusedText2:
BATTLE TOWER has
opened.

I want to go, but
I haven't thought

up a cool line for
when I win.
entries.Route40BattleTowerGateRockerText:
Are you going to
the BATTLE TOWER?

This is a secret,
but if you win a

whole lot, you can
win special gifts.
entries.Route40BattleTowerGateUnusedText3:
I'm going to train
my #MON so I'll

be all ready for
the BATTLE TOWER.
entries.Route40BattleTowerGateTwinText:
The levels of the
#MON I want to

use are all
different.

I have to go train
them now!

entries.SwimmermCharlieSeenText:
The water's warm
here. I'm loose
and limber.

Sure, I'll take
you on!
entries.SwimmermCharlieAfterBattleText:
Isn't it relaxing
just floating like
this?
entries.SwimmermGeorgeSeenText:
I'm a bit tired.
If I win, lend me
your #MON.
entries.SwimmermGeorgeAfterBattleText:
It's so far to
CIANWOOD.

But it's no easy
return trip to
OLIVINE either.

What should I do?
entries.SwimmermBerkeSeenText:
See those islands
that are blocked
by whirlpools?

There just has to
be a secret!
entries.SwimmermBerkeBeatenText:
What's the secret
to your strength?
entries.SwimmermBerkeAfterBattleText:
It was a dark and
stormy night…

I saw this giant
#MON flying
from the islands.

It was scattering
feathers from its
silver wings.
entries.SwimmermKirkSeenText:
The waves are wild
here.

They tire you out
while you swim.
entries.SwimmermKirkAfterBattleText:
The currents keep
me from reaching
that island.
entries.SwimmermMathewSeenText:
Are you seeking
the secrets of
WHIRL ISLANDS?
entries.SwimmermMathewAfterBattleText:
A secret about
WHIRL ISLANDS…

It's pitch-black
inside!
entries.SwimmerfKayleeSeenText:
I'm on my way to
WHIRL ISLANDS.

I'm going explor-
ing with friends.
entries.SwimmerfKayleeBeatenText:
Is that how you do
it?
entries.SwimmerfKayleeAfterBattleText:
There's supposed
to be a big #-
MON deep beneath
WHIRL ISLANDS.

I wonder what it
could be?
entries.SwimmerfSusieSeenText:
You look so ele-
gant, riding your
#MON.
entries.SwimmerfSusieAfterBattleText:
Wasn't there a hit
song about a boy
riding a LAPRAS?
entries.SwimmerfDeniseSeenText:
The weather is so
beautiful, I'm in
a daze!
entries.SwimmerfDeniseAfterBattleText:
A sunburn is the
worst for skin.

But I don't use a
sunblock.

I won't pollute
the water.
entries.SwimmerfKaraSeenText:
If you need to
rest, just tread
water.

You'll get your
wind back, so you

can keep on going
strong.
entries.SwimmerfKaraBeatenText:
Oh! You have more
energy than I do.
entries.SwimmerfKaraAfterBattleText:
I heard roars from
deep inside the
ISLANDS.
entries.SwimmerfWendySeenText:
At night, STARYU
gather near the
water's surface.
entries.SwimmerfWendyAfterBattleText:
The clusters of
STARYU light up
at the same time.

It's so beautiful,
it's scary.

entries.FisherTullySeenText:
Let me demonstrate
the power of the
#MON I caught!
entries.FisherTullyAfterBattleText:
I want to become
the trainer CHAMP

using the #MON
I caught.

That's the best
part of fishing!
entries.HikerBenjaminSeenText:
Ah, it's good to
be outside!
I feel so free!
entries.HikerBenjaminAfterBattleText:
Losing feels in-
significant if you

look up at the big
sky!
entries.PokemaniacShaneSeenText:
HEY!

This is my secret
place! Get lost,
you outsider!
entries.PokemaniacShaneBeatenText:
I should have used
my MOON STONE…
entries.PokemaniacShaneAfterBattleText:
You're working on
a #DEX?

Wow, you must know
some pretty rare
#MON!

May I please see
it. Please?

entries.Route42EcruteakGateOfficerText:
MT.MORTAR is like
a maze inside.

Be careful. Don't
get lost in there.

entries.PokemaniacBenSeenText:
I love #MON!

That's why I
started--and why

I'll keep on col-
lecting #MON!
entries.PokemaniacBenBeatenText:
How could you do
this to me?
entries.PokemaniacBenAfterBattleText:
What else do I
like besides
#MON?

MARY on the radio.
I bet she's cute!
entries.PokemaniacBrentSeenText:
Hey! Do you have
any rare #MON?
entries.PokemaniacBrentAfterBattleText:
I'd be happy just
to own a single
rare #MON.
entries.PokemaniacRonSeenText:
Would you get
this?

Some <RIVAL> guy
made fun of my
#MON!

Darn it! My #-
MON's great!
entries.PokemaniacRonBeatenText:
My NIDOKING did
pretty right on!
entries.PokemaniacRonAfterBattleText:
It's okay for
people to like

different types
of #MON.

#MON isn't just
about having the
most powerful one.
entries.FisherMarvinSeenText:
I'm in a slump.

Maybe it's the
gear I'm using.

Let's battle for a
change of pace!
entries.FisherMarvinBeatenText:
I lost, but I feel
better anyway.
entries.FisherMarvinAfterBattleText:
KURT's LURE BALL
is the best for

catching hooked
#MON.

It's much more
effective than a
ULTRA BALL.
entries.CamperSpencerSeenText:
I can do so much
with my #MON--
it's super-fun!
entries.CamperSpencerAfterBattleText:
What is going on
at LAKE OF RAGE?

We were planning
to camp there.
entries.PicnickerTiffanySeenText:
Are you going to
LAKE OF RAGE too?

Let's play for a 
little while!
entries.PicnickerTiffanyWantsPicnicText:
I'm having a pic-
nic with #MON.

Won't you join us?
entries.PicnickerTiffanyClefairyText:
Isn't my CLEFAIRY
just the most
adorable thing?
entries.Route43Sign1Text:
ROUTE 43

LAKE OF RAGE -
MAHOGANY TOWN
entries.Route43Sign2Text:
ROUTE 43

LAKE OF RAGE -
MAHOGANY TOWN
entries.Route43TrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

All #MON have
pros and cons

depending on their
types.

If their types
differ, a higher-

level #MON may
lose in battle.

Learn which types
are strong and

weak against your
#MON's type.

entries.RocketText_TollFee:
Hold it there,
kiddo!

The toll is ¥{d:ROUTE43GATE_TOLL}
to go through.
entries.RocketText_AllYouGot:
Then pay what you
have, please.
entries.RocketText_MakingABundle:
He-he-he. We're
making a bundle.

Everyone wants to
see what's going

on up at LAKE OF
RAGE.
entries.OfficerText_FoundTM:
I got chased from
my post by these
thugs in black.

They left this
behind.

It makes me uncom-
fortable. Could
you take it away?
entries.OfficerText_AvoidGrass:
Use this gate to
avoid walking in
the grass.

entries.Route43MahoganyGateOfficerText:
Only people headed
up to LAKE OF RAGE

have been through
here lately.
entries.Route43MahoganyGateOfficerRocketsCleared:
Nobody goes up to
LAKE OF RAGE these
days.

entries.FisherWilton1SeenText:
Aack! You made me
lose a POLIWAG!

What are you going
to do about it?
entries.FisherWiltonHugePoliwagText:
That POLIWAG that
got away…
It was huge.

I swear it must've
been 16 feet long!
entries.FisherEdgarSeenText:
I fish until I
can't anymore.

I also battle
until I drop.

That's my
relationship
with my #MON.
entries.FisherEdgarAfterBattleText:
That's 100 wins
to 101 losses.

I won't battle
again for a while.
entries.BirdKeeperVance1SeenText:
Do you know about
the legendary bird
#MON?
entries.BirdKeeperVanceLegendaryBirdsText:
ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS
and MOLTRES are

the three legend-
ary bird #MON.

I heard there are
other legendary
birds, though.
entries.BirdKeeperVance2BeatenText:
Why can't I ever
beat you?

Oh yeah, here you
go. It's that gift

I couldn't give
you last time.
entries.PsychicPhilAfterBattleText:
It's important to
have conviction
on your side.
entries.PokemaniacZachSeenText:
I'll do anything
to get my hands on
rare #MON!
entries.PokemaniacZachAfterBattleText:
If a #MON has
different colors

from usual, it's
more valuable.

What? You mean
that's not true?
entries.CooltrainermAllenSeenText:
I can tell you're
a good trainer by
looking at you.

I'm good at #-
MON, and I can see
that you are too.
entries.CooltrainermAllenBeatenText:
Tch! It's a total
loss on my part.
entries.CooltrainermAllenAfterBattleText:
Wow. You have a
lot of BADGES.

No wonder you're
so tough.

I wonder if
ECRUTEAK GYM's

MORTY is still in
training?

He really hammered
me.
entries.CooltrainerfCybilSeenText:
You look strong.

Good trainers seek
tough opponents
instinctively.
entries.CooltrainerfCybilBeatenText:
Nope! This won't
do at all.
entries.CooltrainerfCybilAfterBattleText:
We all get better
by experiencing
many battles.

I battled a lot to
become what I am
today--an elite.

entries.HikerErikSeenText:
Be prepared for
anything!

Let me see if your
#MON have been
raised properly!
entries.HikerErikAfterBattleText:
I'll head back to
BLACKTHORN's ICE

PATH and train
some more.
entries.HikerMichaelSeenText:
Yo! You're spunky!
But you know what?

When it comes to
sheer spunkiness,
I'm the man!
entries.HikerMichaelAfterBattleText:
Boy, do I love
HP UP! Mmmm, yum!

I keep drinking my
#MON's!

I can't help it!
entries.HikerParryAfterBattleText:
I'm not much good
at thinking, see?

So, I just plow
ahead with power!
entries.HikerTimothySeenText:
Why do I climb
mountains?

Because they're
there.

Why do I train
#MON?

Because they're
there!
entries.HikerTimothyAfterBattleText:
The best thing to
ever happen to me

was discovering
#MON.
entries.HikerParryGivesIronText:
I just can't find
a way to win!

Keep it up!

Oh, and take this
--it's the gift

you couldn't take
when we last met.
entries.BlackbeltKenji3SeenText:
I was training
here alone.

Behold the fruits
of my labor!
entries.BlackbeltKenjiAfterBattleText:
This calls for
extreme measures.

I must take to the
hills and train in
solitude.
entries.BlackbeltKenjiMorningText:
I'm going to train
a bit more before
I break for lunch.
entries.BlackbeltKenjiNightText:
We had plenty of
rest at lunch, so

now we're all
ready to go again!

We're going to
train again!
entries.CooltrainermRyanSeenText:
What are your
thoughts on rais-
ing #MON?
entries.CooltrainermRyanAfterBattleText:
I see you're rais-
ing your #MON
with care.

The bond you build
will save you in
tough situations.
entries.CooltrainerfKellySeenText:
What is your
battle strategy?

It is foolish to
use strong moves
indiscriminately.
entries.CooltrainerfKellyAfterBattleText:
I'm not in favor
of overly power-
ful moves.

I want to win, but
I also don't want
to harm #MON.
entries.Route45DummyText:
I'm really, really
tough!

Is there anywhere
I can prove how
tough I really am?
entries.CamperQuentinBeatenText:
I was tough at the
BATTLE TOWER…
entries.CamperQuentinAfterBattleText:
Have you been to
the BATTLE TOWER?

I never, ever lose
there, but…

entries.HikerBaileySeenText:
Awright! I'll show
you the power of
mountain #MON!
entries.HikerBaileyBeatenText:
Mercy! You showed
me your power!
entries.HikerBaileyAfterBattleText:
It's over. I don't
mind. We HIKERS
are like that.
entries.CamperTedSeenText:
I'm raising #-
MON too!

Will you battle
with me?
entries.CamperTedAfterBattleText:
I did my best but
came up short.

No excuses--I
admit I lost.
entries.PicnickerErin1SeenText:
I raise #MON
too!

Will you battle
with me?
entries.PicnickerErinAfterBattleText:
I've been to many
GYMS, but the GYM

in GOLDENROD is my
favorite.

It's filled with
pretty flowers!
entries.PicnickerErin2BeatenText:
Aww… I keep losing
all the time!

I'll just have to
try harder!

Anyway, thanks for
battling me again

and again. Here's
that present from
the other time.

entries.Route5PokefanMText:
The road is closed
until the problem

at the POWER PLANT
is solved.
entries.Route5UndergroundPathSignText:
UNDERGROUND PATH

CERULEAN CITY -
VERMILION CITY
entries.HouseForSaleSignText:
What's this?

House for Sale…
Nobody lives here.

entries.Route5CleanseTagHouseGrannyText1:
Eeyaaaah!

I sense a sinister
shadow hovering
over you.

Take this to ward
it off!
entries.Route5CleanseTagHouseGrannyText2:
You were in mortal
danger, but you
are protected now.
entries.Route5CleanseTagHouseTeacherText:
My grandma is into
warding off what

she believes to be
evil spirits.

I'm sorry that she
startled you.

entries.Route5SaffronGateOfficerText:
You're from JOHTO,
aren't you?

How do you like
KANTO? It's nice,
don't you agree?

entries.Route5UndergroundPathEntranceTeacherText:
Many cities in
JOHTO have long

histories. I'd
love to visit!

entries.Route6PokefanMText:
The road is closed
until the problem

at the POWER PLANT
is solved.
entries.Route6UndergroundPathSignText:
UNDERGROUND PATH

CERULEAN CITY -
VERMILION CITY
entries.PokefanmRexSeenText:
My PHANPY is the
cutest in the
world.
entries.PokefanmRexAfterBattleText:
Look how adorable
my PHANPY acts!

Isn't it cute
enough to make
your heart melt?
entries.PokefanmAllanSeenText:
My TEDDIURSA is
the cutest in the
world.
entries.PokefanmAllanAfterBattleText:
Look how adorable
my TEDDIURSA acts!

Isn't it cute
enough to make
your heart melt?

entries.Route6SaffronGuardWelcomeText:
Welcome to SAFFRON
CITY, home of the
MAGNET TRAIN!

…That's what I'd
normally say, but

the MAGNET TRAIN
isn't running now.

It's not getting
any electricity

because there's
something wrong

with the POWER
PLANT.
entries.Route6SaffronGuardMagnetTrainText:
The MAGNET TRAIN
is the most famous

thing about SAF-
FRON.

entries.Route7UndergroundPathSignText:
What's this flyer?

… Uncouth trainers
have been holding

battles in the
UNDERGROUND PATH.

Because of rising
complaints by lo-
cal residents, the
UNDERGROUND PATH
has been sealed
indefinitely.

CELADON POLICE

entries.Route7SaffronGuardPowerPlantText:
Did you hear about
the accident at
the POWER PLANT?

It's located in
the East, close to
LAVENDER TOWN.
entries.Route7SaffronGuardSeriousText:
I take my GUARD
job seriously.

Hey! You have a
#DEX.

OK. You can go
through.

entries.BikerDwayneSeenText:
We're the KANTO
#MON FEDERATION
trainer group.

We'll drive you
under our wheels!
entries.BikerDwayneAfterBattleText:
The KANTO #MON
FEDERATION will
never fall!
entries.BikerHarrisSeenText:
The cops shut down
our UNDERGROUND

PATH! That really
fries me!
entries.BikerHarrisAfterBattleText:
Wiped out by some
punk from JOHTO…
entries.BikerZekeSeenText:
We're the KANTO
#MON FEDERA-
TION!
Right on!
entries.BikerZekeAfterBattleText:
We'll try not to
disturb anyone
from now on…
entries.SupernerdSamSeenText:
How does the MAG-
NET TRAIN work?
entries.SupernerdSamBeatenText:
I just want to see
the MAGNET TRAIN…
entries.SupernerdSamAfterBattleText:
The power of mag-
nets is awesome!
entries.SupernerdTomSeenText:
Hm… You've got
many GYM BADGES.
entries.SupernerdTomBeatenText:
Just as I thought…
You're tough!
entries.SupernerdTomAfterBattleText:
GYM BADGES give
you advantages in
battles.
entries.Route8UndergroundPathSignText:
The flyer's torn.

It's impossible to
read…

entries.Route8SaffronGateOfficerText:
Have you been to
LAVENDER TOWN?

There's a tall
RADIO TOWER there.

entries.CamperDeanSeenText:
I came to explore
ROCK TUNNEL.
entries.CamperDeanAfterBattleText:
My #MON were
hurt before even

entering ROCK
TUNNEL.

I'd better take
them to a #MON
CENTER right away.
entries.PicnickerHeidiSeenText:
Have you ever been
to a picnic?

They're so much
fun!
entries.PicnickerHeidiAfterBattleText:
We bake lots of
goodies and share

them all around.
They're delicious!
entries.CamperSidBeatenText:
I was just point-
ing out…
entries.CamperSidAfterBattleText:
Sorry. You weren't
littering. It was
my mistake.
entries.PicnickerEdnaSeenText:
People shouldn't
leave any litter
behind.
entries.PicnickerEdnaAfterBattleText:
Conserving energy
is important, but

the environment is
even more vital.
entries.HikerTimSeenText:
She'll be coming
'round MT.SILVER
when she comes…

MT.SILVER is in
JOHTO, right?
entries.HikerSidneySeenText:
I'll tell you a
secret.

But first, we
battle!
entries.HikerSidneyAfterBattleText:
The POWER PLANT is
across a small
river.

entries.RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberWallHoleText:
There's a big hole
in the wall!
entries.RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberAncientRepli:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.
entries.RuinsOfAlphAerodactylChamberDescriptionT:
This flying #-
MON attacked its

prey with saw-like
fangs.

entries.RuinsOfAlphAerodactylItemRoomAncientRepl:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.

entries.RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberWallHoleText:
There's a big hole
in the wall!
entries.RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberAncientReplicaText:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.
entries.RuinsOfAlphHoOhChamberDescriptionText:
A #MON that
flew gracefully on

rainbow-colored
wings.

entries.RuinsOfAlphHoOhItemRoomAncientReplicaTex:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.

entries.RuinsOfAlphStrangePresenceText:
There is a strange
presence here…
entries.RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberFisherText:
This is a big
room, but there's
nothing here.
entries.RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberTeacherText:
This place has a
mystical quality
to it.

It feels sort of
ethereal even.
entries.RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberGrampsText:
Ancient buildings
are often tombs of
kings.

Like the pyramids,
for instance.
entries.RuinsOfAlphInnerChamberStatueText:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.

entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberReceptionistText:
Welcome to this
chamber.

There are sliding
panels that depict

a #MON drawn by
the ancients.

Slide the panels
around to form the
picture.

To the right is a
description of the
#MON.

Scientists in the
back are examining

some newly found
patterns.
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistCryptic:
Recently, strange,
cryptic patterns
have appeared.

It's odd. They
weren't here a
little while ago…

You should take a
look at the walls.
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistHoleTex:
Ah! Here's another
huge hole!

It's big enough to
go through!
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberScientistTremorT:
That tremor was
pretty scary!

But I'm more
concerned about
this wall here…
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberUnusedText:
The patterns on
the wall appear to
be words!

And those sliding
stone panels seem

to be signals of
some kind.

I think they make
#MON appear,

but it's not clear
yet…
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberWallHoleText:
There's a big hole
in the wall!
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberAncientReplicaTe:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.
entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoChamberDescriptionText:
A #MON that hid
on the sea floor.

Eyes on its back
scanned the area.

entries.RuinsOfAlphKabutoItemRoomAncientReplicaT:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.

entries.RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberWallHoleText:
There's a big hole
in the wall!
entries.RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberAncientReplicaT:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.
entries.RuinsOfAlphOmanyteChamberDescriptionText:
This #MON
drifted in the

sea by twisting
its ten tentacles.

entries.RuinsOfAlphOmanyteItemRoomAncientReplica:
It's a replica of
an ancient #-
MON.

entries.RuinsOfAlphOutsideScientistText:
Hm? That's a #-
DEX, isn't it?
May I see it?

There are so many
kinds of #MON.

Hm? What's this?

What is this
#MON?

It looks like the
strange writing on

the walls of the
RUINS.

If those drawings
are really #-
MON, there should
be many more.

I know! Let me up-
grade your #-
DEX. Follow me.
entries.SuperNerdStanSeenText:
What do you want?
I'm studying--
don't disturb me!
entries.SuperNerdStanBeatenText:
Sorry…
I'm frustrated by

our lack of real
understanding…
entries.SuperNerdStanAfterBattleText:
The RUINS are from
about 1500 years
ago.

Nobody knows who
built them.

It's also not
known if the #-
MON statues have
any meaning.

It's all one big
mystery…
entries.PsychicNathanSeenText:
Hmmm… This is a
strange place.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterSignText:
RUINS OF ALPH
RESEARCH CENTER

THE AUTHORITY ON
THE RUINS OF ALPH
entries.RuinsOfAlphOutsideFisherText1:
While exploring
the RUINS, we

suddenly noticed
an odd presence.

We all got scared
and ran away.

You should be
careful too.
entries.RuinsOfAlphOutsideFisherText2:
The RUINS hide a
huge secret!

…I think…
entries.RuinsOfAlphOutsideYoungster1Text:
There are many
kinds of UNOWN, so

we use them for
our secret codes.
entries.RuinsOfAlphOutsideYoungster2Text:
A… H… E… A… D…
Hmm…

What?

I'm decoding this
message!

entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterModifiedDexText:
Done!

I modified your
#DEX.

I added an
optional #DEX

to store UNOWN
data.

It records them in
the sequence that
they were caught.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist3Text:
The UNOWN you
catch will all be
recorded.

Check to see how
many kinds exist.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist3_Prin:
You caught all the
UNOWN variations?

That's a great
achievement!

I've set up the
printer here for
handling UNOWN.

Feel free to use
it anytime.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text:
The RUINS are
about 1500 years
old.

But it's not known
why they were
built--or by whom.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist1Text_:
I wonder how many
kinds of #MON
are in the RUINS?

#MON appeared
in the RUINS?

That's incredible
news!

We'll need to
investigate this.

Our investigation,
with your help, is

giving us insight
into the RUINS.

The RUINS appear
to have been built

as a habitat for
#MON.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text:
There are odd pat-
terns drawn on the

walls of the
RUINS.

They must be the
keys for unravel-
ing the mystery
of the RUINS.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_:
The strange #-
MON you saw in the
RUINS?

They appear to be
very much like the

drawings on the
walls there.

Hmm…

That must mean
there are many
kinds of them…
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnusedText1:
We think something
caused the cryptic

patterns to appear
in the RUINS.

We've focused our
studies on that.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterUnusedText2:
According to my
research…

Those mysterious
patterns appeared

when the #COM
CENTER was built.

It must mean that
radio waves have

some sort of a
link…
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterScientist2Text_:
Why did those
ancient patterns

appear on the wall
now?

The mystery
deepens…
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterComputerText_Go:
Mystery #MON
Name: UNOWN

A total of {d:NUM_UNOWN}
kinds found.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterPrinterText_Doe:
This doesn't seem
to work yet.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterProfSilktreePho:
It's a photo of
the RESEARCH

CENTER'S founder,
PROF.SILKTREE.
entries.RuinsOfAlphResearchCenterAcademicBooksTe:
There are many
academic books.

Ancient Ruins…
Mysteries of the
Ancients…

entries.WardensGranddaughterText1:
My grandpa is the
SAFARI ZONE WAR-
DEN.

At least he was…

He decided to go
on a vacation and

took off overseas
all by himself.

He quit running
SAFARI ZONE just
like that.
entries.WardensGranddaughterText2:
Many people were
disappointed that

SAFARI ZONE closed
down, but Grandpa
is so stubborn…
entries.WardenPhotoText:
It's a photo of a
grinning old man

who's surrounded
by #MON.
entries.SafariZonePhotoText:
It's a photo of a
huge grassy plain

with rare #MON
frolicking in it.

entries.SaffronCityLass1Text:
A little girl who
is an expert at

mimicking people
lives here.

She even mimics
the people she's

conversing with.
It's confusing.
entries.SaffronCityLass1Text_ReturnedMachinePart:
The COPYCAT girl
looked unhappy.

She said she lost
her favorite #
DOLL--CLEFAIRY.
entries.SaffronCityPokefanMText:
You came out from
JOHTO?

You can zip back
home if the MAGNET
TRAIN's running.
entries.SaffronCityPokefanMText_ReturnedMachineP:
You came out from
JOHTO?

You can zip back
home by hopping on
the MAGNET TRAIN.
entries.SaffronCityCooltrainerMText:
I went to the GYM,
raring for battles
against trainers…

It turns out, I
stumbled into the

unused GYM next
door.

Boy, I was pretty
embarrassed.
entries.SaffronCityCooltrainerFText:
This is SILPH CO.,
famous for #MON
merchandise.

In the past, TEAM
ROCKET wanted the

company because of
that.
entries.SaffronCityFisherText:
Chew… Chew…

I hear there's big
trouble brewing at
the POWER PLANT.

Chew… Chew…
entries.SaffronCityFisherText_ReturnedMachinePar:
Chew… Chew…

I hear there was
big trouble at the
POWER PLANT.

Chew… Chew…
Haaah, I'm full!
entries.SaffronCityYoungster1Text:
Going into an
alley for the

first time makes
me sorta anxious.
entries.SaffronCityYoungster2Text:
There's a place
called TRAINER

HOUSE in VIRIDIAN
where trainers

gather from all
over the place.
entries.SaffronCityLass2Text:
Our city was
featured on a
radio program.

It's nice to hear
praise for your

city, but it's a
bit embarrassing
too.
entries.SaffronCitySignText:
SAFFRON CITY

Shining, Golden
Land of Commerce
entries.SaffronGymSignText:
SAFFRON CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: SABRINA

The Master of
Psychic #MON!

entries.SabrinaIntroText:
SABRINA: I knew
you were coming…

Three years ago I
had a vision of
your arrival.

You're after my
BADGE.

I don't enjoy bat-
tling, but it's my

duty as a LEADER
to confer BADGES

on anyone who has
proven him- or
herself worthy.

Since you wish it,
I will show you my
psychic powers!
entries.SabrinaWinLossText:
SABRINA: Your
power…

It far exceeds
what I foresaw…

Maybe it isn't
possible to fully

predict what the
future holds…

OK, you win. You
earned yourself
MARSHBADGE.
entries.SabrinaMarshBadgeText:
SABRINA: MARSH-
BADGE draws out

your subliminal
powers…

Although I failed
to accurately pre-
dict your power,
this much I know
to be true.

You will become a
celebrated and
beloved CHAMPION!
entries.SabrinaFightDoneText:
SABRINA: Your love
for your #MON

overwhelmed my
psychic power…

The power of love,
I think, is also a

kind of psychic
power…
entries.MediumRebeccaSeenText:
The power of all
those you defeated
comes to me!
entries.MediumRebeccaAfterBattleText:
What is the source
of your power?
entries.PsychicFranklinSeenText:
Psychic power is
the power of your
soul.
entries.PsychicFranklinBeatenText:
Your soul has more
power than mine!
entries.PsychicFranklinAfterBattleText:
You made your soul
stronger, not just
your abilities.
entries.MediumDorisSeenText:
Fufufufu…
I see it clearly.

I can see into
your soul!
entries.MediumDorisBeatenText:
Though I read you,
I still lost…
entries.MediumDorisAfterBattleText:
Darn! I forgot
that I predicted I
would lose to you.
entries.PsychicJaredSeenText:
The FIGHTING DOJO
next door was once
this city's GYM.
entries.PsychicJaredAfterBattleText:
KARATE KING, the
master of the

FIGHTING DOJO, was
just destroyed by
SABRINA.
entries.SaffronGymGuideText:
Yo, CHAMP in
making!

A trainer as
skilled as you

doesn't need to be
told how to deal

with psychic-type
#MON, right?

I expect great
things from you!

Good luck!

entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerTrainIsn:
I'm sorry, but the
MAGNET TRAIN isn't
operating now.
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerAreYouCo:
We'll soon depart
for GOLDENROD.

Are you coming on
board?
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerRightThi:
May I see your
rail PASS, please?

OK. Right this
way, please.
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerYouDontH:
Sorry, but you
don't have a PASS.
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerHopeToSe:
We hope to see you
again.
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationOfficerArrivedI:
We have arrived in
SAFFRON.

We hope to see you
again.
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationGymGuideText:
The MAGNET TRAIN
is a super-modern

rail liner that
uses electricity

and magnets to
attain incredible
speed.

However, if there
isn't any elec-
tricity…
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationGymGuideText_Re:
Whew…

How many times
have I gone back

and forth between
KANTO and JOHTO?
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationTeacherText:
Before the MAGNET
TRAIN STATION was

built, there was a
house there.

A little girl
named COPYCAT used
to live there.
entries.SaffronMagnetTrainStationLassText:
Hi. Do you have a
rail PASS? I have

one. All the peo-
ple in SAFFRON who

ride the MAGNET
TRAIN have PASSES.

entries.SaffronMartCooltrainerMText:
There's a big
RADIO TOWER in
LAVENDER.
entries.SaffronMartCooltrainerFText:
I want to become
stronger, but I'm
not good yet…

Could you show me
how sometime?

entries.SaffronPokecenter1FTeacherText:
What are JOHTO's
#MON CENTERS
like?

…Oh, I see. So
they're not much

different from the
ones in KANTO.

I can go to JOHTO
without worrying,
then!
entries.SaffronPokecenter1FTeacherMobileText:
What are JOHTO's
#MON CENTERS
like?

…Oh, I see.
So they let you

link with people
far away?

Then I'll get my
friend in JOHTO to

catch a MARILL and
trade it to me!
entries.SaffronPokecenter1FFisherText:
I just happened to
come through ROCK

TUNNEL. There was
some commotion at
the POWER PLANT.
entries.SaffronPokecenter1FFisherReturnedMachine:
Caves collapse
easily.

Several caves have
disappeared in the

past few years,
like the one out-
side CERULEAN.

As a pro HIKER,
that's common
knowledge.
entries.SaffronPokecenter1FYoungsterText:
SILPH CO.'s HEAD
OFFICE and the

MAGNET TRAIN STA-
TION--they're the

places to see in
SAFFRON.

entries.BlaineIntroText:
BLAINE: Waaah!

My GYM in CINNABAR
burned down.

My fire-breathing
#MON and I are

homeless because
of the volcano.

Waaah!

But I'm back in
business as a GYM

LEADER here in
this cave.

If you can beat
me, I'll give you
a BADGE.

Ha! You'd better
have BURN HEAL!
entries.BlaineWinLossText:
BLAINE: Awesome.
I've burned out…

You've earned
VOLCANOBADGE!
entries.BlaineAfterBattleText:
BLAINE: I did lose
this time, but I'm

going to win the
next time.

When I rebuild my
CINNABAR GYM,

we'll have to have
a rematch.
entries.BlaineFightDoneText:
BLAINE: My fire
#MON will be

even stronger.
Just you watch!
entries.SeafoamGymGuideWinText:
Yo!

… Huh? It's over
already?

Sorry, sorry!

CINNABAR GYM was
gone, so I didn't

know where to find
you.

But, hey, you're
plenty strong even

without my advice.
I knew you'd win!
entries.SeafoamGymGuideWinText2:
A #MON GYM can
be anywhere as

long as the GYM
LEADER is there.

There's no need
for a building.

entries.SilphCoReceptionistText:
Welcome. This is
SILPH CO.'s HEAD
OFFICE BUILDING.
entries.SilphCoOfficerText:
Only employees are
permitted to go
upstairs.

But since you came
such a long way,

have this neat
little souvenir.
entries.SilphCoOfficerText_GotUpGrade:
It's SILPH CO.'s
latest product.

It's not for sale
anywhere yet.

entries.SilverCavePokecenter1FGrannyText:
Trainers who seek
power climb MT.

SILVER despite its
many dangers…

With their trusted
#MON, they must

feel they can go
anywhere…

entries.SlowpokeWellB1FKurtText:
KURT: Hey there,
<PLAYER>!

The guard up top
took off when I
shouted at him.

But then I took a
tumble down the
WELL.

I slammed down
hard on my back,
so I can't move.

Rats! If I were
fit, my #MON

would've punished
them…

Ah, it can't be
helped.

<PLAYER>, show them
how gutsy you are
in my place!
entries.KurtLeaveSlowpokeWellText:
KURT: Way to go,
<PLAYER>!

TEAM ROCKET has
taken off.

My back's better
too. Let's get out
of here.
entries.GruntM29SeenText:
Darn! I was stand-
ing guard up top

when some old coot
yelled at me.

He startled me so
much that I fell
down here.

I think I'll vent
my anger by taking
it out on you!
entries.GruntM29BeatenText:
Arrgh! This is NOT
my day!
entries.GruntM29AfterBattleText:
Sure, we've been
hacking the tails

off SLOWPOKE and
selling them.

Everything we do
is for profit.

That's right!
We're TEAM ROCKET,

and we'll do any-
thing for money!
entries.GruntM1SeenText:
What do you want?

If you interrupt
our work, don't
expect any mercy!
entries.GruntM1BeatenText:
You did OK today,
but wait till next
time!
entries.TrainerGruntM1WhenTalkText:
Yeah, TEAM ROCKET
was broken up
three years ago.

But we continued
our activities
underground.

Now you can have
fun watching us
stir up trouble!
entries.GruntM2SeenText:
Quit taking SLOW-
POKETAILS?

If we obeyed you,
TEAM ROCKET's rep
would be ruined!
entries.GruntM2AfterBattleText:
We need the money,
but selling SLOW-
POKETAILS?

It's tough being a
ROCKET GRUNT!
entries.GruntF1SeenText:
Stop taking TAILS?

Yeah, just try to
defeat all of us!
entries.GruntF1AfterBattleText:
SLOWPOKETAILS
grow back fast!

What's wrong with
selling them?
entries.SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeWithMailText:
A SLOWPOKE with
its TAIL cut off…

Huh? It has MAIL.
Read it?
entries.SlowpokeWellB1FSlowpokeMailText:
<PLAYER> read the
MAIL.

Be good and look
after the house

with Grandpa and
SLOWPOKE.

Love, Dad
entries.SlowpokeWellB1FTaillessSlowpokeText:
A SLOWPOKE with
its TAIL cut off…

entries.SlowpokeWellB2FGymGuideText:
I'm waiting to see
SLOWPOKE's moment
of evolution.

Through observa-
tion, I made a new
discovery.

A SLOWPOKE with a
KING'S ROCK often

gets bitten by a
SHELLDER.

Here, I'll share a
KING'S ROCK with
you.
entries.SlowpokeWellB2FGymGuideText_GotKingsRock:
I'm going to be
like SLOWPOKE.

I'll wait patient-
ly, so I can see
one evolve.

entries.MrFujiText:
MR.FUJI: Welcome.

Hmm… You appear to
be raising your

#MON in a kind
and loving manner.

#MON lovers
come here to pay

their respects to
departed #MON.

Please offer con-
dolences for the

souls of the de-
parted #MON.

I'm sure that will
make them happy.
entries.SoulHouseTeacherText:
There are other
graves of #MON
here, I think.

There are many
chambers that only
MR.FUJI may enter.
entries.SoulHouseLassText:
I came with my mom
to visit #MON
graves…
entries.SoulHouseGrannyText:
The #MON that
lived with me…

I loved them like
my grandchildren…

entries.SageChowSeenText:
We stand guard in
this tower.

Here, we express
our gratitude to
honor all #MON.
entries.SageChowAfterBattleText:
All living beings
coexist through
cooperation.

We must always be
thankful for this.
entries.SproutTower1FSage1Text:
Only if you reach
the top will you
obtain an HM.
entries.SproutTower1FSage2Text:
SPROUT TOWER was
built long ago

as a place for
#MON training.
entries.SproutTower1FGrannyText:
A BELLSPROUT over
100 feet tall…

People say that it
became the center
pillar here.
entries.SproutTower1FTeacherText:
See the pillar
shaking?

People are train-
ing upstairs.
entries.SproutTower1FStatueText:
A #MON statue…

It looks very
distinguished.

entries.SageNicoSeenText:
However hard we
battle, the TOWER
will stand strong.
entries.SageNicoBeatenText:
I fought hard but
I'm too weak.
entries.SageNicoAfterBattleText:
The flexible pil-
lar protects the

TOWER, even from
earthquakes.
entries.SageEdmondAfterBattleText:
I tried to copy
BELLSPROUT's

gentle movements
for battle…

But I didn't train
well enough.
entries.SproutTower2FStatueText:
A #MON statue…

It looks very
distinguished.

entries.SproutTowerElderLecturesRivalText:
ELDER: You are in-
deed skilled as a
trainer.

As promised, here
is your HM.

But let me say
this: You should

treat your
#MON better.

The way you battle
is far too harsh.

#MON are not
tools of war…
entries.SproutTowerRivalOnlyCareAboutStrongText:
…
…Humph!

He claims to be
the ELDER but
he's weak.

It stands to
reason.

I'd never lose to
fools who babble

about being nice
to #MON.

I only care about
strong #MON
that can win.

I really couldn't
care less about
weak #MON.
entries.SageLiSeenText:
So good of you to
come here!

SPROUT TOWER is a
place of training.

People and #MON
test their bonds

to build a bright
future together.

I am the final
test.

Allow me to check
the ties between

your #MON and
you!
entries.SageLiTakeThisFlashText:
You and your #-
MON should have

no problem using
this move.

Take this FLASH
HM.
entries.SageLiFlashExplanationText:
FLASH illuminates
even the darkest
of all places.

But to use it out
of battle, you

need the BADGE
from VIOLET's GYM.
entries.SageLiAfterBattleText:
I hope you learn
and grow from your
journey.
entries.SageJinSeenText:
I train to find
enlightenment in
#MON!
entries.SageJinAfterBattleText:
As #MON grow
stronger, so does
the trainer.

No, wait. As the
trainer grows

stronger, so do
the #MON.
entries.SageTroySeenText:
Let me see how
much you trust
your #MON.
entries.SageTroyAfterBattleText:
It is not far to
the ELDER.
entries.SageNealSeenText:
The ELDER's HM
lights even pitch-
black darkness.
entries.SageNealBeatenText:
It is my head that
is bright!
entries.SageNealAfterBattleText:
Let there be light
on your journey.
entries.SproutTower3FPaintingText:
It's a powerful
painting of a
BELLSPROUT.
entries.SproutTower3FStatueText:
A #MON statue…

It looks very
distinguished.

entries.CameraGrunt2SeenText:
It's my turn!
There's no escape!
entries.CameraGrunt2BeatenText:
Surveillance cams
are in the #MON
statues.

We'll keep appear-
ing until you trip
a secret switch.
entries.ScientistJedSeenText:
This was once a
ninja hideout.

There are traps to
confound intruders
like you.
entries.ScientistJedAfterBattleText:
All right. I'll
divulge a secret
about our hideout.

That thing on the
floor up ahead is
a warp panel.

If you step on it,
you'll be warped

back to the en-
trance.
entries.GruntM16SeenText:
Heheh. Feeling
lucky, punk?

Go ahead, take
another step.

We've got traps
set in the floor!
entries.GruntM16AfterBattleText:
I don't even know
where the traps
are planted.

You'll just have
to collect your
courage and walk.
entries.TeamRocketBaseB1FSecurityCameraText:
It's a PERSIAN
statue…

Its eyes are oddly
shiny.
entries.TeamRocketBaseB1FSecretSwitchText:
A secret switch!
Better press it.

entries.RocketBaseBossFThrashText:
We can't have a
brat like you on
the loose.

It's harmful to
TEAM ROCKET's
pride, you see.

However strong you
may be, you can't

take both of us at
the same time.

Sorry, baby. Now
get ready to be
thrashed.
entries.RocketBaseLanceShareFunText:
Hey! Don't be so
selfish. Spread
the fun around.
entries.RocketBaseBossDontMeddleText:
What? You had an
accomplice?

Where is your
sense of honor?

As the interim
boss in place of

GIOVANNI, I'll
show you how wrong

it is to meddle
with TEAM ROCKET!
entries.RocketBaseBossWinText:
Tch, you really
are strong.

It's too bad.

If you were to
join TEAM ROCKET,

you could become
an EXECUTIVE.
entries.RocketBaseBossRetreatText:
…This hideout is
done for…

But that's fine.
The broadcast ex-
periment was a
total success.

It doesn't matter
what happens to
this hideout now.

We have much big-
ger plans.

You'll come to
appreciate TEAM

ROCKET's true
power soon enough.

Enjoy yourself
while you can…

Fufufufu…
entries.RocketBaseLancePostBattleText:
LANCE: That did
it. We defeated

all the ROCKETS
here.

But I'm concerned
about the young

guy I battled in
the process…
entries.RocketBaseLancePowerOffText:
Sorry, <PLAY_G>.
I saw how well you

were doing, so I
just hung back.

Now all there is
left to do is to

turn off that odd
radio signal.
entries.RockerBaseLanceElectrodeFaintText:
It's this machine
that's causing all
the problems.

I don't see a
switch on it…

We have no choice.
We have to make

all the ELECTRODE
faint.

That should stop
this machine from

transmitting that
strange signal.

It's no fault of
the #MON, so it

makes me feel
guilty.

<PLAY_G>, let's
split the job.
entries.RocketBaseLancesSideText:
LANCE: Leave this
side to me.
entries.RocketBaseLanceElectrodeDoneText:
LANCE: That odd
signal has finally
stopped.

The LAKE should be
back to normal.

You're the hero!
Let me thank you

on behalf of all
the #MON.

Oh, yes. You
should take this.

I found it here,
but I don't have
any need for it.
entries.RocketBaseLanceWhirlpoolText:
That's WHIRLPOOL.
Teach it to a

#MON to get
across wild water.

But keep this in
mind.

You can use that
out of battle only

with the BADGE
from MAHOGANY GYM.
entries.RocketBaseLanceMonMasterText:
<PLAY_G>…

The journey to be-
coming the #MON

MASTER is long and
difficult.

Knowing that, will
you keep going?

…

I see. No, you're
right.

If you would give
up that easily,

you would have
never chased that

dream in the first
place.

I look forward to
seeing you again!
entries.LanceHealsText1:
LANCE: Are you all
right?

Your #MON are
hurt and tired.

Here, give them
some of my medi-
cine.
entries.LanceHealsText2:
LANCE: <PLAY_G>,
let's give it our
best for #MON.
entries.GruntM17SeenText:
The door won't
open?

Well, duh.
It has to have a

password that only
TEAM ROCKET knows.
entries.GruntM17AfterBattleText:
Heh, I'm just a
GRUNT.

I don't know the
password. Too bad
for you.
entries.GruntM18SeenText:
Oh, a kid? I don't
really like this,

but eliminate you
I must.
entries.GruntM18AfterBattleText:
I got wiped out on
the last mission
by a kid too.

When we were ab-
ducting #MON,

this kid with long
red hair and mean-

looking eyes just
creamed me…
entries.GruntM19AfterBattleText:
Heh, only the boss
knows the password
for that door.

Where's the boss?
Who knows? Go look
for yourself.
entries.RocketBaseDoorNoPasswordText:
The door's closed…

It needs a pass-
word to open.
entries.RocketBaseDoorKnowPasswordText:
The door's closed…

<PLAYER> entered
the password.

The door opened!
entries.RocketBaseB2FTransmitterText:
It's the radio
transmitter that's

sending the
sinister signal.

It's working at
full capacity.
entries.RocketBaseB2FDeactivateTransmitterText:
The radio trans-
mitter has finally

stopped its evil
broadcast.

entries.LanceGetPasswordText:
LANCE: It takes
two passwords to

get into the
boss's quarters.

Those passwords
are known only to
a few ROCKETS.

That ROCKET there
very graciously
told me so.

<PLAY_G>, let's go
get the passwords.
entries.TeamRocketBaseB3FRocketText:
Urrggh… The guy
in the cape is
incredibly tough…
entries.RocketBaseRivalText:
…

Didn't I tell you
that I was going

to destroy TEAM
ROCKET?

…Tell me, who was
the guy in the

cape who used
dragon #MON?

My #MON were no
match at all.

I don't care that
I lost. I can beat

him by getting
stronger #MON.

It's what he said
that bothers me…

He told me that
I don't love and

trust my #MON
enough.

I'm furious that I
lost to a bleeding
heart like him.

…Humph! I don't
have the time for
the likes of you!
entries.ExecutiveM4BeforeText:
What? Who are you?
This is the office

of our leader,
GIOVANNI.

Since disbanding
TEAM ROCKET three

years ago, he has
been in training.

But we're certain
he will be back

some day to assume
command again.

That's why we're
standing guard.

I won't let any-
one disturb this
place!
entries.ExecutiveM4BeatenText:
I… I couldn't do a
thing…

GIOVANNI, please
forgive me…
entries.ExecutiveM4AfterText:
No, I can't let
this affect me.

I have to inform
the others…
entries.RocketBaseMurkrowText:
MURKROW: The
password is…

HAIL GIOVANNI.
entries.GruntF5SeenText:
Do I know the
password?

Maybe.

But no weakling's
going to get it!
entries.GruntF5BeatenText:
All right. Stop.
I'll tell you.
entries.GruntF5AfterBattleText:
The password to
the boss's room is

SLOWPOKETAIL.

But it's useless
unless you have
two passwords.
entries.GruntM28SeenText:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!

You're challenging
me to a battle?

Hah! You're nuts,
but you have guts!

I like that!

If you can beat
me, I'll tell you

a password to the
boss's room!
entries.GruntM28AfterBattleText:
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!

The password to
the boss's room…

Uh…, I think it is
RATICATE TAIL.
entries.ScientistRossSeenText:
I used to work for
SILPH, but now I

run research for
TEAM ROCKET.

A meddlesome child
like you needs to
be punished.
entries.ScientistRossBeatenText:
A mere tactical
error cost me…
entries.ScientistRossAfterBattleText:
A radio signal
that drives #-
MON mad…

My experiment is a
complete success.

My promotion is
assured. This loss

means absolutely
nothing.
entries.ScientistMitchSeenText:
I don't care that
#MON are hurt
by our experiment.
entries.ScientistMitchBeatenText:
Thinking is my
strong suit, not
battling.
entries.ScientistMitchAfterBattleText:
If we turn up the
power of our radio

signal for broad-
cast nationwide…

The very thought
excites me!
entries.TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorNeedsPassword:
The door's closed…

It needs two
passwords to open.
entries.TeamRocketBaseB3FLockedDoorOpenSesameTex:
The door's closed…

<PLAYER> entered
the two passwords.

The door opened!

entries.TinTower1FEusineSuicuneText:
EUSINE: Awesome!
Too awesome, even!

I've never seen a
battle that great.

That was truly
inspiring to see.

SUICUNE was tough,
but you were even

more incredible,
<PLAYER>.

I heard SUICUNE's
mystic power

summons a rainbow-
colored #MON.

Maybe, just maybe,
what went on today

will cause that
#MON to appear.

I'm going to study
the legends more.

Thanks for showing
me that fantastic
battle.

Later, <PLAYER>!
entries.TinTower1FSage1Text:
According to
legend…

When the souls of
#MON and humans

commune, from the
heavens descends a

#MON of rainbow
colors…

Could it mean the
legendary #MON

are testing us
humans?
entries.TinTower1FSage2Text:
When the BRASS
TOWER burned down,

three nameless
#MON were said

to have perished.
It was tragic.

However…

A rainbow-colored
#MON…

In other words…

HO-OH descended
from the sky and

gave new life to
the three #MON.

They are…

SUICUNE, ENTEI and
RAIKOU.

That is what they
say.
entries.TinTower1FSage3Text:
The two TOWERS are
said to have been

built to foster
friendship and

hope between #-
MON and people.

That was 700 years
ago, but the ideal

still remains
important today.
entries.TinTower1FSage4Text1:
HO-OH appears to
have descended

upon this, the TIN
TOWER!
entries.TinTower1FSage5Text1:
This will protect
you. Take it.
entries.TinTower1FSage6Text1:
I believe you are
being tested.

Free your mind
from uncertainty,
and advance.
entries.TinTower1FEusineHoOhText:
I knew it.

I knew you'd get
to see the #MON

of rainbow colors,
<PLAYER>.

It happened just
as I envisioned.

My research isn't
bad, I might say.

I'm going to keep
studying #MON

to become a famous
#MANIAC!
entries.TinTower1FSage4Text2:
The legendary
#MON are said

to embody three
powers…

The lightning that
struck the TOWER.

The fire that
burned the TOWER.

And the rain that
put out the fire…
entries.TinTower1FSage5Text3:
When the legendary
#MON appeared…

They struck terror
in those who saw
their rise.

And…

Some even took to
futile attacks.

The legendary
#MON, knowing

their own power,
fled, ignoring the
frightened people.
entries.TinTower1FSage6Text2:
Of the legendary
#MON, SUICUNE

is said to be the
closest to HO-OH.

I hear there may
also be a link to

#MON known as
UNOWN.

The #MON UNOWN
must be sharing a

cooperative bond
with SUICUNE.

entries.TrainerHouse1FReceptionistText:
Welcome to TRAINER
HOUSE, the newest

and most happening
place in VIRIDIAN.

We're open to
trainers only.

You can battle
against the best

of the best right
downstairs.
entries.TrainerHouse1FCooltrainerMText:
VIRIDIAN is the
town closest to
INDIGO PLATEAU.

They built this
place because so

many trainers pass
through on their

way up to INDIGO
PLATEAU.
entries.TrainerHouse1FCooltrainerFText:
They hold practice
battles downstairs
here.

I would love to
see how well a

trainer from JOHTO
battles.
entries.TrainerHouse1FYoungsterText:
I guess you can't
become the CHAMP

unless you go all
over the place and

battle all kinds
of people.

The CHAMPION from
PALLET traveled to

all the cities and
towns in KANTO.
entries.TrainerHouse1FGentlemanText:
Whew… I'm taking a
rest from #MON
battles.
entries.TrainerHouseSign1Text:
Practice battles
are held in the

TRAINING HALL
downstairs.

Skilled trainers
are invited to
participate.
entries.TrainerHouseSign2Text:
There are no rules
or regulations for

practice matches.
Just like in field

battles, anything
goes!
entries.TrainerHouseIllegibleText:
…What's this?
A strategy memo?

This writing looks
like ONIX tracks…

It's completely
illegible…

entries.TrainerHouseB1FIntroText:
Hi. Welcome to our
TRAINING HALL.

You may battle a
trainer once per
day.
entries.TrainerHouseB1FGoRightInText:
Please go right
through.

You may begin
right away.
entries.TrainerHouseB1FPleaseComeAgainText:
Sorry. Only those
trainers who will

be battling are
allowed to go in.
entries.TrainerHouseB1FSecondChallengeDeniedText:
I'm sorry.
This would be your

second time today.
You're permitted

to enter just once
a day.
entries.TrainerHouseB1FCalBeforeText:
I traveled out
here just so I
could battle you.

entries.HikerRussellSeenText:
You're headed to
AZALEA, are you?

Let my #MON see
if you are good
enough to battle.
entries.HikerRussellAfterBattleText:
All right, then!
I've decided.

I'm not leaving
until my #MON
get tougher!
entries.PokemaniacLarrySeenText:
I roam far and
wide in search of
#MON.

Are you looking
for #MON too?

Then you're my
collecting rival!
entries.PokemaniacLarryAfterBattleText:
Every Friday, you
can hear #MON

roars from deep
inside the cave.
entries.HikerDanielSeenText:
Whoa! What a
surprise!

I didn't expect to
see anyone here!
entries.HikerDanielAfterBattleText:
I was conned into
buying a SLOWPOKE-
TAIL.

I feel sorry for
the poor #MON.
entries.FirebreatherBillSeenText:
ZUBAT's SUPERSONIC
keeps confusing
my #MON.

I'm seriously
upset about that!
entries.FirebreatherBillAfterBattleText:
On weekends, you
can hear strange

roars from deep in
the cave.
entries.FirebreatherRaySeenText:
If it's light, a
cave isn't scary.

If you're strong,
#MON aren't
scary.
entries.FirebreatherRayAfterBattleText:
It's my #MON's
fire that lights
up this cave.

entries.HikerPhillipSeenText:
It's been a while
since I last saw
another person.

Don't be shy.
Let's battle!
entries.HikerPhillipAfterBattleText:
I've been lost for
a long time…

I don't mind it
here, but I am
soooo hungry!
entries.HikerLeonardSeenText:
What do you know!
A visitor!
entries.HikerLeonardAfterBattleText:
I live down here.

You can, too, if
you'd like.

There's plenty of
room, you see.
entries.PokemaniacAndrewSeenText:
Who's there?

Leave me and my
#MON alone!
entries.PokemaniacAndrewAfterBattleText:
Just me and my
#MON. I'm de-
lirious with joy.
entries.PokemaniacCalvinSeenText:
I came all the way
here to conduct my
#MON research.

Let me demonstrate
my findings in a
real battle!
entries.PokemaniacCalvinAfterBattleText:
I should compile
and announce my
study findings.

I might even be-
come famous like
PROF.ELM.

entries.CooltrainermNickSeenText:
There are two
kinds of people.

Those who have
style, and those
who don't.

What kind of
person are you?
entries.CooltrainermNickAfterBattleText:
Your #MON style
is stunning and
colorful, I admit.

You'll just keep
getting better!
entries.CooltrainerfGwenSeenText:
I'm in training.
Care for a round?
entries.CooltrainerfGwenBeatenText:
Aww, no! You're
too good for me.
entries.CooltrainerfGwenAfterBattleText:
I'm going to train
by myself until I
improve.
entries.CooltrainerfEmmaSeenText:
If the #MON I
liked were there,
I'd go anywhere.

That's what a real
trainer does.
entries.CooltrainerfEmmaBeatenText:
I'd rather pet my
babies than this!
entries.CooltrainerfEmmaAfterBattleText:
Just once a week,
a #MON comes to
the water's edge.

I wanted to see
that #MON…

entries.VermilionCityTeacherText:
VERMILION PORT is
KANTO's seaside
gateway.

Luxury liners from
around the world
dock here.
entries.VermilionMachopOwnerText:
My #MON is
preparing the land
for construction.

But I have no
money to start the
project…
entries.VermilionMachopText2:
A MACHOP is growl-
ing while stomping
the ground flat.
entries.VermilionCitySuperNerdText:
There are eight
GYMS in KANTO.

That big building
is VERMILION's
#MON GYM.
entries.VermilionCityRadioNearSnorlaxText:
The #GEAR was
placed near the
sleeping SNORLAX…

…

SNORLAX woke up!
entries.VermilionCityBadgeGuyTrainerText:
Skilled trainers
gather in KANTO.

GYM LEADERS are
especially strong.

They won't be easy
to defeat.
entries.VermilionCityBadgeGuySomeBadgesText:
You've started to
collect KANTO GYM
BADGES?

Don't you agree
that the trainers
here are tough?
entries.VermilionCityBadgeGuyMostBadgesText:
I guess you'll be
finished with your

conquest of KANTO
GYMS soon.

Let me know if
you get all eight
BADGES.
entries.VermilionCityBadgeGuyAllBadgesText:
Congratulations!

You got all the
KANTO GYM BADGES.

I've got a reward
for your efforts.
entries.VermilionCityBadgeGuyBattleEdgeText:
Having a variety
of #MON types

should give you an
edge in battle.

I'm sure the KANTO
GYM BADGES will
help you.
entries.VermilionCitySignText:
VERMILION CITY

The Port of
Exquisite Sunsets
entries.VermilionGymSignText:
VERMILION CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: LT.SURGE

The Lightning
American

entries.VermilionDiglettsCaveSpeechHouseGentlema:
Over many years,
DIGLETT dug a
large tunnel.

That tunnel goes
to a distant town.

entries.FishingDudeText:
I am the FISHING
DUDE, the elder of
the FISHING BROS.

Have you met the
FISHING GURU at
LAKE OF RAGE?

He dreams about
seeing the world's
greatest MAGIKARP.

If you don't mind,
could you show him

any MAGIKARP you
catch?

Who knows, you may
catch the MAGIKARP
of his dreams.
entries.FishingDudesHousePhotoText:
It's a photo of
people fishing…

They're having a
great time…

entries.LtSurgeIntroText:
SURGE: Hey, you
little tyke!

I have to hand it
to you. It may not

be very smart to
challenge me, but
it takes guts!

When it comes to
electric #MON,
I'm number one!

I've never lost on
the battlefield.

I'll zap you just
like I did my
enemies in war!
entries.LtSurgeWinLossText:
SURGE: Arrrgh!
You are strong!

OK, kid. You get
THUNDERBADGE!
entries.LtSurgeThunderBadgeText:
SURGE: THUNDER-
BADGE increases
#MON's speed. 

Consider it proof
that you defeated

me. You wear it
proudly, hear?
entries.LtSurgeFightDoneText:
SURGE: Hey, kid!
Still slugging and
chugging away?

My #MON and I
are still at it!
entries.GentlemanGregorySeenText:
You're here to
defeat LT.SURGE?

Not if I can help
it!
entries.GentlemanGregoryBeatenText:
Sorry I failed
you, LT.SURGE,
sir!
entries.GentlemanGregoryAfterBattleText:
When I was still
in the army, LT.

SURGE saved my
life.
entries.GuitaristVincentSeenText:
LT.SURGE recog-
nized my potential

with electric
#MON.

Think you can beat
me?
entries.GuitaristVincentAfterBattleText:
If the GYM's traps
were working, you

would have been
toast…
entries.JugglerHortonSeenText:
I'm going to take
you down! Prepare
to be shocked!
entries.JugglerHortonAfterBattleText:
Don't get too com-
fortable about

beating me…
LT.SURGE is tough.
entries.VermilionGymGuideText:
Yo! CHAMP in
making!

You lucked out
this time.

LT.SURGE is very
cautious. He has

traps set all over
the GYM.

But--he-heh--the
traps aren't
active right now.

You'll have no
problem getting to
LT.SURGE.
entries.VermilionGymGuideWinText:
Whew! That was an
electrifying bout!

It sure made me
nervous.

entries.VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHousePokefanFT:
Do you know about
the MAGNET TRAIN?

It's a railway
that goes to GOL-
DENROD in JOHTO.
entries.VermilionMagnetTrainSpeechHouseYoungster:
I want to go to
SAFFRON to see
the MAGNET TRAIN.

entries.VermilionMartSuperNerdText:
TEAM ROCKET is no
longer in KANTO.

That alone makes
me happy.
entries.VermilionMartBeautyText:
I'm thinking about
going shopping in
SAFFRON.

entries.VermilionPokecenter1FFishingGuruText:
A sleeping #MON
is lying in front
of DIGLETT'S CAVE.

It's a fantastic
opportunity to get

it, but how do you
wake it up?
entries.VermilionPokecenter1FFishingGuruText_Fou:
There used to be a
sleeping #MON

lying in front of
DIGLETT'S CAVE.

But it seems to
have disappeared.
entries.VermilionPokecenter1FSailorText:
The FAST SHIP is a
great place to

meet and battle
trainers.
entries.VermilionPokecenter1FBugCatcherText:
Oh? You have some
BADGES I've never
seen before.

Oh, I get it. You
got them in JOHTO.

entries.VermilionPortDepartingText:
We're departing
soon. Please get
on board.
entries.VermilionPortAskBoardingText:
Welcome to FAST
SHIP S.S.AQUA.

Will you be board-
ing today?
entries.VermilionPortComeAgainText:
We hope to see you
again!
entries.VermilionPortSSTicketText:
<PLAYER> flashed
the S.S.TICKET.

That's it.
Thank you!
entries.VermilionPortNoTicketText:
<PLAYER> tried to
show the S.S.
TICKET…

…But no TICKET!

Sorry!
You may board only

if you have an
S.S.TICKET.
entries.VermilionPortSailWednesdayText:
The FAST SHIP will
sail on Wednesday.
entries.VermilionPortSailSundayText:
The FAST SHIP will
sail next Sunday.
entries.VermilionPortSuperNerdText:
You came from
JOHTO?

I hear many rare
#MON live over
there.

entries.VermilionPortPassageTeacherText:
The FAST SHIP
sails on Wednes-
days and Sundays
every week.

entries.VictoryRoadRivalBeforeText:
Hold it.

…Are you going to
take the #MON
LEAGUE challenge?

…Don't make me
laugh.

You're so much
weaker than I am.

I'm not like I was
before.

I now have the
best and strongest

#MON with me.
I'm invincible!

<PLAYER>!
I challenge you!
entries.VictoryRoadRivalDefeatText:
…I couldn't win…

I gave it every-
thing I had…

What you possess,
and what I lack…

I'm beginning to
understand what

that dragon master
said to me…
entries.VictoryRoadRivalAfterText:
…I haven't given up
on becoming the
greatest trainer…

I'm going to find
out why I can't

win and become
stronger…

When I do, I will
challenge you.

And I'll beat you
down with all my
power.

…Humph! You keep
at it until then.
entries.VictoryRoadRivalVictoryText:
…Humph!

When it comes down
to it, nothing can
beat power.

I don't need any-
thing else.

entries.VictoryRoadGateOfficerText:
Only trainers who
have proven them-
selves may pass.
entries.VictoryRoadGateNotEnoughBadgesText:
You don't have all
the GYM BADGES of
JOHTO.

I'm sorry, but I
can't let you go
through.
entries.VictoryRoadGateEightBadgesText:
Oh! The eight
BADGES of JOHTO!

Please, go right
on through!
entries.VictoryRoadGateLeftBlackBeltText:
This way leads to
MT.SILVER.

You'll see scary-
strong #MON out
there.
entries.VictoryRoadGateRightBlackBeltText:
Off to the #MON
LEAGUE, are you?

The ELITE FOUR are
so strong it's

scary, and they're
ready for you!

entries.Text_EarlAsksIfYouBeatFalkner:
Hello!
You are trainer?

Battle GYM LEADER,
win you did?
entries.Text_VeryNiceIndeed:
Ooh, la la!
Very indeed nice!
entries.Text_FollowEarl:
Is that so? Then
study shall you!
Follow me!
entries.Text_HereTeacherIAm:
Here, teacher I
am. Good it is
you study here!
entries.VioletCityLassText:
Ghosts are rumored
to appear in
SPROUT TOWER.

They said normal-
type #MON moves

had no effect on
ghosts.
entries.VioletCitySuperNerdText:
Hey, you're a
#MON trainer?

If you beat the
GYM LEADER here,

you'll be ready
for prime time!
entries.VioletCityGrampsText:
FALKNER, from the
VIOLET #MON

GYM, is a fine
trainer!

He inherited his
father's gym and

has done a great
job with it.
entries.VioletCityYoungsterText:
I saw a wiggly
tree up ahead!

If you touch it,
it squirms and
dances! Cool!
entries.VioletCitySignText:
VIOLET CITY

The City of
Nostalgic Scents
entries.VioletGymSignText:
VIOLET CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: FALKNER

The Elegant Master
of Flying #MON
entries.SproutTowerSignText:
SPROUT TOWER

Experience the
Way of #MON

entries.FalknerIntroText:
I'm FALKNER, the
VIOLET #MON GYM
leader!

People say you can
clip flying-type

#MON's wings
with a jolt of
electricity…

I won't allow such
insults to bird
#MON!

I'll show you the
real power of the

magnificent bird
#MON!
entries.FalknerWinLossText:
…Darn! My dad's
cherished bird
#MON…

All right.
Take this.

It's the official
#MON LEAGUE
ZEPHYRBADGE.
entries.FalknerZephyrBadgeText:
ZEPHYRBADGE
raises the attack
power of #MON.

It also enables
#MON to use

FLASH, if they
have it, anytime.

Here--take this
too.
entries.FalknerTMMudSlapText:
By using a TM, a
#MON will

instantly learn a
new move.

Think before you
act--a TM can be
used only once.

TM31 contains
MUD-SLAP.

It reduces the
enemy's accuracy

while it causes
damage.

In other words, it
is both defensive
and offensive.
entries.FalknerFightDoneText:
There are #MON
GYMS in cities and
towns ahead.

You should test
your skills at
these GYMS.

I'm going to train
harder to become

the greatest bird
master!
entries.BirdKeeperRodSeenText:
The keyword is
guts!

Those here are
training night and

day to become bird
#MON masters.

Come on!
entries.BirdKeeperRodAfterBattleText:
FALKNER's skills
are for real!

Don't get cocky
just because you
beat me!
entries.BirdKeeperAbeSeenText:
Let me see if you
are good enough to
face FALKNER!
entries.BirdKeeperAbeAfterBattleText:
This is pathetic,
losing to some
rookie trainer…
entries.VioletGymGuideText:
Hey! I'm no train-
er but I can give
some advice!

Believe me!
If you believe, a

championship dream
can come true.

You believe?
Then listen.

The grass-type is
weak against the

flying-type. Keep
this in mind.
entries.VioletGymGuideWinText:
Nice battle! Keep
it up, and you'll

be the CHAMP in no
time at all!

entries.VioletKylesHousePokefanMText:
A #MON you get
in a trade grows
quickly.

But if you don't
have the right GYM

BADGE, they may
disobey you.

entries.VioletMartGrannyText:
When you first
catch a #MON,
it may be weak.

But it will even-
tually grow to be
strong.

It's important to
treat #MON with
love.
entries.VioletMartCooltrainerMText:
#MON can hold
items like POTION
and ANTIDOTE.

But they don't
appear to know how

to use manmade
items.

entries.VioletNicknameSpeechHouseTeacherText:
She uses the names
of her favorite
things to eat.

For the nicknames
she gives to her
#MON, I mean.

entries.VioletPokecenterElmsAideFavorText:
<PLAY_G>, long
time, no see.

PROF.ELM asked me
to find you.

He has another
favor to ask.

Would you take the
#MON EGG?
entries.VioletPokecenterElmsAideGiveEggText:
We discovered that
a #MON will not

hatch until it
grows in the EGG.

It also has to be
with other active
#MON to hatch.

<PLAY_G>, you're
the only person
we can rely on.

Please call PROF.
ELM when that EGG
hatches!
entries.VioletCityElmsAideFullPartyText:
Oh, no. You can't
carry any more
#MON with you.

I'll wait here
while you make
room for the EGG.
entries.VioletPokecenterFarawayLinkText:
I've been thinking
it'd be great to

be able to link up
and battle with my

friends who live
far away.
entries.VioletPokecenterMobileAdapterText:
I just battled a
friend in CIANWOOD
over a link.

If you connect a
MOBILE ADAPTER,

you can link with
a friend far away.
entries.VioletPokecenter1FGameboyKidText:
A guy named BILL
made the #MON
PC storage system.
entries.VioletPokecenter1FGentlemanText:
It was around
three years ago.

TEAM ROCKET was up
to no good with
#MON.

But justice pre-
vailed--a young
kid broke 'em up.
entries.VioletPokecenter1FYoungsterText:
#MON are smart.
They won't obey a

trainer they don't
respect.

Without the right
GYM BADGES, they

will just do as
they please.

entries.ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsQuestionText:
Hey, kid! I just
had a double shot

of espresso, and
I am wired!

I need to talk to
someone, so you'll
have to do!

I might not look
like much now, but

I was an expert at
catching #MON.

Do you believe me?
entries.ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsBelievedText:
Good, good. Yes, I
was something out

of the ordinary,
let me tell you!
entries.ViridianCityCoffeeGrampsDoubtedText:
What? You little
whelp!

If I were just a
bit younger, I'd

show you a thing
or two. Humph!
entries.ViridianCityGrampsNearGymText:
This GYM didn't
have a LEADER
until recently.

A young man from
PALLET became the

LEADER, but he's
often away.
entries.ViridianCityGrampsNearGymBlueReturnedTex:
Are you going to
battle the LEADER?

Good luck to you.
You'll need it.
entries.ViridianCityDreamEaterFisherText:
Yawn!

I must have dozed
off in the sun.

…I had this dream
about a DROWZEE

eating my dream.
Weird, huh?

Huh?
What's this?

Where did this TM
come from?

This is spooky!
Here, you can have
this TM.
entries.ViridianCityYoungsterText:
I heard that there
are many items on

the ground in
VIRIDIAN FOREST.
entries.ViridianCitySignText:
VIRIDIAN CITY

The Eternally
Green Paradise
entries.ViridianGymSignText:
VIRIDIAN CITY
#MON GYM
LEADER: …

The rest of the
text is illegible…
entries.ViridianCityWelcomeSignText:
WELCOME TO
VIRIDIAN CITY,

THE GATEWAY TO
INDIGO PLATEAU
entries.TrainerHouseSignText:
TRAINER HOUSE

The Club for Top
Trainer Battles

entries.LeaderBlueBeforeText:
BLUE: Yo! Finally
got here, huh?

I wasn't in the
mood at CINNABAR,

but now I'm ready
to battle you.

…

You're telling me
you conquered all
the GYMS in JOHTO?

Heh! JOHTO's GYMS
must be pretty
pathetic then.

Hey, don't worry
about it.

I'll know if you
are good or not by

battling you right
now.

Ready, JOHTO
CHAMP?
entries.LeaderBlueWinText:
BLUE: What?

How the heck did I
lose to you?

…

Tch, all right…
Here, take this--
it's EARTHBADGE.
entries.LeaderBlueAfterText:
BLUE: …

All right, I was
wrong. You're the

real deal. You are
a good trainer.

But I'm going to
beat you someday.

Don't you forget
it!
entries.LeaderBlueEpilogueText:
BLUE: Listen, you.

You'd better not
lose until I beat
you. Got it?
entries.ViridianGymGuideText:
Yo, CHAMP in
making!

How's it going?
Looks like you're
on a roll.

The GYM LEADER is
a guy who battled

the CHAMPION three
years ago.

He's no pushover.

Give it everything
you've got!
entries.ViridianGymGuideWinText:
Man, you are truly
tough…

That was a heck of
an inspirational

battle. It brought
tears to my eyes.

entries.ViridianMartLassText:
The GYM LEADER
here is totally
cool.
entries.ViridianMartCooltrainerMText:
Have you been to
CINNABAR?

It's an island way
south of here.

entries.ViridianNicknameSpeechHousePokefanMText:
Do you put a lot
of thought into

naming your
#MON?

Giving them good
nicknames adds to

the fun of trading
with others.
entries.ViridianNicknameSpeechHouseLassText:
They're SPEARY--
a SPEAROW--and
RATTEY--a RATTATA.

entries.ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText:
Where in the world
is VIRIDIAN's GYM

LEADER? I wanted
to challenge him.
entries.ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerMText_Blu:
There are no GYM
TRAINERS at the
VIRIDIAN GYM.

The LEADER claims
his policy is to

win without having
any underlings.
entries.ViridianPokecenter1FCooltrainerFText:
I heard that the
GYM in CINNABAR is
gone.

I wonder what be-
came of BLAINE,
the GYM LEADER.
entries.ViridianPokecenter1FBugCatcherText:
My dream is to be-
come a GYM LEADER.

entries.WillScript_WillBeforeText:
Welcome to #MON
LEAGUE, <PLAYER>.

Allow me to intro-
duce myself. I am
WILL.

I have trained all
around the world,

making my psychic
#MON powerful.

And, at last, I've
been accepted into
the ELITE FOUR.

I can only keep
getting better!

Losing is not an
option!
entries.WillScript_WillDefeatText:
Even though I was
defeated, I won't
change my course.

I will continue
battling until I

stand above all
trainers!

Now, <PLAYER>, move
on and experience

the true ferocity
of the ELITE FOUR.

entries.WiseTriosRoomSage1Text:
Astounding…

SUICUNE, ENTEI and
RAIKOU have arisen
from their sleep…

Is the legend
coming true?
entries.WiseTriosRoomSage2Text:
We train at the
BURNED TOWER, but

we've never heard
of a hole opening

up there before.
It must have been

deliberately made
by someone.
entries.WiseTriosRoomSage3BlocksExitText:
TIN TOWER may be
entered by those

bearing ECRUTEAK's
GYM BADGE.

However, now that
SUICUNE, RAIKOU

and ENTEI have
arisen, I ask you

to refrain from
entering!
entries.WiseTriosRoomSage3Text:
We, the WISE TRIO,
are the protectors

of the legendary
#MON.
entries.SageGakuSeenText:
Legend has it that
upon the emergence

of a trainer who
has the ability to

touch the souls of
#MON, a #MON

will come forth to
put that trainer

to test at the TIN
TOWER.

The legend has
come true!

The legendary
#MON SUICUNE
has arrived!

We, the WISE TRIO,
shall test your

worthiness to go
inside!
entries.SageGakuAfterBattleText:
Ah, so it is you
who claim to have

seen SUICUNE,
ENTEI and RAIKOU
while they slept?

Unbelievable!

Legend has it that
they can't be seen
while they sleep…
entries.SageMasaSeenText:
Can you be trusted
with the truth?

I must ascertain
your worthiness.
entries.SageMasaAfterBattleText:
In the past, there
were two nine-tier
towers here.

The BRASS TOWER,
which was said to

awaken #MON,
and the TIN TOWER,

where #MON were
said to rest.

The view from the
tops of the TOWERS

must have been
magnificent.

At the time, an
immense, silver-

colored #MON
was said to make

its roost atop the
BRASS TOWER.

However…

About 150 years
ago, a lightning

bolt struck one of
the TOWERS.

It was engulfed in
flames that raged
for three days.

A sudden downpour
finally put out
the blaze.

And that is how
the BURNED TOWER
came to be.
entries.SageKojiAfterBattleQuestionText:
You… Are you the
trainer who is

awaited by the
legendary #MON?
entries.SageKojiAfterBattleSpeechText:
I see…

We, the WISE TRIO,
have been given 

the responsibility
of protecting the

legendary #MON.
We are to allow

passage only to
those people who

possess the power
and soul of truth.

Please, do go on
and enter the TIN
TOWER ahead.

SUICUNE will put
you to the test.
entries.SageKojiAfterBattleFinalText:
Please, do go on.

SUICUNE will put
you to the test.
